programme.title: Air Force One Is Down
programme.desc: Serbian terrorists kidnapped the US President and several dignitaries and took them hostage in an attempt to secure the release of notorious war criminal General Arkady Dragutin. His arrest by the Irish Captain Fergus Markey was supposed to enable Serbia to join NATO, but now Markey sets out to free the kidnapped politicians from the hands of the militia. / Serbische Terroristen entfuhren die US-Prasidentin und einige Wurdentrager und nehmen sie als Geiseln, um die Freilassung des beruchtigten Kriegsverbrechers General Arkady Dragutin zu erreichen. Dessen Verhaftung durch den Iren Captain Fergus Markey sollte Serbien den Beitritt zur NATO ermoglichen, doch nun macht Markey sich auf den Weg, um die gekidnappten Politiker aus den Handen der Miliz zu befreien.

programme.title: Do you want to go with me? / Willst Du mit mir gehen?
programme.desc: A single person meets four candidates on a hike, but only one is allowed to go all the way to the end. There are small challenges and exciting outdoor activities that need to be mastered along the way. Who will find a partner? / Ein Single trifft auf einer Wanderung auf vier Kandidaten, aber nur einer darf den Weg bis zum Ende gehen. Unterwegs mussen kleine Herausforderungen und spannende Outdoor-Aktivitaten gemeistert werden. Wer findet dabei einen Partner?

programme.desc: Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: King Julien
programme.desc: Julien is the new monarch of the jungle and he is turning the kingdom into a party zone. Unfortunately, he also has to act as king to keep his subjects happy. However, the Regent doesn't like that at all. / Julien ist der neue Monarch des Dschungels und er verwandelt das Konigreich in eine Party-Zone. Dummerweise muss er sich auch als Konig betatigen, um seine Untertanen zufrieden zu stellen. Das schmeckt dem Regenten allerdings gar nicht.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Tom
programme.desc: A friendly dinosaur named Tom lands in the metropolis of New York after an adventurous journey through a violent storm. There he meets the two circus children Wanda and Tip and becomes friends with them. / Ein freundlicher Dinosaurier namens Tom landet nach einer abenteuerlichen Fahrt durch ein heftiges Unwetter in der Metropole New York. Dort lernt er die beiden Zirkuskinder Wanda und Tip kennen und freundet sich mit ihnen an.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper has skipped four grades and is starting high school at the same time as his older brother. The fact that he is gifted is often met with incomprehension by his father, his siblings and his schoolmates, but Sheldon's mother supports him all the more. Because of his stubborn nature, he often drives his brother and sister crazy, and the teachers aren't particularly enthusiastic about the clever boy with a special talent for science. / Der neunjahrige Sheldon Cooper hat vier Klassen ubersprungen und beginnt gleichzeitig mit seinem alteren Bruder an der Highschool. Die Tatsache, dass er hochbegabt ist, stoSSt bei seinem Vater, seinen Geschwistern und seinen Schulkameraden haufig auf Unverstandnis, doch Sheldons Mutter unterstutzt ihn umso mehr. Wegen seiner eigenwilligen Art treibt er seinen Bruder und seine Schwester oft zur WeiSSglut und auch die Lehrerschaft ist nicht gerade begeistert von dem neunmalklugen Jungen mit dem besonderen Talent fur die Wissenschaft.

programme.title: Die Simpsons
programme.desc: There is always something going on in the lives of the Simpson family. The lovable but unlucky, scatterbrained and rather lazy father Homer Simpson works in a nuclear power plant and tries to keep his family afloat as best he can. As a mother and housewife, his wife Marge is the good soul in the Simpson house and always tries to improve basic moral values ​​both in the family and in society. The parents have their hands full with their three children. With ten-year-old Bart, you never know what prank he'll come up with next. The eight-year-old, highly intelligent and ambitious Lisa is a do-gooder who is often teased as a nerd at school. The Simpsons is completed by Baby Maggie. The lives of the family and the other residents of the small US town of Springfield are characterized by the everyday chaos and normal madness of society. / Im Leben der Familie Simpson ist immer etwas los. Der liebenswerte, aber vom Pech verfolgte, schusselige und ziemlich faule Vater Homer Simpson arbeitet in einem Atomkraftwerk und versucht, seine Familie bestmoglich uber Wasser zu halten. Seine Frau Marge ist als Mutter und Hausfrau die gute Seele im Hause Simpson und versucht stets, sowohl in der Familie als auch in der Gesellschaft die moralischen Grundwerte zu verbessern. Die Eltern haben alle Hande voll zu tun mit ihren drei Kindern. Bei dem zehnjahrigen Bart weiSS man nie, welchen Streich er als nachstes ausheckt. Die achtjahrige hochintelligente und ehrgeizige Lisa ist eine Weltverbesserin, die in der Schule oft als Streber gehanselt wird. Vervollstandigt werden die Simpsons von Baby Maggie. Das Leben der Familie und der anderen Bewohner der US-Kleinstadt Springfield ist gepragt vom alltaglichen Chaos und ganz normalen Wahnsinn der Gesellschaft.

programme.title: Terminator 2 - Judgment Day / Terminator 2 - Tag der Abrechnung
programme.desc: After the first attempt to kill the resistance leader John Connor, born in 1985, failed in the past, the cyborgs of 2029 make a second attempt. This time the T-1000 Terminator is supposed to take over the mission. But the Terminator is not alone, because the original model 101 from the T-800 series was programmed in the future to protect Connor. / Nachdem der erste Versuch, den im Jahr 1985 geborenen Anfuhrer des Widerstandes John Connor in der Vergangenheit zu toten, gescheitert ist, unternehmen die Cyborgs des Jahres 2029 einen zweiten Versuch. Diesmal soll der T-1000-Terminator die Mission ubernehmen. Doch der Terminator ist nicht allein, denn das Ur-Modell 101 aus der T-800er Serie wurde in der Zukunft darauf programmiert, Connor zu schutzen.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Will is a US veteran who suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder after serving in the Iraq War. For this reason, he and his 13-year-old daughter Tom live a peaceful, but isolated, life in a natural area near Portland, Oregon. When Will is discovered by a jogger one day, he notifies the authorities. Father and daughter are then assigned to a host family where they are supposed to be reintegrated into society. / Will ist ein US-Veteran, der nach seinem Einsatz im Irak-Krieg unter einer posttraumatischen Belastungsstorung leidet. Aus diesem Grund leben er und seine 13-jahrige Tochter Tom ein friedliches, aber von der AuSSenwelt abgeschottetes, Leben in einem Naturgebiet nahe Portland, Oregon. Als Will eines Tages von einem Jogger entdeckt wird, benachrichtigt dieser die Behorden. Vater und Tochter werden sodann einer Gastfamilie zugeteilt, bei der sie wieder in die Gesellschaft integriert werden sollen.

programme.title: Blue Bloods - Crime Scene New York
programme.desc: Frank Reagan is the chief of the New York Police Department. The widower is following his father, who also previously headed this authority and who is always helpful to him with his knowledge and contacts. The fight against crime is not just a job for the Reagans, but a real family affair. Frank's sons Daniel and Jamison also wear the typical blue police uniforms. / Frank Reagan ist Chef der Polizei von New York. programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. programme.title: The nation is a witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. Without the support of a man, they will have to stand up to the opposite and dominant sex and show that they are capable of running their own estate. / Tri sestre ostale su same nakon smrti oca. Bez podrške nekog muškarca one će morati da se suprotstave suprotnom i dominantnom spolu i pokazati da su sposobne same voditi svoje imanje.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Pogledaj u sutra
programme.desc: Chloe Delcourt went in search of her son after the terrible explosion on the coast of Sète. Her life turns upside down when the body of her sister, whom she hasn't seen for years, is found on the shore... / Chloe Delcourt otišla je u potragu za svojim sinom nakon strašne eksplozije na obali Sète. Njezin život okrene se naglavačke kada na obali pronađu tijelo njezine sestre koju godinama nije vidjela...

programme.title: Centar dana
programme.desc: An infotainment show that listens to the most current social topics and events that we comment on with guests from all social spheres. We bring viewers interesting things from the world of entertainment, culture, and art, and we often have regional stars as guests. The show is edited and hosted by Dragana Božić and Milica Nogo. / Infotaiment emisija koja osluškuje najaktuelnije društvene teme i događaje koje komentarišemo sa gostima iz svih društenih sfera. Gledaocima donosimo zanimljivosti iz sveta zabave, kulture, i umjetnosti, a često su nam u gostima i regionalne zvijezde. Emisiju uređuju i vode Dragana Božić i Milica Nogo.

programme.title: Poseban tretman
programme.desc: Doctor Ilić works in a hospital for forced treatment of alcoholics. Carrying out his "special treatment" composed of physical exercises, an apple diet, the healing effect of Wagner's music and psychodrama, he and a group of six patients visit a brewery where alcoholism in the workplace is a big problem. From the events that follow, it is revealed that the doctor applies his way of treating patients in order to express his essentially despotic and hypocritical personality. / Doktor Ilić radi u bolnici za prinudno liječenje alkoholičara. Sprovodeći svoj "poseban tretman" sastavljen od fizičkih vežbi, dijete jabukama, iscjeliteljskog dejstva Vagnerove muzike i psihodrame, on sa grupom od šest pacijenata odlazi u posjetu pivari u kojoj je veliki problem alkoholizam na radnom mjestu. Iz događaja koji slijede otkriva se da doktor primjenjuje svoj način liječenja pacijenata kako bi mogao da izrazi svoju, u suštini, despotsku i hipokritsku ličnost.

programme.title: Najbolje iz ATV jutra
programme.desc: The morning program of Alternative Television "ATV jutro" is a specific combination of information and entertainment. The first daily information, the first morning reports from the field throughout Republika Srpska, interesting contributions from the world of politics, culture and sports, dedicated to people and interesting events. / Jutarnji program Alternativne televizije "ATV jutro" specifičan je spoj informative i zabave. Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Bistra voda
programme.desc: The story of two once close friends, Aleksandar and Arsen, who unexpectedly meet in Skopje after 45 years. Years of betrayal and separation have left deep traces, and the meeting awakens memories, emotions and hope for reconciliation. / Priča o dva nekada bliska prijatelja, Aleksandru i Arsenu, koji se nakon 45 godina neočekivano sreću u Skoplju. programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: The nation is a witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. Despite numerous conflicts, their unwanted marriage gives birth to a strong love. / Priča o Dilan i Baranu, dvoje mladih ljudi koji su prisiljeni uploviti u bračnu luku. Unatoč brojnim sukobima, njihov neželjeni brak iznjedriće snažnu ljubav.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Centar dana
programme.desc: An infotainment show that listens to the most current social topics and events that we comment on with guests from all social spheres. We bring viewers interesting things from the world of entertainment, culture, and art, and we often have regional stars as guests. The show is edited and hosted by Dragana Božić and Milica Nogo. / Infotaiment emisija koja osluškuje najaktuelnije društvene teme i događaje koje komentarišemo sa gostima iz svih društenih sfera. Gledaocima donosimo zanimljivosti iz sveta zabave, kulture, i umjetnosti, a često su nam u gostima i regionalne zvijezde. Emisiju uređuju i vode Dragana Božić i Milica Nogo.

programme.title: Svijet poljoprivrede
programme.desc: Poljoprivredna emisija dugogodišnje tradicije i autorski projekat urednika i voditelja Dejana Jovanovića donosi provjerene informacije znanja i iskustva koja interesuju svakog poljoprivrednika.

programme.title: Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: In the mix zone / U mix zoni
programme.desc: In the mix zone / U mix zoni

programme.title: Agrar
programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. To those who want to learn something new and useful, they want to improve production and increase yields. / Emisija je posvećena poljoprivrednicima, ali i onima koji žive u urbanim sredinama, imaju baštu, vrt, voćnjak, plastenik. Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? We find the first traces of boxing already in the third century BC on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxing were established in the 18th century in London and define the fighting area, equipment and illegal and allowed types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Martial arts - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. programme.title: MMA UFC 12
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. programme.title: KIK-BOKS Trofej Beograda
programme.desc: Kickboxing is practiced as a form of self-defense, regular maintenance of body shape or as a martial sport. Kickboxing as a modern martial sport that includes several sports disciplines, These are Semi contact (Semi contact), "Light contact", "Full contact", Low kick, Thai kickboxing, musical forms and Aero kickboxing. The beginnings of this martial art date back to the 60s of the 20th century in Japan, while kickboxing became popular in Europe and North America ten years later. Maximum protective equipment is used, which consists of a helmet, mouth guard, chest guard (women), genital guard, gloves, shin guards and slippers. / Kikboks se praktikuje kao vrsta samoobrane, redovno održavanje telesne forme ili kao borilački sport. Kikboks kao moderan borilački sport koji obuhvata više sportskih disciplina, To su Semi kontakt (Polu kontakt), "Light contact" (Lagani kontakt), "Full contact" (Puni kontakt), Lou kik, Taj kikboks, muzičke forme i Aero kikboks. Početci ove borilačke veštine datiraju još iz 60ih godina 20. veka u Japanu, dok se u Evropi i Severnoj Americi kikboks popularizovao deset godina kasnije. Koristi se maksimalna zaštitna oprema koja se sastoji od kacige, štitnika za zube, štitnika za prsa (žene), štitnika za genitalije, rukavica, štitnika za potkolenice te papuča.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: Follow exciting duels in martial arts organized by the UFC. This association was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Las Vegas. / Pratite uzbudljive duele u borilačkim veštinama u organizaciji UFC-a. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine, a sedište im je u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 14
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - England 2nd league / Fudbal - Engleska 2. liga
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multimillion-dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity sits the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams fighting for the sacred goal of entering the Premiership. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svijetla medijske popularnosti smjestio se Championship, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. Novi milenijum je obeležio klub iz Bazela sa višestrukim uzastopnim titulama prvaka i jako dobrim rezultatima u Ligi šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. Novi milenijum je obeležio klub iz Bazela sa višestrukim uzastopnim titulama prvaka i jako dobrim rezultatima u Ligi šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football Qualifications for WC 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred members of the world football organization FIFA compete in the qualifications for the main tournament of the world football championship. These long and especially tense qualifications differ depending on the continental confederation. But what they all have in common is that they are a real prelude to the final tournament, given the very high stakes they are playing for. The significance of the qualifications is added by the fact that no one except the hosts has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must also confirm their visas in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.
