programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The Italian Serie A is a professional football competition with 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since it was founded in 1929, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the decline of the financial power of the Italian first league teams and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly dropped in quality, but it is returning to its rightful place with sure steps. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish League / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish League / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcjenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football - Scottish Premiership / Fudbal - Škotski Premiership
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship started its first season in 1890, and even then a rarity was established. The two teams then shared the championship title due to the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today's world-famous Glasgow Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles, and today's relatively unknown Dumbarton club. The league itself has changed names and format on a couple of occasions over the years, but since 2013 it is officially called the "Scottish Professional Football League" and is the highest level of Scottish football. The league is also marked by one of the biggest derbies in football history between two Glasgow teams, Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podijelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svjetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata mijenjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove "Scottish Professional Football League" i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obilježava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. programme.title: American football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams of the conference each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za djecu i omladinu na ovim prostorima čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: The "Natonal Hockey League" is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular part, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish League / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - England 2nd league / Fudbal - Engleska 2. liga
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multimillion-dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity sits the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams fighting for the sacred goal of entering the Premiership. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svijetla medijske popularnosti smjestio se Championship, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first Polish football league was founded in 1927, and the league is organized by the Polish Football Association (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of Polish champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - 2nd Spanish League / Fudbal - 2. španska liga
programme.desc: Founded in 1929, Segunda is the second largest league in Spain. There are a total of 22 teams fighting for entry into Primera, the first Spanish football league. The two first-placed teams of Segunda win a direct promotion to the top, while the third-placed team can win its place in Primera through the play-off. Uncertain matches and a high level of football quality and the technical aspect of the game make Segunda a highly media-covered competition. / Osnovana 1929. godine, Segunda je druga liga po veličini u Španiji. Ukupno broji 22 ekipe koje se bore za ulazak u Primeru, prvu špansku fudbalsku ligu. Dve prvoplasirane ekipe Segunde osvajaju direktan plasman gore dok trećeplasirani kroz baraž može izboriti svoje mjesto u Primeri. Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football - Argentinian League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league is Argentina. It was back in 1891, and only teams from Buenos Aires and Rosario had the right to perform. In 1931, when 18 clubs moved from the amateur to the professional ranks, the Argentinian league got the forerunner of its current version. Since 2014, the league has 30 teams that fight for the title of champion of Argentina in a single-round system. The legendary River Plate from Buenos Aires has the most titles, but it is closely followed by its biggest rival, Boca Juniors. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first football league of Poland was founded in 1927. This league is organized by the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league. The champion directly wins the title of Polish champion. The number of teams changed over the years, 18 participated in the 90s, and only 10 in the 30s. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu, osnovana je 1927. godine. Ovu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno, u ligi učestvuje 16 ekipa. Prvak direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona. Broj ekipa se sa godinama menjao, 90-ih učestvovalo ih je 18, a 30-ih samo 10.

programme.title: Fudbal - Championship
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multi-million dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity lies the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams fighting for the holy goal, entering the Premiership. The specialty of the Championship is that, with an average attendance of about 15,000 people, it is the second most watched league in the world. For real football fans, it is a must stop for sports weekend entertainment. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svetla medijske popularnosti smestio se Čempionšip, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premieršip. Posebnost Čempionšipa je i u tome što je sa prosečnom posećenošću od oko 15000 ljudi najgledanija druga liga na svetu. Pravim ljubiteljima fudbala nezaobilazna je stanica sportske vikend razonode.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. programme.title: Football - Swiss league / Fudbal - Švajcarska liga
programme.desc: The Swiss league is one of the longest-running leagues in Europe, the first season of which started back in the 20th century, i.e. from 1897. Since 2003, the league has been played according to the system of ten teams, where each team plays four games, two at home and two away. After 36 rounds, the last team leaves the elite rank of Swiss football and is relegated to the second Swiss league. The team with the most titles is Grasshopper Club Zurich with 27, of which 19 are in the professional period. The new millennium was marked by the club from Basel with multiple consecutive championship titles and very good results in the Champions League. / Švajcarska liga je jedna od najdugovječnijih liga u Evropi čija je prva sezona krenula još u 20. veku odnosno od 1897. godine. Liga se od 2003. igra po sistemu deset ekipa gde svaki igra sa svakim četiri utakmice po dve kući i dve u gostima. Poslednja ekipa nakon 36 kola napušta elitni rang švajvarskog fudbala i ispada u drugu švajcarsku ligu. Ekipa sa najviše titula je Grasshopper Club Zurich sa 27, od kojih su 19 u razdoblju profesionalizma. programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the "Greens" have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali "Zeleni" na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian league / Košarka - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The long history of the Italian "Lega Basket Serie A" dates back to 1920 and its collapse. The first winner was the team from Kostana in the same year, 1920. This league is of great importance for European club basketball as a league that has given over 35 titles to its clubs in European competitions, starting with the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saporta Cup and the Radivoje Korac Cup. The competition itself consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents in a round robin, followed by an eight-team playoff. The elimination games are played on the best of four games out of seven, or "Best of seven" in English terminology. / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske "Lega Basket Serie A" datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija "Best of seven".

It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Francuske (M)
programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Onofre tells the village that Olivia likes the priest Tenorio. Isadora sees Olívia kissing Rafael and goes crazy with jealousy. Olívia asks Rafael to pretend to be wooing her to help her get rid of the rumors about Reverend Tenorio. Rafael agrees because he knows it affects Isadora. Leônidas manages to get Matias out of the sanatorium and brings him back to the estate. Violeta is sad about Matias' situation. She is supported by Eugenio who ruins the romantic dinner that Úrsula is preparing for him. Olívia and Onofre have disagreements within the factory. Olívia is changing shifts. Isadora cannot hide Rafael's jealousy. Rafael disguises himself, goes to the club and steals Joaquim's car. Julinha was fired from the LBA. Violeta questions Rafael about their relationship and he confesses to her that he loves Isadora. / Onofre govori po selu da se Oliviji sviđa svećenik Tenorio. Isadora vidi kako Olívia ljubi Rafaela i poludi od ljubomore. Olívia zamoli Rafaela da odglumi da joj se udvara kako bi joj pomogao da se riješi glasina o velečasnom Tenoriju. Rafael pristaje jer zna da to utječe na Isadoru. Leônidas uspije odvesti Matiasa iz sanatorija i vraća ga na imanje. Violeta je tužna zbog Matiasove situacije. Podupire ju Eugenio koji uništi romantičnu večeru koju Úrsula priprema za njega. Olívia i Onofre imaju nesuglasice unutar tvornice. Olívia mijenja smjenu. Isadora ne može sakriti Rafaelovu ljubomoru. Rafael se maskira, ode u klub i ukrade Joaquimov auto. Julinha je otpuštena iz LBA. Violeta ispituje Rafaela o njihovoj vezi i on joj prizna da voli Isadoru.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Tiago is sad as Cacau explains to him that Regina wanted to distance him from Marquinho, thinking that Marco was a better man for her. Júlia tells Quim that she won't feel sorry for Regina if she miscarries, given her behavior towards Cacao. Jaime tries to defend Regina, but the others disagree with him. Anita suggests doing a DNA test and everyone agrees. / Tiago je tužan dok mu Cacau objašnjava da ga je Regina htjela udaljiti od Marquinha, misleći da je Marco bolji muškarac za nju. Júlia kaže Quimu da neće žaliti Reginu ako pobaci, s obzirom na njezino ponašanje prema Cacau. Jaime pokuša obraniti Reginu, ali drugi se ne slažu s njim. Anita predloži da napravi DNK test i svi se slože.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: Our guest is Pero Galić, a recognizable voice of the domestic music scene who, after more than thirty years of career in the band Opća pašnja, is starting a new musical chapter. We also have a woman who has conquered the oceans, pushes the limits of endurance and achieves what seems impossible to many. After returning from the American adventure, the guest of the show is distance swimmer Dina Levačić. What is the future of Poljud Stadium, a symbol of Split, Hajduk and Croatian architecture? Our Ivan Dorian Molnar talks about this topic with the architect, professor Nenad Fabijanić, the copyright protector of that unique stadium. / U goste nam dolazi Pero Galić, prepoznatljiv glas domaće glazbene scene koji, nakon više od trideset godina karijere u bendu Opća opasnost, započinje novo glazbeno poglavlje. Stiže nam i žena koja je pokorila oceane, pomiče granice izdržljivosti i ostvaruje ono što se mnogima čini nemogućim. Nakon povratka s američke avanture, gošća emisije je daljinska plivačica Dina Levačić. Kakva je budućnost stadiona Poljud, simbola Splita, Hajduka i hrvatske arhitekture? O toj temi naš Ivan Dorian Molnar razgovara s arhitektom, profesorom Nenadom Fabijanićem, zaštitnikom autorskih prava tog jedinstvenog stadiona.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Parkways are made for walks, and walks are made for conversations, closeness, togetherness in discovering blooming magnolias, leaves carried by the wind, changing seasons, nature that seems to want to escape from the cities, and they, on the contrary, try to keep it, place it among the houses, preserve it somewhere in sight. Therefore, gardens are arranged. There are several of them in the center of Zagreb, so in this walk, which is also suitable for those who are not inclined to long walks, we will visit some that are particularly dear to us and some that we wanted to see again after a long time. / Perivoji su stvoreni za šetnje, a šetnje su stvorene za razgovore, bliskost, zajedništvo u otkrivanju procvjetale magnolije, lista nošena vjetrom, mijene godišnjih doba, prirode koja kao da želi pobjeći iz gradova, a oni je, naprotiv, pokušavaju zadržati, smjestiti među kuće, sačuvati negdje u vidokrugu. Stoga, uređuju se perivoji. U užem središtu Zagreba smjestilo ih se nekoliko pa ćemo i mi, u ovoj šetnji prikladnoj i za one nesklone dugom pješačenju, obići neke koji su nam osobito dragi i neke koje smo nakon mnogo vremena poželjeli ponovno vidjeti.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the show Dr. Beck we are talking about alopecia. This is hair loss, i.e. loss of hair from the head, and in more severe cases, loss of all body hair. The causes of alopecia are various, from endocrine disorders to stress and systemic diseases. In the show, we talk about the causes, symptoms and methods of treatment, as well as why hair loss causes serious stress in many people and how to deal with it. Actor Asim Ugljen will share his experience with alopecia. / U emisiji Dr. Beck govorimo o alopeciji. To je opadanje kose odnosno gubitak dlaka s glave a u težim slučajevima i gubitak svih tjelesnih dlaka. Uzroci alopecije su razni, od endokrinih poremećaja do stresa i sistemskih bolesti. U emisiji govorimo o uzrocima, simptomima i načinima liječenja te o tome zašto gubitak kose kod mnogih izaziva ozbiljan stres i kako se nositi s njim. Svoje iskustvo s alopecijom podijelit će glumac Asim Ugljen.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia wants everyone to enjoy cooking. Her Spicy Pork Chops with Broccoli are baked together so dinner is ready in no time. Lidia will teach grandson Miles that he can prepare a simple weekday meal from leftover soup. Dessert will be crescents stuffed with apricot jam, which are a Bastianich household favorite. In this sequel, discover the joy of preparing dinner. / Lidia želi da svi uživaju u kuhanju. Njezini pikantni svinjski kotleti s brokulom zajedno se ispeku pa večera bude začas gotova. Lidia će naučiti unuka Milesa da od ostatka juhe može pripremiti jednostavno jelo na radni dan. Desert će biti polumjeseci nadjeveni pekmezom od marelica, koji su omiljeni u kućanstvu Bastianich. U ovom nastavku otkrijte užitak pripreme večere.

programme.desc: Edukativna tjedna emisija Hrvatskog autokluba donosi reportaže, kratke savjete i zanimljivosti o cestovnom prometu i povećanju sigurnosti.

programme.title: Word and life / Riječ i život
programme.desc: The peace agreement between Israel and Hamas offers some kind of hope to the residents of Gaza, but also to everyone living in the immediate vicinity, that a more peaceful life is ahead of them. What is the role of the Catholic Church, especially Vatican diplomacy, how crucial was American President Donald Trump in the peace process and what are the perspectives of interreligious dialogue, foreign policy analyst Mate Mijić talks in the show. / Mirovni sporazum između Izraela i Hamasa pruža kakvu takvu nadu stanovnicima Gaze, ali i svima koji žive u neposrednoj blizini, da je pred njima mirniji život. Koja je uloga Katoličke Crkve, pogotovo vatikanske diplomacije, koliko je u mirovnom procesu bio presudan američki predsjednik Donald Trump te koje su perspektive međureligijskog dijaloga, u emisiji govori vanjskopolitički analitičar Mate Mijić.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: In this sequel, Lidia will prepare food that she likes to share with others. First we will see the pork guazzetto with beans. Rustic ribs stewed with white beans are a complete meal. And if you want a quick and impressive dish for a hungry crowd, Lidia's brudet of mixed fish alla Matalotta is ideal for you. Lidia will prepare enough food for everyone today. / U ovom će nastavku Lidia pripremati hranu koju voli dijeliti s drugima. Najprije ćemo vidjeti guazzetto od svinjetine s grahom. Rustikalna rebarca pirjana s bijelim grahom cjelovit su obrok. A ako želite brzinsko, a dojmljivo jelo za gladnu gomilu, za vas je idealan Lidijin brudet od miješane ribe alla Matalotta. Lidia će danas pripremati dovoljno hrane za sve.

programme.title: Normalan život
programme.desc: After the show dedicated to World Mental Health Day and suicide prevention, especially among adolescents, we continue with the topic "Social work and mental health", which was also the central topic of the 14th conference of social workers, recently held in Vodice. The guests of the show are: Štefica Karačić, B.Sc. soc. worker, president of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and member of the Board of Directors of the Croatian Chamber of Social Workers, Ph.D. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, B.Sc. soc. worker, member of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and the Association's Ethics Committee, advocate and initiator of the Zagreb Strategy for Equalizing Opportunities for People with Disabilities. Guests will speak about prevention and protection of mental health, especially in at-risk and vulnerable groups. As many as 20% of people with disabilities have impaired mental health _ guests will testify about invisible barriers, stigmatization and social exclusion of the poor, elderly and infirm and people with intellectual disabilities. They will especially emphasize the role of social support in improving mental health, especially in the mourning process, and the importance of interdisciplinary cooperation between institutions. In the context of the digital age, we will also discuss the need to reduce administrative barriers, in order to help people in need in a timely and efficient manner. / Nakon emisije posvećene Svjetskom danu mentalnog zdravlja i prevenciji suicida, osobito među adolescentima, nastavljamo s temom "Socijalni rad i mentalno zdravlje", koja je ujedno bila središnja tema 14. konferencije socijalnih radnika, nedavno održane u Vodicama. Gošće emisije su: Štefica Karačić, dipl. soc. radnica, predsjednica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i članica Upravnog odbora Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika dr. sc. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, dipl. soc. radnica, članica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i Etičkog povjerenstva Udruge, zagovarateljica i pokretačica Zagrebačke strategije izjednačavanja mogućnosti za osobe s invaliditetom Gošće će govoriti o prevenciji i zaštiti mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u rizičnih i ranjivih skupina. Čak 20 % osoba s invaliditetom ima narušeno mentalno zdravlje _ gošće će svjedočiti o nevidljivim barijerama, stigmatizaciji i socijalnoj isključenosti siromašnih, starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s intelektualnim teškoćama.Posebno će istaknuti ulogu socijalne podrške u poboljšanju mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u procesu žalovanja, te značaj interdisciplinarne suradnje među institucijama. U kontekstu digitalnog doba, razgovarat ćemo i o potrebi smanjenja administrativnih barijera, kako bi se pravovremeno i učinkovito pomoglo osobama u potrebi.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Lalá hides that it bothers her that Simone wants to use Valdemar to protect herself from legal problems. Salomao suggests that they press charges against Marco and Regina for Marquinho's kidnapping, but Cacau does not want to make such a move against his mother. Majoris tells Sal that she never witnessed anything inappropriate between Simone and Rui. / Lalá skriva da joj smeta što Simone želi iskoristiti Valdemara kako bi zaštitila sebe od pravnih problema. Salomao predlaže da podignu tužbu protiv Marca i Regine zbog Marquinhove otmice, ali Cacau ne želi povući takav potez protiv majke. Majoris kaže Sal da nikad nije svjedočila ničem neprimjerenom između Simone i Ruija.
