programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. And we should remember that we have the strength, patience and passion to reach for the stars and change the world..." _ Harriet Tubman's words. But even if you don't change the world by following your dreams, you will most certainly change your own life! And in today's show we hang out with people who have made it happen! So never forget that all our dreams can only come true if we have the courage to follow them... But _ JUST EASY! / Svaki veliki san počinje sanjarem. I treba zapamtiti kako u sebi imamo snagu, strpljenje i strast da dosegnemo zvijezde i promijenimo svijet..." _ riječi su Harriet Tubman. Ali čak i ako ne promijenite svijet, slijedeći snove, posve ćete sigurno promijeniti vlastiti život! A u današnjoj se emisiji družimo s ljudima koji su to i ostvarili! Zato nikada ne zaboravite kako se svi naši snovi mogu ostvariti samo ako ih imamo hrabrosti slijediti... Ali _ SAMO LAGANO!

programme.title: Stadion
programme.desc: Weekly overview of the strongest European football leagues, as well as smaller national championships, and other current sports topics. / Tjedni pregled najjačih europskih nogometnih liga, kao i manjih nacionalnih prvenstava, te druge aktualne sportske teme.

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Every week, the show for car enthusiasts presents new car models, technological innovations, tests new vehicles, and provides advice on maintenance. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Moj put
programme.desc: It is incredible how much strength, positive energy and perseverance is hidden in Gordana Glass, a fragile and ethereal woman from Zagreb, resident of the Slovak capital Bratislava since 1998. Her path to international success was long and often not easy. From her workshop, fascinating works of art, often weighing hundreds of kilograms, leave the world. Gordana is a proud mother of two adult sons, a woman ready to share a good word with the needy and beautify their living space with her works. She built her family and business nest in Lamač, a suburb of Bratislava, which was settled by her compatriots about five hundred years ago. It was one of about a hundred majority Croatian villages at the time. Today, only four remain: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo and Devinska Nova Vas. The latter has been the host of the Festival of Croatian Culture for 36 years in memory of the centuries-old tradition and history of Croats in that area. Exposed to assimilation more strongly than ever before, they try to say that they still preserve their customs and language. The natives of Devinska Nova Vasa still remember how the fanfare announced the first festival. It symbolically stimulated the awakening of the Croatian community there, which had been somewhat forgotten until then. It was in June 1989, on the eve of the "velvet revolution" that marked the end of the era of political unanimity. Thanks to the courage and sacrifice of many generations, the festival evokes memories of ancient Croatian ancestors. Mostly tough, hard-working and hard-working people, they inherited their peculiarities from the past, the specific Chakavian-Ikavian version of the Croatian Gradišća dialect, songs, costumes, and traditional dishes. / Nevjerojatno je koliko se snage, pozitivne energije i upornosti krije u Gordani Glass, krhkoj i eteričnoj Zagrepčanki, od 1998. stanovnici glavnoga slovačkog grada Bratislave. Dug je i nerijetko ne baš lagodan bio njezin put do međunarodnog uspjeha. Iz njezine radionice u svijet odlaze fascinantna umjetnička djela mahom teška i stotine kilograma. Gordana je majka dvojici odraslih sinova, žena spremna podijeliti s potrebitima lijepu riječ i svojim radovima uljepšati im životni prostor. Svoje obiteljsko-poslovno gnijezdo savila je u Lamaču, predgrađu Bratislave, koje su prije petstotinjak godina naselili njezini sunarodnjaci. Bilo je to jedno od stotinjak tada većinskih hrvatskih sela. Danas su ostala tek četiri: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo i Devinska Nova Vas. Upravo ovo potonje već 36 godina u spomen na stoljetnu tradiciju i povijest Hrvata na tom prostoru domaćin je Festivala hrvatske kulture. Izloženi asimilaciji snažnije nego ikada prije, nastoje poručiti da još čuvaju svoje običaje i jezik. Starosjedioci Devinske Nove Vasi još pamte kako su fanfare najavile prvi festival. Njime je simbolično potaknuto buđenje tamošnje, dotad pomalo zaboravljene, hrvatske zajednice. Bilo je to u lipnju 1989., uoči "baršunaste revolucije" koja je označila kraj epohe političkog jednoumlja. Zahvaljujući hrabrosti i požrtvovnosti mnogih naraštaja, festival priziva sjećanja na davne hrvatske pretke. Mahom težaci, radišni i vrijedni ljudi baštinili su od prošlosti svoje posebnosti, specifičnu čakavsko-ikavsku inačicu hrvatskog gradišćanskog narječja, napjeve, nošnje, tradicionalna jela.

programme.title: Zadar: Sea / Zadar: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative show dedicated to the wealth of our Adriatic Sea, coast and coastline. It brings interesting reports on topics related to life at sea and by it. It is broadcast from HRT's studios in Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: This week Ben will spend practically at home. In rural Oxfordshire, he will be the guest of an extended family who have given up their conventional lifestyle and moved to a 16-acre property. Ben will find out what obstacles they faced, how they spent twenty years perfecting the skills of cultivating the land on which eleven family members live today. They will also discover how the Muslim faith affects their approach to agriculture. As their guest, Ben will take care of sheep, take care of hooves, drive a tractor, feed thousands of chickens... He will realize that it is possible to live in the homeland as well as in the isolated wilderness, and learn that the future of this rural idyll is in doubt. / Ovaj tjedan Ben će provesti praktički kod kuće. U ruralnom Oxfordshireu bit će gost proširene obitelji koja se odrekla konvencionalnog načina života i preselila na posjed površine 16 hektara. Ben će saznati s kakvim su se preprekama susretali, kako su dvadeset godina usavršavali vještine obrade zemlje na kojoj danas živi jedanaest članova obitelji. Otkrit će i kako muslimanska vjera utječe na njihov pristup poljoprivredi. Kao njihov gost, Ben će čuvati ovce, njegovati papke, voziti traktor, hraniti tisuće kokoši... Shvatit će da se i u zavičaju može živjeti kao i u izoliranoj divljini te saznati da je budućnost ove seoske idile pod upitnikom.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: All life needs water to survive. But water is not always available and animal parents have to adapt to this issue without question. Dedication, perseverance and sheer courage are key to success in the freshwater world. In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of turtles must predict the timing of the seasonal rains before laying their eggs. If they get it wrong, their young will drown underground, but if they get it right, it will be the start of one of the greatest spectacles on Earth as thousands of baby turtles follow their mothers' call to the water. In Namibia, watering holes provide a reliable source for the desert life of male South African saja. He must choose wisely the moment of decision in which to take water for his birds. If he makes a mistake in one second, he will end up in the claws of a predator. Some animal parents try to turn the power of water to their advantage. In the Caribbean, a flounder called a tri-tri diverts an underwater current to supply oxygen to its eggs. But before the eggs are laid, a once-in-a-lifetime storm sweeps him and everything he's made downstream. You have to make it over three hundred meters of waterfalls to get another chance for parenthood. In the wetlands of Florida, the clever swamp canary uses the power of its bite to pull its young out of danger in a matter of seconds. For some, it seems that the search for water never ends. In drought-stricken Kenya, an elephant and her family must share the remaining water with humans until the rains begin. And when it rains, the water is so violent that it can become deadly. With climate change, the movement of fresh water is increasingly difficult to predict. Humans and wildlife are adapting to changing freshwater flows, but we may choose to give the next generation a future where freshwater is a more reliable factor. / Sav život treba vodu da bi opstao. No voda nije stalno dostupna i roditelji životinja moraju se bespogovorno prilagođavati tom pitanju. Predanost, ustrajnost i puka hrabrost ključni su za uspjeh u slatkovodnom svijetu. U brazilskoj Amazoniji tisuće kornjača moraju predvidjeti vrijeme sezonskih kiša prije nego što polože jaja. Ako pogriješe, njihov će se pomladak utopiti pod zemljom, ali ako dobro pogode, bit će to početak jednog od najvećih spektakala na Zemlji jer tisuće mladunaca kornjača slijede poziv svojih majki u vodu. U Namibiji pojilišta pružaju pouzdan izvor za pustinjski život mužjaka južnoafričke sadže. Mora mudro odabrati trenutak odluke u kojem će uzeti vodu za svoje ptiće. Pogriješi li za jednu sekundu, završit će u pandžama grabljivice. Neki životinjski roditelji pokušavaju okrenuti snagu vode u svoju korist. Na Karibima, glavoč zvan tri-tri skreće podvodnu struju za dovod kisika svojim jajašcima. No prije nego što su jajašca i položena, oluja koja se događa jednom u životu odnese nizvodno i njega i sve što je izradio. Mora se uspeti preko tristo metara slapova da bi dobio još jednu priliku za roditeljstvo. U močvarnim staništima Floride pametni močvarni kanarinac koristi se snagom zalogaja da izvuče svoju mladunce iz ralja opasnosti u trenutku kad je sve pitanje sekundi. Nekima se čini da potraga za vodom nikad ne prestaje. U sušom pogođenoj Keniji slonica i njezina obitelj moraju dijeliti preostalu vodu s ljudima dok ne počnu kiše. A kad kiša padne, voda je toliko silovita da može postati smrtonosna. Promjenom klime kretanja slatke vode sve je teže predvidjeti. Ljudi i divlje životinje prilagođavaju se promjenjivim slatkovodnim tokovima, ali možda odlučimo pružiti sljedećem naraštaju budućnost u kojoj će slatka voda biti pouzdaniji čimbenik.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: The film follows Mamie Till-Mobley, the mother of 14-year-old Emmett Till, who was brutally murdered in Mississippi in 1955 for allegedly making inappropriate comments to a white woman. Seeking justice for her son, she confronts racism, and her determination to ensure that Emmett's death does not go unnoticed has encouraged the general public and the media to become more seriously involved in the fight against racial injustice. / Film prati Mamie Till-Mobley, majku 14-togodišnjeg Emmetta Tilla, koji je brutalno ubijen u Mississippiju 1955. zbog optužbi da je neprimjereno komentirao bijelu ženu. Tražeći pravdu za sina, suprotstavlja se rasizmu, a njezina odlučnost da Emmettova smrt ne ostane neprimijećena potaknula je širu javnost i medije da se ozbiljnije uključe u borbu protiv rasne nepravde.

programme.title: Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: The trial that everyone has been waiting for with impatience begins. As the prosecution tries to prove beyond doubt that Talitha and Dhillon killed Hanna Ellis together, Cleo tries to undermine the credibility of the evidence against Talitha. Lucinda Bright's testimony hurts Dhillon. Tension rises in the courtroom as Cleo and Damian clash over whether to call Talitha as a witness. / Počinje suđenje koje su svi s nestrpljenjem iščekivali. Dok tužiteljstvo nastoji nepobitno dokazati da su Talitha i Dhillon zajedno ubili Hannu Ellis, Cleo pokušava umanjiti vjerodostojnost dokaza protiv Talithe. Svjedočenje Lucinde Bright našteti Dhillonu. Napetost u sudnici raste, a Cleo i Damian sukobe se oko toga trebaju li pozvati Talithu kao svjedoka.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: A smart young student is found dead in a hotel room, and detectives Hathaway and Lewis are drawn into a world of intrigue and ambition that stops short of anything. It is about Jo Gilchirst, one of the three students at Oxford who decided to succeed in life. The case, which contains elements of dangerous sexual politics, will force Lewis to face his own past and to convince himself that in today's world, personal advancement is very often much more important than friendship. / Pametna mlada studentica nađena je mrtva u hotelskoj sobi, a detektivi Hathaway i Lewis uvučeni su u svijet spletki i ambicije koja ne preže ni pred čime. Riječ je o Jo Gilchirst, jednoj od tri studentice na Oxfordu koje su pošto-poto odlučile uspjeti u životu. programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica's due date is approaching, but she has had enough of pregnancy and wants to go on one last trip together before the baby is born. Adam and Barry don't know what is expected of them as uncles, so they decide to follow the advice from the movie Uncle Buck. / Erici se bliži termin poroda, no već joj je dosta trudnoće i želi otići na posljednje putovanje udvoje prije rođenja djeteta. Adam i Barry ne znaju što se očekuje od njih kao ujaka pa odluče poslušati savjete iz filma "Striko Buck".

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam decides to visit Dave Kim at New York University to celebrate Halloween together, but discovers that his best friend has changed drastically. Geoff resents Beverly taking care of the baby, resulting in many comical and terrifying situations! / Adam odlučuje posjetiti Davea Kima na Sveučilištu u New Yorku kako bi skupa proslavili Noć vještica, no otkriva da se njegov najbolji prijatelj stubokom promijenio. Geoff negoduje što je Beverly preuzela brigu o bebi, iz čega proizlaze mnoge komične, ali i zastrašujuće situacije!

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: We are hosting the renowned composer of theater and film music Ozren K. Glaser, the man who composed the music for the film "The Woman I Read About". The reason for the conversation was a recent concert by Vatroslav Lisinski, the first author's concert of that young, successful composer, with 200 musicians on stage. The concert called "Achilles' song" is music for a film that was not made. What that film would be like, what are the dreams of that young successful composer, whose first author's concert was attended by many people from Zagreb, as well as music film Oscar winners, find out in today's ART. / Ugošćujemo uglednog skladatelja kazališne i filmske glazbe Ozrena K. Glasera, čovjeka koji je skladao glazbu za film "Žena kojoj sam čitao". Povod razgovoru je nedavno održan koncert u KD Vatroslava Lisinskog, prvi autorski koncert tog mladog, uspješnog skladatelja, s 200 glazbenika na pozornici. Koncert pod nazivom "Ahilejeva pjesma" glazba je za film koji nije snimljen. Kakav bi bio taj film, kakvi su snovi toga mladog uspješnog skladatelja, kojem su na prvi autorski koncert uz brojne Zagrepčane došli i glazbeni filmski oskarovci, otkrijte u današnjem ART-u.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly embraces her new role as a grandmother, but tries to stay young at heart. Adam gets a job while waiting to start his studies. / Beverly prihvaća svoju novu ulogu bake, no pokušava ostati mlada u srcu. Adam dobiva posao dok čeka da krene na studij.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam and Barry do everything in their power to make Thanksgiving go smoothly because they know how much it means to Beverly, but things go wrong. / Adam i Barry čine sve u svojoj moći kako bi Dan zahvalnosti protekao bez trzavica jer znaju koliko to znači Beverly, no stvari krenu po zlu.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: After almost escaping seven years ago, this episode's couple want to try again, and Ginny Buckley will help them move from the Surrey town to the area on the Norfolk/Suffolk border. Ginny will also meet someone who has already moved there and turned the thatched cottage into a charming postcard home. / Nakon što zamalo da im je uspjelo pobjeći prije sedam godina, par iz ove epizode želi pokušati ponovno, a Ginny Buckley će im pomoći da se presele iz grada u Surreyu u područje na granici Norfolka i Suffolka. Ginny će također upoznati nekoga tko se već preselio onamo i pretvorio kućicu sa slamnatim krovom u očaravajući dom s razglednica.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: A couple converts a military truck and an old camper trailer into an off-road vehicle. One man builds a luxury cabin on his family farm. And in Denmark, George will tour a container converted into a living space. / Par pretvara vojni kamion i staru kamp prikolicu u vozilo za terensku vožnju. Jedan čovjek gradi luksuznu kolibu na svojoj obiteljskoj farmi. A u Danskoj, George će razgledati kontejner pretvoren u prostor za stanovanje.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon's guide to cooking at home continues the theme of cooking for friends. Dishes that are great to share include grilled polenta with roasted tomatoes and fresh goat's cheese for an early lunch and impressive salt-crusted halibut for lunch. Gordon's son Jack will help him prepare a roast chicken stuffed with chickpeas and a fantastic layered dessert with hazelnuts and snow for dinner. / Gordonov vodič za kuhanje kod kuće nastavlja se temom kuhanja za prijatelje. Jela koja je sjajno dijeliti s drugima uključuju palentu s grila s pečenim rajčicama i kozjim svježim sirom za rani ručak i dojmljivu ribu kantara u korici od soli za ručak. Gordonov sin Jack pomoći će mu da za večeru pripremi pečeno pile nadjeveno slanutkom i fantastični slojeviti desert s lješnjacima i snijegom.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae are to choose the most beautiful gardens in Scotland and Northern Ireland this time. In the village of Inversek, they discover a garden that has been lovingly landscaped for more than 30 years. Despite its size and formality, this garden is playful and full of personality. In Magherafelt, Northern Ireland, there is another garden with a lovely story. The young amateur gardener started arranging the garden where he spent his childhood, and soon it grew into his life's work. Then, in Scotland's Tay, he will visit a terraced garden in an inhospitable location that requires great commitment. Above the famous Firth of Forth, they visit a spectacular garden, which is being arranged by the second generation. / Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae ovaj put trebaju odabrati najljepše vrtove u Škotskoj i Sjevernoj Irskoj. U selu Inverseku otkrivaju vrt koji je s mnogo ljubavi uređivan više od 30 godina. Unatoč svojoj veličini i formalnosti, ovaj je vrt razigran i pun osobnosti. U Magherafeltu u Sjevernoj Irskoj je još jedan vrt s ljupkom pričom. Mladi je vrtlar amater počeo uređivati vrt u kojem je proveo djetinjstvo, a ubrzo je prerastao u njegovo životno djelo. Zatim će u škotskom Tayju posjetiti terasasti vrt na negostoljubivom položaju za koji je potrebna velika predanost. Iznad poznatog zaljeva Firth of Forth posjećuju spektakularan vrt koji uređuje već drugi naraštaj.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel will prepare a celebratory meal in this episode. Inspired by a visit to the famous LOusta De Baumaniere, they will serve millefeuille with mussels in curry sauce, rich venison daube with zucchini puree, followed by princess donuts. / Michel će u ovoj epizodi pripremiti slavljenički obrok. Nadahnut posjetom poznatom LOustau De Baumaniereu, poslužit će millefeuille s dagnjama u umaku od curryja, bogati daube od divljači s pireom od tikvica nakon kojeg će poslužiti princes krafne.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: If it is true that today it is increasingly difficult, in terms of style, to answer the question "What is jazz?", this is not a reason for concern. On the contrary _ jazz should first of all be music that is constantly being redefined, which is perhaps best embodied by Miles Davis: music that slips away from you the next moment just when you thought you had caught it by the tail. More than a style, jazz is _ at least in theory _ an open house, where everyone is welcome. How long they stay in it, as musicians or listeners, depends on their openness to the unpredictable, especially that which arises from spontaneous interaction. In this sense, although it is sometimes perceived as narrow and exclusive, jazz is actually the music of a live meeting and collective experience _ either in joint music-making, or in front of an audience. The Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival is based on this idea, which combines a high-level music camp and a concert program in a special way. Workshops, get-togethers and masterclasses with mentors are held during the day, while the evenings are dedicated to public performances by distinguished guests and jam sessions in which all participants, through mutual musicianship, fuse different musical traditions and influences. The third edition of the festival, held from August 28 to 30, fully immersed in the atmosphere of the island, continued to build on the great foundations laid by vocalist Thana Alexa and Ponta Lopud Creative Platform Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. The concert program and mentoring team consisted of saxophonist Ben Wendel and vocalists Sofia Rey and Michael Mayo, together with members of their supporting ensembles. They conducted workshops, lectures and talks with a selected group of musicians from all over the world, including those from Croatia. Terri Lyne Carrington, multi-awarded drummer and Grammy winner, presided over the entire program as the main mentor and master of the festival. At the end of the day, the participants presented their intensive work to the Lopud audience, and that even a storm is not stronger than the spirit of jazz was shown by the successful relocation of part of the performance to the Duke's Palace in Lopud _ which, apart from its historical beauty, also showed how it fits perfectly with the liveliness of new, exciting music. / Ako je točno da je danas sve teže, u stilskom smislu, odgovoriti na pitanje "Što je jazz?", to nije razlog za zabrinutost. Naprotiv _ jazz bi prije svega trebao biti glazba koja se neprestano redefinira, što je možda najbolje utjelovio Miles Davis: glazba koja vam u sljedećem trenutku izmakne baš kad ste pomislili da ste je uhvatili za rep. Više od stila, jazz je _ barem u teoriji _ kuća otvorenih vrata, u koju su svi dobrodošli. Koliko će se u njoj zadržati, kao glazbenici ili slušatelji, ovisi o njihovoj otvorenosti prema nepredvidivom, osobito onom koje proizlazi iz spontane interakcije. U tom je smislu, premda ga se katkad doživljava zakučastim i isključivim, jazz zapravo glazba živog susreta i kolektivnog iskustva _ bilo u zajedničkom muziciranju, bilo pred publikom. Na toj ideji temelji se i Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, koji na poseban način spaja glazbeni kamp visoke razine i koncertni program. Tijekom dana održavaju se radionice, druženja i masterclassovi s mentorima, dok su večeri posvećene javnim nastupima uglednih gostiju i jam sessionima u kojima svi sudionici, kroz međusobno muziciranje, stapaju različite glazbene tradicije i utjecaje. Treće izdanje festivala, održano od 28. do 30. kolovoza, u potpunosti uronjeno u atmosferu otoka, nastavilo je graditi sjajne temelje koje su postavili vokalistica Thana Alexa i Kreativna platforma Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. Koncertni program i mentorski tim činili su saksofonist Ben Wendel te vokalisti Sofia Rey i Michael Mayo, zajedno s članovima svojih pratećih sastava. Vodili su radionice, predavanja i razgovore s odabranom skupinom glazbenika iz cijelog svijeta, uključujući i one iz Hrvatske. Cijelim je programom, kao glavna mentorica i master festivala, predsjedala Terri Lyne Carrington, višestruko nagrađivana bubnjarka i dobitnica Grammyja. Svoj su intenzivan rad sudionici na kraju dana predstavili lopudskoj publici, a da ni oluja nije jača od duha jazza, pokazalo je uspješno preseljenje dijela izvedbi u lopudski Knežev dvor _ koji je, osim svoje povijesne ljepote, pokazao i kako savršeno pristaje uz živost nove, uzbudljive glazbe.

programme.title: Zadržani nakon dolaska
programme.desc: Diego, an urban planner from Venezuela, and his partner Elena, a dancer from Barcelona, ​​arrive in the US to start a new life. However, at the immigration department of the airport, they are separated into a room for additional examination. A seemingly routine control turns into a grueling interrogation that exposes their secrets and puts their relationship to the test. / Diego, urbanist iz Venezuele, i njegova partnerica Elena, plesačica iz Barcelone, stižu u SAD kako bi započeli novi život. No, na imigracijskom odjelu zračne luke izdvajaju ih u prostoriju za dodatno ispitivanje. Naizgled rutinska kontrola pretvara se u iscrpljujuće ispitivanje koje razotkriva njihove tajne i stavlja na kušnju njihov odnos.

programme.title: Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: As part of the 11th Split Blues Festival, Croatian blues musicians from the homeland and diaspora held all-night concerts. Thus, on the same stage in Split's Đardin, Croatian blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, but also from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Čiovo, Zagreb, Hvar, Solin, Veliko Trgovišće... Performed: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking and Charlie And Bell Blues Experience, who are this year's winners of the Croatian Blues Challenge and representatives of Croatia at the world blues competition in Memphis. / U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking te Charlie And Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film "About people and stories" from the series "I'm telling you a story" is a very personal "story about a story" by director Mladen Santrić, and his last work / Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Institute for the Croatian Language: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković and Viktor Nenadić and Branimira Volf with the support of colleagues from the Web Department of HRT Iva Hren and Matka Švarca and Tomislav Mršić and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The fearsome team has taken the bus on a jumping trip, and the Moto dogs have to rescue them from the High Winding Mountain. // Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, where he is captured by the Scary Squad. Moto dogs embark on an epic rescue! / Strašna ekipa krenula je autobusom na skakanje, a Moto psići ih moraju spasiti s Visoke vijugave gore. // Chaseove mačje alergije odvedu ga u pustinju, gdje ga zarobi Strašna ekipa. Moto psići kreću u epsko spašavanje!

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he is given a special task that he cannot complete if he does not learn something about the daily activities in the zoo _ feeding, cleaning and arranging the housing, playing, training or treating the animals. In this episode, Marko was given the task of making a house for a milk snake. Before starting the task, you should find out how to adapt the spaces where the animals stay to their needs. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju,treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U ovoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti nastambu za mliječnu zmiju. Prije nego što krene na zadatak, treba doznati kako prostore u kojima borave životinje prilagoditi njihovim potrebama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Damir accidentally angers Maks when he doesn't explain the rules of the game to him properly. / Damir slučajno naljuti Maksa kad mu ne objasni pravila igre kako treba.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and petty mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoy and his friends, and each episode deals with a different theme. Cheerful sociables explore the world and learn new words and concepts through play. And he's having a good time along the way. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy decides to paint the perfect picture of Muc, but Muc doesn't want to cooperate. Can Tweedy adapt her perfect portrait to her imperfect and unpredictable pet? / Tvidi odluči naslikati savršenu Mucovu sliku, ali Muc ne želi surađivati. Može li Tvidi prilagoditi svoj savršen portret svome nesavršenom i nepredvidivom ljubimcu?

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: While setting up his new automatic feeder, Farmer Kaos is shocked to see his precious chickens trying to fly off the roof of the barn. He calls the Numbers to bring his chickens back to safety. In order to succeed in this, the team uses mathematical skills to figure out how to get the chickens to stop making a mess where they shouldn't. / Dok namješta svoj novi automatski stroj za hranjenje, Farmer Kaos šokira se kad ugleda da njegove dragocjene kokoši pokušavaju odletjeti s krova staje. Zove Brojčiće da vrate njegove kokoši na sigurno. Da bi u tome uspjeli, ekipa koristi matematičke vještine da bi odgonetnula kako da kokoši prestanu praviti zbrku gdje ne treba..

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The day after the big party, the whole of Slatkograd is a mess and that mess needs to be cleaned up! / Dan poslije velike zabave cijeli je Slatkograd u neredu i taj nered treba počistiti!

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Everyone is excited about the Snow Sports Day competition. / Svi su uzbuđeni zbog natjecanja povodom Dana snježnih sportova.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Blitz shows Vrck how to gather the dinosaurs, but the little dinosaur is overexcited and keeps scaring them instead of directing them. When the Dinoranchers discover that some parasaurs are lost in the High Forest, Vrcko can't wait to help and secretly sneaks in on their mission. When the Dinoranchers discover the hidden Vrcko, they tell him not to follow them, but Jon accidentally drops his dino whistle as he leaves, and Vrcko runs back into the forest to get it back. Deep in the misty forest, Vrcko finds Jon and returns his whistle so he can summon the parasaurs. When the moment comes to chase them back home, Jon and Blitz patiently allow Vrck to help them and see that the dinosaur has finally learned how not to scare the dinosaurs. All the Dinoranchers are glad they gave Vrck a second chance, because it turns out he just needed a little more practice. / Blitz pokazuje Vrcku kako okupiti dinosaure, ali mali dinosaur je preuzbuđen i neprestano ih plaši umjesto da ih usmjerava. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju da su se neki parasauri izgubili u Visokoj šumi, Vrcko jedva čeka pomoći i potajno se ušulja na njihov zadatak. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju skrivenog Vrcka, kažu mu da ne ide za njima, no Jon pri odlasku slučajno ispusti svoju dinozviždaljku, a Vrcko potrči natrag u šumu kako bi mu je vratio. Duboko u maglovitoj šumi, Vrcko pronalazi Jona i vraća mu zviždaljku kako bi mogao dozvati parasaure. Kad dođe trenutak da ih potjeraju natrag kući, Jon i Blitz strpljivo dopuste Vrcku da im pomogne i vide da je dinić napokon naučio kako ne uplašiti dinosaure. Svi Dinorančeri raduju se što su Vrcku dali drugu priliku, jer se ispostavilo da mu je trebalo samo malo više vježbe.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mehapomagači
programme.desc: The Martians send a giant chunk of ice to help cool down the Big City on a hot day, but the ice goes straight for a skyscraper! Meche must find a way to prevent the ice from destroying the city. / Marsovci šalju divovski komad leda kako bi pomogli da se Lijepi veliki grad ohladi za vrućeg dana, ali led ide ravno prema neboderu! Mehe trebaju naći način za spriječiti da led uništi grad.

programme.title: Topsy i Tim
programme.desc: Topsy and Tim is a live-action drama from children's television channel CBeebies, brought to you by BAFTA award-winning creators Darrall Macqueen. The series follows the everyday adventures of cheerful twins. / Topsy i Tim živa je akcijska drama dječjeg televizijskog kanala CBeebies koju donose dobitnici nagrade BAFTA, autori produkcijske kuće Darrall Macqueen. Serija prati svakidašnje pustolovine veselih blizanaca.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy decides to paint the perfect picture of Muc, but Muc doesn't want to cooperate. Can Tweedy adapt her perfect portrait to her imperfect and unpredictable pet? / Tvidi odluči naslikati savršenu Mucovu sliku, ali Muc ne želi surađivati. Može li Tvidi prilagoditi svoj savršen portret svome nesavršenom i nepredvidivom ljubimcu?

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: While setting up his new automatic feeder, Farmer Kaos is shocked to see his precious chickens trying to fly off the roof of the barn. He calls the Numbers to bring his chickens back to safety. In order to succeed in this, the team uses mathematical skills to figure out how to get the chickens to stop making a mess where they shouldn't. / Dok namješta svoj novi automatski stroj za hranjenje, Farmer Kaos šokira se kad ugleda da njegove dragocjene kokoši pokušavaju odletjeti s krova staje. Zove Brojčiće da vrate njegove kokoši na sigurno. Da bi u tome uspjeli, ekipa koristi matematičke vještine da bi odgonetnula kako da kokoši prestanu praviti zbrku gdje ne treba..

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo wants to know what happens to the characters of his favorite television show when the television is turned off. Fortunately, Noasaur has an idea how to find out. / Pablo želi znati što se događa s likovima njegove omiljene televizijske emisije kad se televizor isključi. Srećom, Noasaur ima ideju kako će to doznati.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Everyone is excited about the Snow Sports Day competition. / Svi su uzbuđeni zbog natjecanja povodom Dana snježnih sportova.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Winter came a little early and Mima did not finish all her preparations for the winter and snow season. Edmund and Luce do their best to help her. In the process, they discover how nature is preparing for a long cold winter. / Zima je malo uranila i Mima nije završila sve svoje pripreme za doba zime i snijega. Edmund i Luce daju sve od sebe kako bi joj pomogli. Tijekom toga, oni otkrivaju kako se priroda priprema za dugu hladnu zimu.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Blitz shows Vrck how to gather the dinosaurs, but the little dinosaur is overexcited and keeps scaring them instead of directing them. When the Dinoranchers discover that some parasaurs are lost in the High Forest, Vrcko can't wait to help and secretly sneaks in on their mission. When the Dinoranchers discover the hidden Vrcko, they tell him not to follow them, but Jon accidentally drops his dino whistle as he leaves, and Vrcko runs back into the forest to get it back. Deep in the misty forest, Vrcko finds Jon and returns his whistle so he can summon the parasaurs. When the moment comes to chase them back home, Jon and Blitz patiently allow Vrck to help them and see that the dinosaur has finally learned how not to scare the dinosaurs. All the Dinoranchers are glad they gave Vrck a second chance, because it turns out he just needed a little more practice. / Blitz pokazuje Vrcku kako okupiti dinosaure, ali mali dinosaur je preuzbuđen i neprestano ih plaši umjesto da ih usmjerava. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju da su se neki parasauri izgubili u Visokoj šumi, Vrcko jedva čeka pomoći i potajno se ušulja na njihov zadatak. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju skrivenog Vrcka, kažu mu da ne ide za njima, no Jon pri odlasku slučajno ispusti svoju dinozviždaljku, a Vrcko potrči natrag u šumu kako bi mu je vratio. Duboko u maglovitoj šumi, Vrcko pronalazi Jona i vraća mu zviždaljku kako bi mogao dozvati parasaure. Kad dođe trenutak da ih potjeraju natrag kući, Jon i Blitz strpljivo dopuste Vrcku da im pomogne i vide da je dinić napokon naučio kako ne uplašiti dinosaure. Svi Dinorančeri raduju se što su Vrcku dali drugu priliku, jer se ispostavilo da mu je trebalo samo malo više vježbe.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The fearsome team has taken the bus on a jumping trip, and the Moto dogs have to rescue them from the High Winding Mountain. // Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, where he is captured by the Scary Squad. Moto dogs embark on an epic rescue! / Strašna ekipa krenula je autobusom na skakanje, a Moto psići ih moraju spasiti s Visoke vijugave gore. // Chaseove mačje alergije odvedu ga u pustinju, gdje ga zarobi Strašna ekipa. Moto psići kreću u epsko spašavanje!

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Institute for the Croatian Language: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film "About people and stories" from the series "I'm telling you a story" is a very personal "story about a story" by director Mladen Santrić, and the last work of cinematographer Radovan Sredić. Inspired by the speech of the Nobel laureate Ivo Andrić, the author of the film sets out in search of the fate of the story today. Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras and Drago Grgić _ Godra lead us through the literary, filmic, artistic and musical aspects of their "stories". Although they are generations apart, they all have in common that they do not live on stories, but they could not live without them. / Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad snimatelja Radovana Sredića. Inspiriran govorom nobelovca Ive Andrića, autor filma kreće u potragu za sudbinom priče danas. Kroz književne, filmske, likovne i glazbene aspekte njihovih "priča" vode nas Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras i Drago Grgić _ Godra. Iako generacijski udaljeni, svima je zajedničko da ne žive od priča, ali bez njih ne bi mogli živjeti.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Dodir zla
programme.desc: A high-ranking official in the Mexican government Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) is enjoying his honeymoon with his American wife Susan (J. Leigh). Their kiss in a small town on the US-Mexico border is interrupted by the explosion of the car in which the town's powerful man was. It is a skillfully planned murder, in which local police chief Hank Quinlan (O. Welles) takes over the investigation. As the crime took place at the border crossing itself, Quinlan is joined in the investigation by Vargas, who deals with exposing drug smugglers. A Mexican law enforcement officer will be targeted by Quinlan, who will not hesitate to cooperate with the gangster Joe Grandi aka Uncle (A. Tamiroff) in order to disable his colleague from Mexico... / Visokopozicionirani službenik u meksičkoj vladi Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) uživa u medenom mjesecu sa svojom suprugom Amerikankom Susan (J. Leigh). Njihov poljubac u gradiću na američko-meksičkoj granici prekine eksplozija automobila u kojoj se nalazio gradski moćnik. Riječ je o vješto isplaniranom ubojstvu pri čemu istragu preuzme mjesni šef policije Hank Quinlan (O. Welles). Kako se zločin zbio na samom graničnom prijelazu, Quinlanu se u istrazi pridruži Vargas koji se bavi raskrinkavanjem krijumčara droge. Meksički čuvar zakona naći će se na meti Quinlana koji neće prezati ni od suradnje s gangsterom Joeom Grandijem zvanim Uncle (A. Tamiroff) kako bi onemogućio svog kolegu iz Meksika...

programme.title: From whisperer to spokesperson / Od šaptačice do glasnogovornika
programme.desc: There is no longer a so-called in any theater. shell for whisperers. That shell is a kind of symbol of the term "theatre". But time takes its toll and the whisperers, together with the shells _ disappear. Shells are deposited in warehouses of staged scenery, and whisperers cease to exist as a profession. Moreover, today most theater companies in Croatia do not have an official, paid, full-time whisperer. Although they still, mostly only at rehearsals, help with the creation of the play and do so in the way they know best _ by whispering. But even that is less and less. Many claim that this is the most obvious sign that the theater, and with it the world, has irreversibly changed. Namely, less and less texts are played in which it is important what was said by whom in the first place. There are fewer and fewer texts in verse and rhyme, so words have lost their importance. "Whisperers are dying out. People have less and less time to communicate. Life is becoming faster and more technologically modern day by day, people are more distant. There will come a day when there will be no time for whispering," says one professional whisperer. On the other hand, the fact is that the epochal mood of the 21st century needs noisemakers more than whisperers. It is in this modern tendency that the second layer of this story is hidden. So today, while whisperers are dying out, spokespeople are multiplying unstoppably... / Više ni u jednom kazalištu ne postoji tzv. školjka za šaptače. Ta je školjka svojevrsni simbol pojma "kazalište". No, vrijeme nosi svoje i šaptači, zajedno sa školjkama _ nestaju. Školjke se odlažu u skladišta izigranih scenografija, a šaptači kao zanimanje prestaju postojati. Štoviše, danas većina kazališnih kuća u Hrvatskoj nema službenog, na plaći, stalno zaposlenog šaptača. Mada još uvijek, uglavnom samo na probama, pomažu pri stvaranju predstave i to onako kako najbolje znaju _ šapćući. Ali i to sve rjeđe. Mnogi tvrde da je to najočitiji znak da se kazalište, a s njime i svijet, nepovratno promijenilo. Naime, sve se manje igraju tekstovi u kojima je važno što je tko uopće rekao. Sve je manje tekstova u stihu i rimi, pa su i riječi izgubile na važnosti. "Šaptači izumiru. Ljudi imaju sve manje vremena za komunikaciju. Život iz dana u dan postaje sve ubrzaniji i tehnološki suvremeniji, ljudi udaljeniji. Doći će dan kada neće biti vremena za šaptanje" _ kaže jedna profesionalna šaptačica. S druge strane, činjenica je da epohalni štimung 21. stoljeća više treba bukače nego li šaptače. Upravo u toj novovjekoj tendenciji krije se drugi sloj ove priče. Tako danas, dok šaptači izumiru, nezaustavljivo se množe glasnogovornici...

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Mangroove is performing tonight, a band that in more than two decades of being on the scene has built a recognizable, original pop sound, coated with soul, acid jazz, funk, electronics and a series of experiments. Their discography includes the albums Svijet za nas, Put na mješ, Sami, Srce, and after the well-received album Nešto vješe od nas from 2023, recorded with the HRT Jazz Orchestra, this autumn they present a new album Komad neba, judging by the first reviews, one of the main contenders for album of the year. Mangroves are Željka Veverec, Toni Starešinić, Leo Beslać and Silvio Bočić. / Večeras nastupa Mangroove, bend koji je u više od dva desetljeća, koliko je na sceni, izgradio prepoznatljiv, autorski pop zvuk, premazan soulom, acid jazzom, funkom, elektronikom i nizom eksperimenata. Njihov diskografski put uključuje albume Svijet za nas, Put na mjesec, Sami, Srce, a nakon odlično prihvaćenog albuma Nešto veće od nas iz 2023., snimljenog s Jazz orkestrom HRT-a, ove jeseni predstavljaju novi album Komad neba, sudeći po prvim kritikama, jednim od glavnih konkurenata za album godine. Mangroove su Željka Veverec, Toni Starešinić, Leo Beslać i Silvio Bočić.

programme.title: A witness of reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people gave their face to the small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man steps off the stage of his life, his story fades into oblivion. They say that some stories existed only to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of memories of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres signed by director Dražen Piškorić are preserved in the HRT archive. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Paris in 1827. The young generation of artists led by Hugo, Dumas and Delacroix is ​​determined to make a real revolution in the art field. These are the beginnings of romanticism in France. Delacroix creates "The Death of Sardanapalus", a picture that becomes a kind of manifesto of a new artistic movement that wants to break with conventions and create a completely new style of writing, painting and composing. "Hernani", "The Skin of Chagrin", "The Hunchback of Notre Dame" and "Fantastic Symphony" ensure the triumph of the romantic army whose soldiers are ready to risk everything to win the victory and defeat the classics. Their artistic commitment also gives a strong impetus to the new political consciousness. While on the streets of Paris the people demand and fight for the Republic, even the romantics will not stop until freedom reigns. / Pariz 1827. Mladi naraštaj umjetnika predvođen Hugoom, Dumasom i Delacroixom odlučan je u namjeri da na umjetničkom polju napravi pravu revoluciju. To su počeci romantizma u Francuskoj. Delacroix stvara "Sardanapalovu smrt", sliku koja postaje svojevrsni manifest novog umjetničkog pokreta koji želi raskinuti s konvencijama i osmisliti potpuno nov stil pisanja, slikanja i komponiranja. "Hernani", "Chagrinska koža", "Zvonar crkve Notre Dame" i "Fantastična simfonija" osiguravaju trijumf romantičarske vojske čiji su vojnici spremni sve riskirati kako bi odnijeli pobjedu i pobijedili klasike. Njihova umjetnička angažiranost daje snažan poticaj i novoj političkoj svijesti. Dok na pariškim ulicama narod zahtijeva i bori se za Republiku, ni romantičari neće stati sve dok ne zavlada sloboda.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America. / Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic under the direction of renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal _ bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.
