programme.title: In memoriam Snješka Knežević: Contemporaries / In memoriam Snješka Knežević: Suvremenici
programme.desc: Snješka Knežević, art historian, translator and theorist, left us at the age of 87. As a chronicler of the city of Zagreb, she dealt critically with issues of restoration and protection and pointed out the devastation of cultural heritage. In the "Contemporary" episode recorded in 2020, Snješka Knežević talks about her love for Zagreb, urbanism and architecture; about dedication to research and scientific work, from the early sixties when she worked at Radio Zagreb to the shows of the Third Program "Baština, mi i svijet". / Snješka Knežević, povjesničarka umjetnosti, prevoditeljica i teoretičarka napustila nas je u 87. godini života. Kao kroničarka grada Zagreba kritički se bavila pitanjima obnove i zaštite te ukazivala na devastacije kulturne baštine. U epizodi "Suvremenika" snimljenoj 2020. Snješka Knežević govori o ljubavi prema Zagrebu, urbanizmu i arhitekturi; o posvećenosti istraživanju i znanstvenom radu, od ranih šezdesetih kad je radila na Radio Zagrebu do emisija Trećeg programa "Baština, mi i svijet".

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: Topics: Doctors, politicians, Society of addicts Commentators are Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec. / Teme: Liječnici političari Društvo ovisnika Komentatori su Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec.

programme.title: Spas za Veneciju
programme.desc: Venice is one of the most famous cities in the world. Her accommodation is a stimulus for her economic progress, but it also exposes her to floods. The first settlers drove wooden stakes into the soft mud of the lagoon and thus achieved sufficient strength for the soil to bear more weight. The whole city rests on this technique. Samples of thousand-year-old stakes show that the sludge slows down the rotting of wood, but increasingly frequent floods are a new threat. Restorers hurriedly remove the salt from the city's monuments, which, when it remains after evaporation, crystallizes and weakens the structure of the walls. After a decade of construction, MOSE, a multi-billion euro flood barrier system, is ready to protect the city. Passages have been built across three narrow bays that connect the lagoon to the open sea. In the control room, we monitor barrier raising operations as a devastating storm approaches the city. Despite the failure of the safety valves, the team manages to solve the problem and raise the door in time. The city is safe, but MOSE can only be used in exceptional circumstances because the barriers prevent the tides, which are necessary to remove pollution and human waste from the city. Engineers are working on plans to balance the two problems, including a groundbreaking project to pump billions of liters of seawater into aquifers deep beneath the city to raise the water level there by 25cm. Venice's relationship with the lagoon is crucial to the city's future and explains its current difficulties. In the 15th century, while the lagoon was getting clogged, large-scale engineering efforts prevented the lagoon from turning into dry land, but because of this, floods became more frequent. New routes to North and South America reduced Venice's trading power. In order to survive, the city was repurposed as an important tourist destination. Today, Venice attracts millions of tourists annually. Large cruisers and cargo ships crowd the canal west of the city, and the waves from these large vessels erode the salt marshes at an alarming rate and increase the risk of flooding, while smaller motorboats damage the canal walls. Events such as Regatta Storica celebrate the town without motorboats. Faced with the possibility of losing their city due to climate change, the Venetians turn to revolutionary engineering: the restoration of the natural environment and the knowledge of the past. Only by applying multiple approaches can they hope to save Venice. / Venecija je jedan od najpoznatijih gradova na svijetu. Njezin smještaj poticajan je za njezin gospodarski napredak, ali je zbog njega istodobno izložena poplavama. Prvi doseljenici zabijali su drvene kolce u meki mulj lagune i tako postigli dovoljnu čvrstoću da tlo podnese veću težinu. Na toj tehnici počiva cijeli grad. Uzorci kolaca starih tisuću godina pokazuju kako mulj usporava truljenje drva, ali sve češće poplave nova su prijetnja. Restauratori žurno uklanjaju sol s gradskih spomenika koja, kad ostane nakon isparavanja, kristalizira i slabi strukturu zidova. Nakon desetljeća izgradnje, MOSE, sustav poplavnih barijera vrijedan više milijardi eura, spreman je za zaštitu grada. Preko tri uske uvale koje povezuju lagunu s otvorenim morem izgrađeni su prolazi. U kontrolnoj sobi pratimo operacije podizanja barijera dok se gradu približava razorna oluja. Unatoč kvaru sigurnosnih ventila, ekipa uspijeva riješiti problem i na vrijeme podići vrata. Grad je siguran, ali MOSE se može primijeniti samo u iznimnim okolnostima jer barijere sprečavaju plimu i oseku, koje su nužne za uklanjanje onečišćenja i ljudskog otpada iz grada. Inženjeri rade na planovima za uravnoteženje ova dva problema, uključujući revolucionarni projekt ispumpavanja milijardi litara morske vode u vodonosnike duboko ispod grada kako bi se razina ondje podignula za 25 cm. Odnos Venecije s lagunom ključan je za budućnost grada i objašnjava njegove trenutne poteškoće. U 15. stoljeću, dok se laguna začepljivala, krupnim inženjerskim pothvatima spriječeno je pretvaranje lagune u suho tlo, ali zato su poplave postale učestalije. Nove rute prema Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi smanjile su trgovačku moć Venecije. Da bi preživio, grad je prenamijenjen u važnu turističku destinaciju. Danas Venecija privlači milijune turista godišnje. Veliki krstaši i teretni brodovi naguravaju se u kanalu zapadno od grada, a valovi s tih velikih plovila uzrokuju eroziju slanih močvara alarmantnom brzinom i povećavaju rizik od poplava, dok manji motorni čamci oštećuju stjenke kanala. Događaji kao što je Regatta Storica slave grad bez motornih čamaca. Pred mogućnošću da zbog klimatskih promjena izgube grad, Venecijanci se okreću revolucionarnom inženjerstvu: obnovi prirodnog okoliša i znanjima iz prošlosti. Samo se primjenom višestrukih pristupa mogu nadati da će spasiti Veneciju.

programme.title: Šangajska trijada
programme.desc: At the beginning of the thirties of the 20th century, Tang (L. Baotian) is the most powerful criminal in Shanghai, and he created an "empire" by selling opium. His lover Xiao Jingbao _ "Bijou" (L. Gong) _ is once a prostitute and now a singer in the biggest Shanghai night club owned by Tang of course. Fourteen-year-old peasant Shuisheng (W. Xiaoxiao) is brought to Shanghai by his uncle, Tang's cousin and servant. The boy will be Bijou's servant and will obediently fulfill her every wish. She lives in a large, luxurious house given to her by Tang. Tang has two assistants _ his "right hand" Song (S. Chun) and favorite Zheng (F. Biao). Song is Bijou's secret lover, which a stunned Shuisheng discovers in the first days. Fat Yu (L. Jiang) is Tang's main competitor who kills several of his men, among them Shuisheng's uncle... / Početkom tridesetih godina 20. stoljeća Tang (L. Baotian) je najmoćniji šangajski kriminalac, a "carstvo" je stvorio prodajući opijum. Njegova je ljubavnica Xiao Jingbao _ "Bijou" (L. Gong) _ nekoć prostitutka, a sad pjevačica u najvećem šangajskom noćnom klubu čiji je vlasnik dakako Tang. Četrnaestogodišnjeg seljačića Shuishenga (W. Xiaoxiao) dovede u Šangaj njegov stric, Tangov rođak i sluga. Dječak će biti sluga kod Bijou i ispunjavat će poslušno svaku njezinu želju. Ona stanuje u velikoj raskošnoj kući koju joj je poklonio Tang. Tang ima dvojicu pomoćnika _ svoju "desnu ruku" Songa (S. Chun) i miljenika Zhenga (F. Biao). Song je tajni ljubavnik Bijou što zapanjeni Shuisheng otkrije već prvih dana. Debeli Yu (L. Jiang) glavni je Tangov konkurent koji pobije nekoliko njegovih ljudi, među njima i Shuishengovog strica...

programme.title: Slobodna zona
programme.desc: Rebecca (Natalie Portman) is a young American who has been living in Jerusalem for several months. She just broke up with the Jew Breitberg, after he confessed to her that he raped a Palestinian woman while he was in the army. Rebecca's father is Jewish, and her mother is non-Jewish, so, despite her Jewish upbringing, she is not considered Jewish according to religious tradition. A tearful Rebecca gets into a taxi driven by Israeli Hanna (Hanna Laslo), whose parents survived the Holocaust. Rebecca agrees to go with Hanna, who is headed to a free trade zone not far from the Jordanian border to collect money owed to her husband, who was wounded in a recent rocket attack. There they meet Laila (Hiam Abbass), a Palestinian woman who is supposed to connect them with Hanna's husband's black market partner, a man they call "The American". The three women embark on a perilous journey to recover Hanna's money and find "The American's" son, Walid, who they believe ran off with the money. / Rebecca (Natalie Portman) je mlada Amerikanka koja već nekoliko mjeseci živi u Jeruzalemu. Upravo je prekinula vezu sa Židovom Breitbergom, nakon što joj je priznao da je silovao Palestinku dok je bio u vojsci. Rebeccin je otac Židov, a majka nežidovka pa se, unatoč židovskom odgoju, ne smatra Židovkom prema vjerskoj tradiciji. Uplakana Rebecca ulijeće u taksi kojim upravlja Izraelka Hanna (Hanna Laslo), čiji su roditelji preživjeli holokaust. Rebecca pristaje poći s Hannom koja se uputila prema slobodnoj trgovačkoj zoni nedaleko od jordanske granice kako bi utjerala novac koji duguju njezinom suprugu, ranjenom u nedavnom raketnom napadu. Ondje se nađu s Lailom (Hiam Abbass), Palestinkom koja ih treba povezati s partnerom Hannina supruga na crnom tržištu, muškarcem kojeg zovu "Amerikanac". Tri žene kreću na opasno putovanje kako bi utjerale Hannin novac i pronašle "Amerikančeva" sina Walida, za kojeg vjeruju da je pobjegao s novcem.
