Muc is left alone with the box and after his playful antics it becomes completely unrecognizable! / Pospremajući sobicu, Tvidi odluči da bi zbirku vrpci bilo najbolje čuvati u kutiji. Muc ostane nasamo s kutijom i nakon njegovih razigranih nestašluka ona postane posve neprepoznatljiva!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: While playing a board game, Captain Redbeard is drawn into the game itself and remains trapped in it. Marko invites Brojčić to help him find the captain. But this game is not for the faint of heart and the Numbers will have to use all their math knowledge to free him. / Dok je igrao društvenu igru, kapetana Riđobradog povlači sama igra te ostaje zarobljen u njoj. Marko poziva Brojčiće da mu pomognu pronaći kapetana. Ali ova igra nije za one slabog srca i Brojčići će morati upotrijebiti svo znanje matematike da ga oslobode.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo loves watching the rain. Some of his friends from the Drawing World don't like it. Rafi and Misha hate getting wet, but Pablo loves the rain so much that he actually turns into it! / Pablo obožava promatrati kišu. Neki od njegovih prijatelja iz Svijeta crteža to ne vole. Rafi i Miša mrze kad se smoče, ali Pablo kišu voli tako jako da se zapravo pretvori u nju!

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: It's time for the Snow Goat Show on High Snow Mountain. / Vrijeme je za predstavu snježnih koza na Visokoj snježnoj planini.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: A heat wave is underway. To help everyone cool down, Luce offers to lead them to a source no one knows about. / U tijeku je val vrućine. Kako bi pomogla svima da se ohlade, Luce ponudi odvesti ih do izvora za koji nitko ne zna.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango, Angus and the little triceratops Tillie are given the task of clearing rocks from a new field, but one huge rock is so stuck that they can't move it. Instead of finding a way around the stone, Angus persistently tries to move it, breaking his plow in the process. With Miguel's advice, Tango tries to show Angus how to calm down and try something different when things don't go according to plan, but Angus won't listen to her. In the end, he gets so angry that he manages to knock a huge rock out of the ground, but he accidentally knocks little Tillie onto it and it rolls away with her! Realizing that his stubbornness has put Tillie in danger, Angus finally listens to Tango, takes a deep breath and tries something new, and works with her to safely stop the rock and save Tillie. / Tango, Angus i mala triceratopsica Tillie dobivaju zadatak da očiste kamenje s novog polja, no jedan golemi kamen toliko je zaglavljen da ga ne mogu pomaknuti. Umjesto da pronađe način kako zaobići kamen, Angus uporno pokušava pomaknuti ga, pritom lomeći svoj plug. Uz Miguelov savjet, Tango pokušava pokazati Angusu kako se smiriti i pokušati nešto drukčije kad stvari ne idu po planu, ali Angus je ne želi slušati. Na kraju se toliko razljuti da uspije izbiti golemi kamen iz zemlje, no slučajno prevrne malenu Tillie na njega i on se otkotrlja skupa s njom! Shvativši da je njegova tvrdoglavost dovela Tillie u opasnost, Angus napokon posluša Tango, duboko udahne i pokuša nešto novo te surađuje s njom da sigurno zaustave kamen i spase Tillie.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian children's animated series Dogs on Patrol was created by Keith Chapman. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: Host _ traveler and gastronomad Robert Ripli in the third episode "Skitancija" takes us through the valley of the Krka river in search of an answer to the question that bothers him: is there still a place where people truly enjoy food and its preparation, and appreciate the importance of spending time together while eating. Along the way, Ripley managed to get groceries, cook like a guerilla and eat slowly and in peace, as he had not had the opportunity to do for a long time. He visited Burnum, the town of Nečven, the Roški waterfall, sailed through the canyon, visited Visovac, and finally found himself with his friends in the biggest gastronomic center of Croatia, in Skradin, where they enjoyed the joint preparation of brunch and the main theme of Skradin - food. / Voditelj _ putnik i gastronomad Robert Ripli u trećoj epizodi "Skitancija" vodi nas dolinom rijeke Krke u potrazi za odgovorom na pitanje koje ga muči: postoji li još mjesto gdje ljudi uistinu uživaju u hrani i njezinoj pripremi, te cijene važnost zajednički provedenog vremena uz jelo. Putem se Ripli snalazio za namirnice, gerilski kuhao i jeo polako i na miru, kako to već dugo nije imao prilike. Obišao je Burnum, Nečven grad, Roški slap, plovio kanjonom, posjetio Visovac te se na kraju s prijateljima našao u za njega najvećem gastronomskom središtu Hrvatske, u Skradinu, gdje su uživali u zajedničkoj pripremi marende i glavnoj skradinskoj temi _ hrani.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Dobar posao u Italiji
programme.desc: Charlie (M. Caine) is out of prison and is already ready for a big job in Italy, right in front of the Mafia. And so begins a show of cars from the sixties, Mini Cooper, Jaguar, as well as a race across the Alps... / Charlie (M. Caine) je izašao iz zatvora i već je spreman za velik posao u Italiji, baš ispred nosa mafiji. I tako počinje revija automobila iz šezdesetih, Mini Coopera, Jaguara, kao i jurnjava preko Alpa...

programme.title: Bolidu me godine
programme.desc: Ljubica Kordić lives the life that most idle and rich Europeans would wish for. She lives on the small island of Šćedar and is its only resident. However, living alone on an island is not easy at all. / Ljubica Kordić živi život kakav bi poželjela većina dokonih i bogatih Europljana. Živi na malom otoku Šćedru i njegova je jedina stanovnica. Međutim, živjeti sam na otoku nije nimalo lako.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: Topics: Doctors, politicians, Society of addicts Commentators are Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec. / Teme: Liječnici političari Društvo ovisnika Komentatori su Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić, Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec.

programme.title: Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: Modern science reveals that the border between the living and the non-living world does not actually exist. Everything that exists _ is alive. Nature is infinitely wondrous and cooperative, not competitive and exclusive. In its multiple appearances, it is capable of self-organization in countless ways. This power of self-organization is called syntropy. It was first discovered by mathematicians within the theory of complex systems, then by biologists in the field of microbiology, and today it is increasingly studied in theoretical and experimental physics, which until recently recognized only entropy. Syntropy is the opposite of entropy. The law of syntropy therefore goes beyond the limiting law of entropy, which allowed only the degradation and disintegration of ordered structures. It represents a radical turn in our view of the universe. / Suvremena znanost otkriva da granica između živog i neživog svijeta zapravo ne postoji. Sve što postoji _ živo je. Priroda je bezgranično čudesna i suradnička, a ne natjecateljska i isključiva. U svojoj mnogostrukoj pojavnosti sposobna je samoorganizirati se na bezbroj načina. Ova moć samoorganizacije naziva se sintropija. Prvo su je otkrili matematičari unutar teorije složenih sustava, zatim biolozi u području mikrobiologije, a danas se sve više proučava i u teorijskoj i eksperimentalnoj fizici, koja je do nedavno priznavala samo entropiju. Sintropija je suprotnost entropiji. Zakon sintropije stoga nadilazi ograničavajući entropijski zakon, koji je dopuštao samo degradaciju i raspad uređenih struktura. On predstavlja radikalan zaokret u našem pogledu na svemir.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The land between the mighty Gissar Mountains and the almost dried up Aral Sea stretches far away. Uzbekistan is characterized by sandy deserts, which seem endless, and oases that were once among the most important in the entire East. For thousands of years here, on the Silk Road, there was actually only one means of transport: the camel. After Russia annexed the territory of today's Uzbekistan, a railway network was built. Even today, the Silk Road express route is the main transport link between the green east of Uzbekistan and the arid deserts in the west. / Daleko se proteže zemlja između moćnog gorja Gissar i gotovo isušenog Aralskog jezera. Uzbekistan je obilježen pješčanim pustinjama, koje se doimaju beskrajnim, i oazama koje su nekoć bile među najvažnijima na cijelom Istoku. Tisućljećima je ovdje, na Putu svile, postojalo zapravo samo jedno prijevozno sredstvo: deva. Nakon što je Rusija pripojila područje današnjeg Uzbekistana, izgrađena je željeznička mreža. Još i danas ruta ekspresa Puta svile glavna je prometna poveznica između zelenog istoka Uzbekistana i sušnih pustinja na zapadu.

programme.title: Hvarski divovi
programme.desc: Hvar has always attracted with its beauty, an island where the sun warms stronger, a paradise created for man. Is it part of the legend about the creation of the world, did giants live there and do they belong to the human species, which the gods created as the first of the first before the Flood? / Hvar je uvijek privlačio svojom ljepotom, otok gdje sunce jače grije, raj stvoren za čovjeka. Je li dio legende o postanku svijeta, jesu li tu živjeli divovi i pripadaju li u ljudsku vrstu, koje su bogovi stvorili kao prve od prvih prije Potopa?

programme.title: Strength - Translation 1 And 2 / Mayales - Katran Session 1 And 2
programme.desc: The colorful Katran complex, a former industrial center in the center of Zagreb, is today on the verge of decay. Numerous names of the Zagreb art scene, clubs, studios, studios found their places there. Some of them still exist today. Since the beginning of the creation of the album "Simbol za Sunce" (2015), the group Mayales has been inextricably linked to Katran. As a sort of homage to this important place for the urban culture of Zagreb, the group Mayales is recording a series under the name Katran Session. In them, they perform their music from current albums live. This music film combines two sessions recorded in February 2018 (Symbol za sunce) and in October 2022 (Homeland), both directed by Radislav Jovanov Gonza. / Živopisan kompleks Katran, nekadašnji industrijski centar u središtu Zagreba, danas je na rubu propadanja. Ondje su svoja mjesta pronašla brojna imena zagrebačke umjetničke scene, klubovi, atelijeri, studija. Neka od njih postoje još i danas. Još od početka stvaranja albuma "Simbol za Sunce" (2015.), grupa Mayales neraskidivo je vezana uz Katran. Kao svojevrsni hommage ovom važnom mjestu za urbanu kulturu Zagreba grupa Mayales snima serijal pod imenom Katran Session. U njima uživo izvode svoju glazbu s aktualnih albuma. Ovaj glazbeni film objedinjuje dva sessiona snimljena u veljači 2018. (Simbol za sunce) te u listopadu 2022. (Domovina), oba u režiji Radislava Jovanova Gonze.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: We are hosting the renowned composer of theater and film music Ozren K. Glaser, the man who composed the music for the film "The Woman I Read About". The reason for the conversation was a recent concert by Vatroslav Lisinski, the first author's concert of that young, successful composer, with 200 musicians on stage. The concert called "Achilles' song" is music for a film that was not made. What that film would be like, what are the dreams of that young successful composer, whose first author's concert was attended by many people from Zagreb, as well as music film Oscar winners, find out in today's ART. / Ugošćujemo uglednog skladatelja kazališne i filmske glazbe Ozrena K. Glasera, čovjeka koji je skladao glazbu za film "Žena kojoj sam čitao". Povod razgovoru je nedavno održan koncert u KD Vatroslava Lisinskog, prvi autorski koncert tog mladog, uspješnog skladatelja, s 200 glazbenika na pozornici. Koncert pod nazivom "Ahilejeva pjesma" glazba je za film koji nije snimljen. Kakav bi bio taj film, kakvi su snovi toga mladog uspješnog skladatelja, kojem su na prvi autorski koncert uz brojne Zagrepčane došli i glazbeni filmski oskarovci, otkrijte u današnjem ART-u.

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: We all have only one, fragile but fluent sentence, and our existence is an opportunity to have the power to say something with that one sentence, said sentence grandmaster Lászlo Krasznahorkai. This need to express all the meaning and all the power in just one sentence before the end comes, can be seen in every multi-page, maniacal, hypnotic sentence of Krasznahorkai's works. Slađana Bukovac and Petar Milat talk about him in the show What is Classic. / Svi mi posjedujemo samo jednu, krhku, ali tečnu rečenicu, a naša egzistencija je prilika da imamo moć izreći nešto tom jednom rečenicom, rekao je rečenični velemajstor Lászlo Krasznahorkai. Ta potreba da se iskaže sav smisao i sva snaga u samo jednoj rečenici prije nego li dođe kraj, vidi se u svakoj, višestraničnoj, manijakalnoj, hipnotičnoj rečenici Krasznahorkaijeva djela. U emisiji Što je klasik o njemu govore Slađana Bukovac i Petar Milat.

programme.title: Georgij Paro - Cleaning up / Georgij Paro - Pospremanje
programme.desc: Croatian Television is showing the film "Cleaning Up _ Portrait of Georgij Par", produced by the Drama Program of Croatian Television. The peculiarity of the film is that the great director, pedagogue, theater thinker and theater theorist is not discussed by his colleagues, friends or critics, but is composed exclusively of materials found in the Archives of Croatian Television and Croatian Radio, in which Georgij Paro (1934 - 2018) talks about his directing, acting and actors, his relationship with his teachers, especially with Dr. Gavella, and his youth in Karlovac, director's beginnings, ambient theater, his American directors, pedagogical work and friends, about his relationship with the writer, about scenography, theater and politics, and he thinks about the future of theater. In addition to interesting audio and video material, after a long time we will see materials related to some of his plays that are considered a turning point in the history of the Dubrovnik Summer Festival, such as a rehearsal recorded the day before the premiere of Krleža's "Aretej" at Bokar in 1972, or the adaptation of a ship in Rijeka Dubrovnik that will sail as Santa Maria around Lokrum in the summer of 1973 as the stage for Krleža's "Kristofor" Columbus". Georgij Paro never wanted a monograph to be made about his work. He is one of the few directors of ours who has published several books related to the theater, so here too the great director told his theater story himself, which is a dedication to his desire related to the film form. The title of the film "Cleaning Up" is taken from the title of his last book, which in its very name refers to the author's desire to put his life story in order, to clean up what was really important to him. / Hrvatska televizija prikazuje film "Pospremanje _ portret Georgija Para" snimljen u produkciji Dramskog programa Hrvatske televizije. Osobitost filma je u tome što o velikom redatelju, pedagogu, kazališnom misliocu i teoretičaru kazališta ne govore njegovi suradnici, prijatelji ili kritičari, već je sastavljen isključivo od materijala pronađenih u Arhivu Hrvatske televizije i Hrvatskog radija u kojima Georgij Paro (1934. _ 2018.)govori o svojim režijama, o glumi i glumcima, odnosu prema svojim učiteljima, osobito prema doktoru Gavelli, o mladosti u Karlovcu, redateljskim počecima, ambijentalnom teatru, svojim američkim režijama, pedagoškom radu i prijateljima, o odnosu prema piscu, o scenografiji, kazalištu i politici te promišlja o budućnosti kazališta. Uz zanimljiv audio i video materijal, nakon dugo vremena vidjet ćemo materijale vezane uz neke od njegovih predstava koje se smatraju prekretnicom u povijesti Dubrovačkih ljetnih igara, poput probe snimljene dan uoči premijere Krležinog "Areteja" na Bokaru 1972. ili adaptiranja broda u Rijeci dubrovačkoj koji će kao Santa Maria oploviti oko Lokruma ljeta 1973. kao pozornica Krležinog "Kristofora Kolumba". Georgij Paro nikada nije želio da se o njegovom radu napravi monografija. Jedan je od rijetkih naših redatelja koji je objavio nekoliko knjiga vezanih uz kazalište, stoga je i ovdje veliki redatelj sam ispričao svoju kazališnu priču, što je posveta njegovoj želji vezanoj uz formu filma. Naziv filma "Pospremanje" preuzet je naslov njegove zadnje knjige koja i samim imenom upućuje na autorovu želju da posloži, pospremi svoju životnu priču i da se pri tome izdvoji ono što mu je zaista bilo važno.

programme.title: Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Borac
programme.desc: Jacques Darnay (A. Delon) was caught and convicted for stealing diamonds and murdering a jeweler. Although not a murderer, Darnay spent eight years in prison. Since the diamonds were not found after his release from prison, he is followed by Inspector Rouxel (P. Mondy), but also by criminals. He is protected by former gangster Gino Ruggeri (F. Perier) and lends him money, an apartment and even his lover Nathalie (A. Parillaud). But Ruggeri is still the leader of the gang that eliminated Darnay's best friend, and is similarly threatening him... / Jacques Darnay (A. Delon) je bio uhvaćen i osuđen zbog krađe dijamanata i ubojstva draguljara. Iako nije ubojica, Darnay je u zatvoru proveo osam godina. Budući da dijamanti nisu pronađeni nakon njegova izlaska iz zatvora, slijedi ga inspektor Rouxel (P. Mondy), ali i kriminalci. Štiti ga bivši gangster Gino Ruggeri (F. Perier) i posuđuje mu novac, stan, pa čak i ljubavnicu Nathalie (A. Parillaud). No, Ruggeri je još uvijek vođa bande koja je eliminirala Darnayeva najboljeg prijatelja, a slično prijeti i njemu...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Bart, Martin and the thugs must save lives after a weekend in the wilderness goes awry. / Bart, Martin i nasilnici moraju spašavati živu glavu nakon što vikend u divljini pođe po zlu.

programme.title: Relationships and acquaintances in paradise / Veze i poznanstva u raju
programme.desc: Felice Castriota is from Salento, a city in the south of Italy. He is a bookkeeper, impulsive and somewhat superficial. The desire to get rich and a certain recklessness lead him to engage in money laundering for criminals, but he is soon arrested for this. When the state attorney offers him a plea deal and offers to do community service instead of prison, Felice accepts it without thinking and exposes the influential gangster for whom he laundered money. In the Roman center of Don Guanella, where he was sent to work, Felice encounters a completely different reality from the one he expected and the one he had known until then. As a superficial man accustomed to luxury, he finds himself in a completely different environment, full of people with serious physical and mental disabilities. There are constant crises, diapers need to be changed, it is difficult to communicate with the wards and all this becomes a common practice of his days. Little by little, thanks to his love for the young psychologist Julia, Felice begins to feel like a member of a new big family for the first time in his life and becomes what he never was: a man. And just as everything seems to be moving in the perfect direction, Felice suddenly encounters her past and the collection of old debts. He will have to face the threats of a gangster who never stopped looking for him, and now he has finally found him. / Felice Castriota je iz Salenta, grada na jugu Italije. Knigovođa je, impulzivan i pomalo površan. Želja da se obogati i određena bezobzirnost dovode ga do angažmana pranja novca kriminalaca, no ubrzo zbog toga bude uhićen. Kad mu državni odvjetnik predloži nagodbu i ponudi da umjesto zatvora odradi društveno koristan rad, Felice to prihvati bez razmišljanja i prokaže utjecajnog gangstera za kojeg je prao novac. U rimskom centru Don Guanella, kamo je poslan na rad, Felice se susreće sa posve drukčijom stvarnošću od one koju je očekivao i one koju je dotad poznavao. Kao površan čovjek naučen na luksuz nađe se u posve drukčijem okruženju, punom ljudi s ozbiljnim tjelesnim i mentalnim oštećenjima. Tu su stalne krize, treba mijenjati pelene, teško je komunicirati sa štićenicima i sve to postaje uobičajena praksa njegovih dana. Malo pomalo, zahvaljujući i ljubavi prema mladoj psihologinji Juliji, Felice se prvi put u životu počinje osjećati članom nove velike obitelji i postaje ono što nikad nije bio: čovjek. I baš dok se sve naizgled kreće u savršenom smjeru, Felice se odjednom susretne sa svojom prošlošću i naplatom starih dugova. Morat će se suočiti s prijetnjama gangstera koji ga nikad nije prestao tražiti, a sad ga je napokon našao.

programme.title: Strength - Translation 1 And 2 / Mayales - Katran Session 1 And 2
programme.desc: The colorful Katran complex, a former industrial center in the center of Zagreb, is today on the verge of decay. Numerous names of the Zagreb art scene, clubs, studios, studios found their places there. Some of them still exist today. Since the beginning of the creation of the album "Simbol za Sunce" (2015), the group Mayales has been inextricably linked to Katran. As a sort of homage to this important place for the urban culture of Zagreb, the group Mayales is recording a series under the name Katran Session. In them, they perform their music from current albums live. This music film combines two sessions recorded in February 2018 (Symbol za sunce) and in October 2022 (Homeland), both directed by Radislav Jovanov Gonza. / Živopisan kompleks Katran, nekadašnji industrijski centar u središtu Zagreba, danas je na rubu propadanja. Ondje su svoja mjesta pronašla brojna imena zagrebačke umjetničke scene, klubovi, atelijeri, studija. Neka od njih postoje još i danas. Još od početka stvaranja albuma "Simbol za Sunce" (2015.), grupa Mayales neraskidivo je vezana uz Katran. Kao svojevrsni hommage ovom važnom mjestu za urbanu kulturu Zagreba grupa Mayales snima serijal pod imenom Katran Session. U njima uživo izvode svoju glazbu s aktualnih albuma. Ovaj glazbeni film objedinjuje dva sessiona snimljena u veljači 2018. (Simbol za sunce) te u listopadu 2022. (Domovina), oba u režiji Radislava Jovanova Gonze.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Dobar posao u Italiji
programme.desc: Charlie (M. Caine) is out of prison and is already ready for a big job in Italy, right in front of the Mafia. And so begins a show of cars from the sixties, Mini Cooper, Jaguar, as well as a race across the Alps... / Charlie (M. Caine) je izašao iz zatvora i već je spreman za velik posao u Italiji, baš ispred nosa mafiji. I tako počinje revija automobila iz šezdesetih, Mini Coopera, Jaguara, kao i jurnjava preko Alpa...

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore i teme iz povijesti hrvatske fotografije te suvremene autore koji djeluju na hrvatskoj sceni.

programme.title: Strength - Translation 1 And 2 / Mayales - Katran Session 1 And 2
programme.desc: The colorful Katran complex, a former industrial center in the center of Zagreb, is today on the verge of decay. Numerous names of the Zagreb art scene, clubs, studios, studios found their places there. Some of them still exist today. Since the beginning of the creation of the album "Simbol za Sunce" (2015), the group Mayales has been inextricably linked to Katran. As a sort of homage to this important place for the urban culture of Zagreb, the group Mayales is recording a series under the name Katran Session. In them, they perform their music from current albums live. This music film combines two sessions recorded in February 2018 (Symbol za sunce) and in October 2022 (Homeland), both directed by Radislav Jovanov Gonza. / Živopisan kompleks Katran, nekadašnji industrijski centar u središtu Zagreba, danas je na rubu propadanja. Ondje su svoja mjesta pronašla brojna imena zagrebačke umjetničke scene, klubovi, atelijeri, studija. Neka od njih postoje još i danas. Još od početka stvaranja albuma "Simbol za Sunce" (2015.), grupa Mayales neraskidivo je vezana uz Katran. Kao svojevrsni hommage ovom važnom mjestu za urbanu kulturu Zagreba grupa Mayales snima serijal pod imenom Katran Session. U njima uživo izvode svoju glazbu s aktualnih albuma. Ovaj glazbeni film objedinjuje dva sessiona snimljena u veljači 2018. (Simbol za sunce) te u listopadu 2022. (Domovina), oba u režiji Radislava Jovanova Gonze.

programme.title: Skitancije
programme.desc: In the fourth episode of "Skitancija", forester Željko Dolenec travels by motorbike through Gorski kotar to Novi Vinodolski to meet bikers. While driving, he enjoys the beauty of the Goranian forests, silence and nature, which is still sleepy and vulnerable during the transition from winter to spring. Along the way, our biker visits beautiful places such as the source of Kupa, the Orlove stijene lookout, the Golubinjak forest, Vrážji prolaz, Samarska stijene... He is occasionally accompanied by an artist who looks for various figures in the branches, a woman who paints with fire, a herbalist who always returns gifts to the forest, the oldest and most cheerful mountaineer in the Goran region, but also a bear with cubs, a carnivorous plant and the beautiful Queen of the Forest. / U četvrtoj epizodi "Skitancija" šumar Željko Dolenec putuje motorom kroz Gorski kotar u Novi Vinodolski na susret bikera. Vozeći se uživa u ljepoti goranskih šuma, tišini i prirodi koja je na prelasku zime u proljeće još snena i ranjiva. Putem naš biker obilazi prekrasna mjesta kao što su izvor Kupe, vidikovac Orlove stijene, šuma Golubinjak, Vražji prolaz, Samarske stijene... Društvo mu povremeno prave umjetnik koji u granama traži razne likove, žena koja slika vatrom, travarica koja šumi uvijek vraća darove, najstariji i najvedriji planinar goranskog kraja, ali i medvjedica s medvjedićima, biljka mesožderka te predivna Kraljica šume.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian children's animated series Dogs on Patrol was created by Keith Chapman. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu gets upset when she loses Damir's special toy. / Lu se uzruja, kad izgubi Damirovu posebnu igračku.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Water is dripping from the ceiling to the floor! Muc is fascinated by water, but he doesn't want to get wet! Can the friends figure out how to catch the water drops without getting wet? / Voda kaplje sa stropa na pod! Muc je očaran vodom, ali ne želi se smočiti! Mogu li prijatelji smisliti kako uhvatiti vodene kapi, a da se ne smoče?

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Farmer Kaos keeps counting the ducklings, but he can't figure out why. Can Brojčić help him understand? / Farmer Kaos stalno prebrojava pačiće, ali ne može shvatiti zašto. Mogu li mu Brojčići pomoći shvatiti?

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Love Monster is afraid that the hole in the inflatable pool will ruin the whole party. / Ljubavno Čudovište se boji da će zbog rupe u bazenu za napuhavanje propasti cijela zabava.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bob takes care of Phoebe's cute dog Earl, but when he takes him for a walk, he gets lost in Bitza's maze. / Bob se brine o Phoebinom slatkom psiću Earlu, ali kad ga odvede u šetnju, izgubi se u Bitzinu labirintu.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve and the Cassidy family is happily decorating their Christmas tree. Nearby, the dinosaur thief Wicked Sonny watches them longingly and thinks that he too would have someone to keep him company at Christmas if he had a tree as beautiful as theirs. When he sees the thieving raptor Bera trying to steal the gifts, he asks him to help him steal their tree instead. The duo load the tree onto Blitz's carriage and escape, with the Dinoranchers chasing after them all the way to snowy Blizzard Peak. High on an icy mountain, the Dinoranchers slip and end up on a dangerous cliff. Sonny thinks this is their chance to escape, but Bero doesn't want to leave the Dinoranchers in danger and saves them. The dinoranchers then kindly tell Bera that he and Sonny can keep the tree if it means so much to them, and this act of kindness prompts Sonny to give it back to them. But while returning it, he and the tree accidentally slide down the mountain, so the Dinoranchers have to rescue them. When everyone is finally safe, the ranchers invite Sonny to spend Christmas with them, and his Christmas wish comes true when Bero, proud that Sonny has returned the Cassidys' tree, becomes his friend and lets him ride on it. / Badnjak je i obitelj Cassidy s veseljem kiti svoje božićno drvce. U blizini, kradljivac dinosaura Opaki Sonny promatra ih s čežnjom i pomisli kako bi i njemu netko pravio društvo za Božić kad bi imao tako prekrasno drvce poput njihova. Kad ugleda lopovskog raptora Beru kako pokušava ukrasti darove, zamoli ga da mu umjesto toga pomogne ukrasti njihovo drvce. Dvojac ukrca drvce na Blitzovu kočiju i pobjegne, a Dinorančeri pojure za njima sve do snježnog Mećavinog vrha. Visoko na ledenoj planini, Dinorančeri se poskliznu i završe na opasnoj litici. Sonny pomisli da je to njihova prilika za bijeg, ali Bero ne želi ostaviti Dinorančere u opasnosti i spašava ih. Dinorančeri zatim ljubazno kažu Beri da on i Sonny mogu zadržati drvce ako im toliko znači, a taj čin dobrote potakne Sonnyja da im ga vrati. No, dok ga vraća, on i drvce slučajno skliznu niz planinu, pa ih Dinorančeri moraju spasiti. Kad su svi napokon na sigurnom, rančeri pozovu Sonnyja da s njima provede Božić, a njegova se božićna želja ispuni kad Bero, ponosan što je Sonny vratio Cassidyjevima drvce, postane njegov prijatelj i dopusti mu da jaše na njemu.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: Consumer code / Potrošački kod
programme.desc: We are talking about the rise of online fraud. In a year's time, a law is due to come into force that requires online sellers to introduce a so-called cancel button — a simple tool that will allow consumers to cancel online purchases with two clicks. The goal is to prevent pressure on customers. Citizens are offered allegedly lucrative investments or prizes, branded goods at special discounts, mobile phones, technical equipment and even excavators via e-mail and social networks. The theft of personal information or money from bank accounts is often hidden behind such offers. Fraudsters have become more and more convincing — so the question arises: how not to fall into their traps? / Govorimo o porastu internetskih prijevara. Za godinu dana na snagu bi trebao stupiti zakon koji internetskim prodavateljima nameće uvođenje takozvanog gumba za otkazivanje — jednostavnog alata kojim će potrošači s dva klika moći odustati od online kupnje. Cilj je spriječiti pritisak na kupce.Građanima se putem e-pošte i društvenih mreža nude navodno unosna ulaganja ili nagrade, brendirana roba po posebnim sniženjima, mobiteli, tehnička oprema pa čak i bageri. Iza takvih ponuda često se kriju krađa osobnih podataka ili novca s bankovnih računa. Prevaranti su postali sve uvjerljiviji — pa se postavlja pitanje: kako ne upasti u njihove zamke?

programme.title: Eko zona
programme.desc: Works on the revitalization of the Arboretum Opeka in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin are underway. After the restoration of the Opeka castle, built in the Baroque style in the second half of the 17th century, which had been deteriorating for decades, sediment was removed from the small artificial lake and the planting of indigenous and rare species is planned. On the occasion of that project, an introductory conference was recently held. Jaškovo is a small settlement within the town of Ozlje in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records as far back as 1433, when Prince Bartol Frankopan gave the people of Jaškov the pasture around the Dobra River for their use. It is in this ancient region that the Kovač family's farm is located, which has high-mountain Scottish cattle in free-range pastures. In addition to cattle, the family also grows pumpkins, walnuts and hazelnuts in an ecological way. We also bring foreign news. The pearly series of islands and islets called Pakleni otoci has been a protected natural monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. Posidonia meadows still grow in its bays and straits. / U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Nakon obnove dvorca Opeka, izgrađenog u baroknom stilu još u 2. polovici 17. stoljeća koji je desetljećima propadao, izvađen je sediment iz malenog umjetnog jezera te se planira sadnja autohtonih i rijetkih vrsta. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. Biserni niz otoka i otočića nazvan Pakleni otoci zaštićeni je spomenik prirode u kategoriji značajnog krajolika još od 1968. godine. U njegovim uvalama i tjesnacima i danas još rastu livade posidonije.

programme.title: Agenda: Svijet
programme.desc: Almost two years after the controversial economist of Italian-Croatian origin, Javier Milei, came to power in Argentina, his reforms continue to cause social divisions and protests. Nevertheless, Milei reduced massive inflation and stabilized the local currency, the peso. Ahead of partial parliamentary elections at the end of this month, to the aid of Donald Trump, the US approved 20 billion dollars to further stabilize the Argentine economy. What is the situation now in the once strong economy and agricultural superpower, which has been going through turbulent periods for decades? Agenda guest: Svijet is the director of the National Institute for Agricultural Technology in Buenos Aires, the highest-ranking descendant of Croatian emigrants in the administration there, Nicolas Bronzovich. / Gotovo dvije godine nakon što je na vlast u Argentini došao kontroverzni ekonomist talijansko-hrvatskog podrijetla, Javier Milei, njegove reforme i dalje izazivaju društvene podjele i prosvjede. Ipak, Milei je smanjio golemu inflaciju i stabilizirao domaću valutu, pesos. Uoči djelomičnih parlamentarnih izbora potkraj ovog mjeseca, u pomoć uskače Donald Trump, SAD su odobrile 20 milijardi dolara za daljnju stabilizaciju argentinske ekonomije. Kakva je sada situacija u nekada snažnoj ekonomiji i poljoprivrednoj velesili, koja već desetljećima prolazi kroz turbulentna razdoblja? Gost Agende: Svijet je ravnatelj Nacionalnog instituta za poljoprivrednu tehnologiju u Buenos Airesu, najviše rangirani potomak hrvatskih iseljenika u tamošnjoj administraciji, Nicolas Bronzovich.

programme.title: Druga strana
programme.desc: Are prime ministers consumable goods or guarantors of the stability of economic cycles? It depends on who you ask. France has overtaken Italy in the speed of prime minister rotation, while on the other side of the spectrum, Hungary and Croatia have been led by the same people for eight years. Does it say anything about the economy _ or is it a political trap for the gullible? The corruption of state budgets is analyzed by economic analyst Velimir Šonje. Governments do not fall because of ideology, but because of numbers. (Except in Croatia.) In the Other Side, we compare France, Romania and Croatia. Since Emmanuel Macron has been in power, the average "life expectancy" of a French prime minister has become shorter than ever. Barnier, who fell in December last year, was a record holder in recent French history _ with only three months of prime ministership. But he was dethroned by Sebastien Lucorni, setting a new record: only 27 days in office. And you thought that Italy is a country that changes governments like socks? Since 2017, since Macron came to power, France has changed seven and Italy four prime ministers. In football terms: 7 : 4 for France. And what would Croats or Hungarians say about such a hockey-like change of prime minister? In both countries, the same people have been leading the government for more than eight years. Today, Hungary has the highest interest rates in the European Union, and Croatia has the highest inflation. Where the fissures of the fiscal policy are hidden _ reveals the doyen of economic analytics Velimir Šonje. / Jesu li premijeri potrošna roba ili jamac stabilnosti ekonomskih ciklusa? Zavisi koga pitate. Francuska je u brzini rotacije premijera prestigla Italiju, dok s druge strane spektra Mađarsku i Hrvatsku već osam godina vode isti ljudi. Govori li to išta o ekonomiji _ ili je riječ o političkoj klopci za lakovjerne? Kvarenje državnih proračuna analizira ekonomski analitičar Velimir Šonje. Ne padaju vlade zbog ideologije, nego zbog brojki. (Osim u Hrvatskoj.) U Drugoj strani uspoređujemo Francusku, Rumunjsku i Hrvatsku. Od kada je Emmanuel Macron na vlasti, prosječni "životni vijek" francuskog premijera postao je kraći nego ikad. Barnier, koji je pao u prosincu prošle godine, bio je rekorder novije francuske povijesti _ s tek tri mjeseca premijerskog staža. No s trona ga je svrgnuo Sebastien Lucorni, postavivši novi rekord: samo 27 dana mandata. A mislili ste da je Italija zemlja koja mijenja vlade kao čarape? Od 2017., otkako je Macron stupio na vlast, Francuska je promijenila sedam, a Italija četiri premijera. Nogometnim rječnikom: 7 : 4 za Francusku. A što bi na ovako hokejašku izmjenu premijera rekli Hrvati ili Mađari? U obje zemlje isti ljudi vode vladu više od osam godina. Mađarska danas ima najviše kamatne stope u Europskoj uniji, a Hrvatska najvišu inflaciju. Gdje su skrivene pukotine fiskalne politike _ otkriva doajen ekonomske analitike Velimir Šonje.

programme.title: Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: How do European Union member regions respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union _ one of the key pillars of European development. / Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije _ jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja.

programme.title: Consumer code / Potrošački kod
programme.desc: We are talking about the rise of online fraud. In a year's time, a law is due to come into force that requires online sellers to introduce a so-called cancel button — a simple tool that will allow consumers to cancel online purchases with two clicks. The goal is to prevent pressure on customers. Citizens are offered allegedly lucrative investments or prizes, branded goods at special discounts, mobile phones, technical equipment and even excavators via e-mail and social networks. The theft of personal information or money from bank accounts is often hidden behind such offers. Fraudsters have become more and more convincing — so the question arises: how not to fall into their traps? / Govorimo o porastu internetskih prijevara. Za godinu dana na snagu bi trebao stupiti zakon koji internetskim prodavateljima nameće uvođenje takozvanog gumba za otkazivanje — jednostavnog alata kojim će potrošači s dva klika moći odustati od online kupnje. Cilj je spriječiti pritisak na kupce.Građanima se putem e-pošte i društvenih mreža nude navodno unosna ulaganja ili nagrade, brendirana roba po posebnim sniženjima, mobiteli, tehnička oprema pa čak i bageri. Iza takvih ponuda često se kriju krađa osobnih podataka ili novca s bankovnih računa. Prevaranti su postali sve uvjerljiviji — pa se postavlja pitanje: kako ne upasti u njihove zamke?

programme.title: Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: How do European Union member regions respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union _ one of the key pillars of European development. / Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije _ jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja.

programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Blaine Leslie Reininger (born 1953 in Pueblo, Colorado) is an American post-punk and new-wave musician, multi-instrumentalist, composer and author, best known as the co-founder of the avant-garde band Tuxedomoon. Since 1977, he has been active as a solo artist and collaborator of numerous musicians, including Durutti Column, Snakefinger, Anna Domino and Savage Republic. His work combines American underground and European avant-garde, and he is recognized as one of the key innovators of the post-rock and art-rock scene. After studying music in San Francisco, Reininger formed Tuxedomoon with Steven Brown, with whom he recorded the cult albums Half Mute, Desire and Suite en Sous-Sol. Since 1983, he has developed a rich solo career (Broken Fingers, Night Air, Byzantium), composing music for theater and film. Today he lives in Athens, where he continues to work as a performer and composer. In our conversation with Reininger, we return to San Francisco in the seventies, to Brussels in the eighties and to Europe, which for him became a space of freedom and research. He talks about the emergence of Tuxedomoon's hybrid sound, about collaborations with Maurice Bejart, Wim Wenders and Crammed Disco, and about the constant need to think music outside the market. We also talk about his working methods _ a combination of control and chaos, intuition and structure _ and about the topic of lucid dreaming, silence and space in music. Reininger reflects on contemporary art, technology and artificial intelligence, and the possibility of authentic experimentation in the digital age. / Blaine Leslie Reininger (rođen 1953. u Pueblu, Colorado) američki je post-punk i new-wave glazbenik, multiinstrumentalist, skladatelj i autor, najpoznatiji kao suosnivač avangardnog benda Tuxedomoon. Od 1977. aktivan je i kao solo umjetnik te suradnik brojnih glazbenika, među kojima su Durutti Column, Snakefinger, Anna Domino i Savage Republic. Njegov rad spaja američki underground i europsku avangardu, a prepoznat je kao jedan od ključnih inovatora post-rock i art-rock scene.Nakon studija glazbe u San Franciscu, Reininger s Stevenom Brownom formira Tuxedomoon, s kojim snima kultne albume Half Mute, Desire i Suite en Sous-Sol. Od 1983. razvija i bogatu solo karijeru (Broken Fingers, Night Air, Byzantium), skladajući i glazbu za kazalište i film. Danas živi u Ateni, gdje nastavlja djelovati kao izvođač i skladatelj.U razgovoru s Reiningerom vraćamo se u San Francisco sedamdesetih, u Bruxelles osamdesetih i u Europu koja je za njega postala prostor slobode i istraživanja. Govori o nastanku hibridnog zvuka Tuxedomoona, o suradnjama s Mauriceom Bejartom, Wimom Wendersom i Crammed Discom, te o trajnoj potrebi da glazbu misli izvan granica tržišta.Razgovaramo i o njegovim metodama rada _ spoju kontrole i kaosa, intuicije i strukture _ te o temi lucidnog sanjanja, tišine i prostora u glazbi. Reininger promišlja i suvremenu umjetnost, tehnologiju i umjetnu inteligenciju, te mogućnost autentičnog eksperimenta u digitalnom dobu.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: Why do we kill animals and could we survive as a species without meat? Is a diet without meat healthy and does it contribute to the preservation of the environment _ are just some of the questions that will be discussed in the show "Sunday at 2", whose guest is the president of the Animal Friends Association, Luka Oman. / Zašto ubijamo životinje i bismo li kao vrsta mogli opstati bez mesa? programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: In the city on four rivers, he found his way of life. Born in Karlovac with Czech roots, Dinko Neskusil observes the world through the lens of a camera. He took his first steps with his father, appearing in Karlovac weeklies, but also on the front line, documenting the devastating attacks on the city. His war photographs make up most of the display of the Museum of the Homeland War in Turnje. "It didn't happen again," says Dinko, who still takes photographs with the same passion today. He knows very well that a picture is worth a thousand words. Sound master: Boris Harmić Lighting master: Darko Višek / U gradu na četiri rijeke pronašao je svoj životni tok. Rođeni Karlovčanin čeških korijena, Dinko Neskusil, svijet promatra kroz objektiv fotoaparata. Prve je korake napravio uz oca, stasao u karlovačkim tjednicima, ali i na prvoj liniji fronte, dokumentirajući razorne napade na grad. Njegove ratne fotografije čine većinu postava Muzeja Domovinskog rata na Turnju. "Ne ponovilo se", kaže Dinko, koji i danas fotografira s jednakom strašću. Dobro zna da slika govori više od tisuću riječi. Ton-majstor: Boris Harmić Majstor rasvjete: Darko Višek

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: After the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina adopted the Reform Agenda, a key document derived from the Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, Ursula von der Leyen visited Bosnia and Herzegovina. From Sunday, the European Union applies a new system for controlling the entry and exit of citizens from outside the EU, the so-called EES, which replaces the traditional use of passports with digital recording of biometric data, such as fingerprints and facial images. The goal is more effective border control, the fight against illegal migration and the monitoring of the stay of foreigners in the Schengen area. The Government of the Republic of Croatia continues to financially support projects for the return of Croats and the creation of sustainable living conditions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The ceremonial awarding of the financial support contract for this year was held in Orašje. In Odžak, the foundation stone for the construction of the sports hall of the Vladimir Nazor Elementary School, worth one million and 410 thousand convertible marks, was laid, and the funds for the first phase were provided by the counties of Posavina and Osijek-Baranja and the Government of the Republic of Croatia. The beginning of the construction of the expressway Mostar - Polog - Široki Brijeg - the border of the Republic of Croatia was officially marked by the signing of the contract. Good transport connections will help the development of the economy, including agriculture, while Herzegovinian olive growers show how to invest in modernization and new technologies. Collaborating high school from neighboring states, specifically Osijek III. gymnasium and general gymnasium of the Catholic school center "Blaženi Ivan Merz" from Banja Luka, shown in a report by Predrag Solomun. The Osmica Memorial Park recalls the death of eight children in Lašvanska dolina in 1993. They died as a result of a mortar shell explosion on a children's playground in the suburb of Viteška. Thanks to the persistence of the families of the surviving children, the playground became a memorial with a strong anti-war message _ not to be forgotten and never to happen again. The 26th Mediterranean Film Festival ended in Široki Brijeg. In the competition of 19 documentaries, the Grand Prix of the festival was won by the film "Together Forever" by director Anastasya Miroshnichenko, while the award for the best short film was won by "Knives" by Croatian director Ivan Mokrović. / Nakon što je Vijeće ministara BiH donijelo Reformsku agendu, ključni dokument proizašao iz Plana rasta za zapadni Balkan, Ursula von der Leyen posjetila je BiH. Europska unija od nedjelje primjenjuje novi sustav za kontrolu ulaska i izlaska građana izvan EU-a, tzv. EES, koji zamjenjuje tradicionalnu uporabu putovnica digitalnim snimanjem biometrijskih podataka, poput otiska prstiju i slike lica. Cilj je učinkovitija kontrola granica, borba protiv nezakonitih migracija i praćenje boravka stranaca u schengenskom prostoru. Vlada Republike Hrvatske nastavlja financijski poticati projekte povratka Hrvata i stvaranje održivih uvjeta života u BiH. Svečana dodjela ugovora o financijskoj potpori za ovu godinu održana je u Orašju. U Odžaku je položen kamen temeljac za izgradnju sportske dvorane Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora, vrijedne milijun i 410 tisuća konvertibilnih maraka, a sredstva za prvu fazu osigurale su posavska i osječko-baranjska županija te Vlada Republike Hrvatske. Početak izgradnje brze ceste Mostar _ Polog _ Široki Brijeg _ granica RH službeno je označen potpisivanjem ugovora. Dobra prometna povezanost pomoći će razvoju gospodarstva, uključujući poljoprivredu, dok hercegovački maslinari pokazuju kako se ulagati u modernizaciju i nove tehnologije. Suradnja gimnazija iz susjednih država, konkretno osječke III. gimnazije i Opće gimnazije Katoličkoga školskog centra "Blaženi Ivan Merz" iz Banje Luke, prikazana je u reportaži Predraga Solomuna. Spomen-park Osmica podsjeća na stradanje osmero djece u Lašvanskoj dolini 1993. Poginula su od posljedica eksplozije minobacačke granate na dječjem igralištu u viteškom prigradskom naselju. Zahvaljujući upornosti obitelji preživjele djece, igralište je postalo spomen-obilježje s snažnom antiratnom porukom _ da se ne zaboravi i da se nikada više ne dogodi. U Širokom Brijegu završen je 26. Mediteran film festival. U konkurenciji 19 dokumentaraca, Grand Prix festivala osvojio je film "Zauvijek zajedno" redateljice Anastasye Miroshnichenko, dok je nagradu za najbolji kratkometražni film osvojio "Nožarije" hrvatskog redatelja Ivana Mokrovića.

programme.title: Third Place Dispute: Japan x Brazil / Disputa de Terceiro Lugar: Japao x Brasil
programme.desc: Worth the bronze, Japan and Brazil duel at the Hua Mak Indoor Stadium, in Bangkok, Thailand. programme.title: I am… / Аз съм…
programme.desc: The portrait series "I am...", in which interesting personalities from sports and culture tell about themselves, will mark its 10th anniversary with a special episode on the air of the sports and entertainment channel of the public television BNT 3. It collects the most interesting moments from the 620 episodes broadcast so far, realized by the journalistic team of the "Sport" directorate. Over the years, Olympic champions Ivet Goranova, Stoyka Krasteva, Erika Zafirova, Laura Traats, Madeleine Radukanova and Simona Dyankova, Olympic medalists Tervel Pulev, Mirela Demireva, Reneta Kamberova, Mihaela Maevska, Hristiana Todorova, Tsvetelina Naydenova, Lyubomira have been guests in the series. Casanova, Antoineta Kostadinova, Boryana Kalein, the European champions Stiliyana Nikolova, Gabriela and Stefani Stoevi, Lyubomir Epitropov, Stanimira Petrova, Daniel Asenov, Edmond Nazaryan, Kiril Milov, Miroslava Mincheva, Samuil Donkov, the winner of the snowboard world cup Radoslav Yankov, the young hope in motor sports Nikola Tsolov and many other athletes. The actors Filip Bukov, Martin Gyaurov, Rosen Belov and Irmena Chichikova also presented themselves in front of the camera of "I am...". / Портретната поредица "Аз съм...", в която интересни личности от спорта и културата разказват за себе си, ще отбележи своята 10-годишнина със специален епизод в ефира на спортно-развлекателния канал на обществената телевизия БНТ 3. programme.title: Slevin's luck / Късметът на Слевин
programme.desc: Slevin is at the bottom of bad luck - he loses his job, his girlfriend cheats and immediately after his arrival in New York he is "attacked". His good friend Nick is missing from his apartment so Slevin feels at home enough to take his place in the scheme he knows nothing about. Nick is indebted to two of the most powerful crime bosses - Shefa and Ravina, who mistakenly discover Slevin. With no explanation available, he must pay off Nick's debts with a 30,000 murder, liquidating one's son in revenge at the behest of the other. Helping the "lucky one" is the amorous neighbor Lindsay - an assistant in the morgue who wants to be a detective, on his trail is inspector Brikovski, who wants to reach the "top", while the mysterious killer Goodcat moves the strings "down" in the underworld... / Слевин е на дъното на лошия късмет - губи работата си, приятелката му изневерява и веднага след пристигането му в Ню Йорк е "нападнат". Добрият му приятел Ник липсва в апартамента си така, че Слевин да се почувства у дома си толкова, че да заеме мястото му в схемата, за която нищо не знае. Ник е длъжник на двама от най-могъщите криминални босове - Шефа и Равина, които погрешно откриват Слевин. Без възможност за обяснения, той трябва да изплати дълговете на Ник с убийство за 30 000, ликвидирайки за отмъщение сина на единия по поръчка на другия. В помощ на "късметлията" е влюбената съседка Линдзи - асистентка в моргата, която иска да бъде детектив, по следите му е инспектор Бриковски, който иска да стигне "върха", докато тайнственият килър Гудкет размества конците "долу" в подземния свят...

programme.desc: "Last One Wins" is a fun-informative, family-friendly quiz show featuring four players. programme.title: CASH OR TRESH / KEŠ ILI TREŠ
Osinje gnijezdo
programme.desc: Rene González (Édgar Ramírez) is a Cuban pilot who leaves his wife (Penelope Cruz) and their young daughter to defect to America in the early 1990s. In Miami, he starts a new life and uses his piloting skills to help the large number of Cubans who have fled the island by ship due to the effects of the Cuban economic collapse. / Rene González (Édgar Ramírez) kubanski je pilot koji ostavlja svoju suprugu (Penelope Cruz) i njihovu mladu kćerku kako bi prebjegao u Ameriku početkom 90-ih godina prošlog stoljeća. U Miamiju, on započinje novi život i koristi svoje pilotske vještine kako bi pomogao velikom broju Kubanaca koji su brodovima pobjegli s otoka zbog posljedica kubanskog ekonomskog kolapsa.

programme.title: Asher
programme.desc: Asher is a contract killer who has spent the better part of his life taking the lives of others, taking orders from Avi. He lives a solitary life, enjoying wine and good food, angering his apprentice Uzi, who takes over his jobs because he is younger. When Ava gives Asher 3 more revenge kills, he makes casual contact with Sophie, the ballet teacher, but can't reveal anything about his life to her. Asher is forced to team up with Uzi, but when the job goes wrong, Asher soon becomes the hunted, and death becomes a threat to all who come in contact with him. / Asher je plaćeni ubojica koji je najbolji dio svog života proveo oduzimajući živote drugima, primajući naređenja od Avija. Živi usamljeničkim životom, uživajući u vinu i dobroj hrani, ljuteći svog šegrta Uzija, koji preuzima njegove poslove jer je mlađi. Kad Avi da Asheru nova 3 ubojstva iz osvete, on uspostavi slučajni kontakt sa Sophie, učiteljicom baleta, ali joj ne može ništa otkriti o svom životu. Asher bude primoran udružiti se sa Uzijem, no kad posao krene po zlu, Asher ubrzo postane lovina, a smrt postane prijetnja svima koji su u dodiru s njim.

Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971.
