programme.title: Ellbogen
programme.desc: Original version German / Turkishsome with German subtitlesFree TV premiereHazal is 17 and from Berlin. Her deepest wish: a chance. On her 18th birthday, she actually just wants to celebrate, but a dramatic incident forces Hazal to flee. When Hazal is looking for an education in Berlin, she encounters prejudice everywhere she goes. But on her 18th birthday, Hazal feels strong. She wants to go to the coolest club in Berlin with her friends, but the bouncer turns her down. No training place because she doesn't have a high school diploma, prejudice because of her Turkish name, a mother who puts pressure on her to finally earn money - Hazal can't forget all of this, even while partying with her friends. The bouncer shows her once again that she doesn't belong. As if the evening wasn't bad enough, the friends are harassed by a pushy student in the subway station on the way home. All the frustration erupts and the situation escalates into a serious incident. Hazal flees headlong to Istanbul, to a strange city in a country she doesn't know. She has to survive there alone, no matter what the cost. / Originalfassung Deutsch / Turkischteilweise mit deutschen UntertitelnFree-TV-PremiereHazal ist 17 und Berlinerin. Ihr sehnlichster Wunsch: eine Chance. An ihrem 18. Geburtstag will sie eigentlich nur feiern, doch ein dramatischer Zwischenfall zwingt Hazal zur Flucht.Auf der Suche nach einer Ausbildung in Berlin stoSSt Hazal uberall nur auf Vorurteile. Aber an ihrem 18. Geburtstag fuhlt sich Hazal stark. Mit ihren Freundinnen will sie in den coolsten Klub Berlins, doch der Tursteher lasst sie abblitzen.Kein Ausbildungsplatz wegen fehlendem Abitur, Vorurteile aufgrund ihres turkischen Namens, eine Mutter, die ihr Druck macht, endlich Geld zu verdienen - das alles kann Hazal nicht einmal mit ihren Freundinnen beim Feiern vergessen. Der Tursteher zeigt ihr wieder einmal, dass sie nicht dazugehort.Als ware der Abend nicht schon schlimm genug, werden die Freundinnen auf dem Heimweg im U-Bahnhof auch noch von einem aufdringlichen Studenten belastigt. Der ganze Frust entladt sich und die Situation eskaliert in einem folgenschweren Zwischenfall. Hazal flieht Hals uber Kopf nach Istanbul, in eine fremde Stadt in einem ihr unbekannten Land. Dort muss sie allein uberleben, koste es, was es wolle.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - parents for my child / Lena Lorenz - Eltern fur mein Kind
programme.desc: Midwife Lena Lorenz and her husband Quirin are happy about the birth of their little Luis. They receive a lot of support at the Lorenzhof, so Lena is running her practice herself again. Her first patient is Gabriele Ammerer, whose pregnancy is going well. But she herself is seriously ill and has therefore already organized foster parents for her child. Shortly before the birth they had to cancel her. Gabriele is desperate. The shock causes her to give birth. Luckily, this goes without complications and Lena can put a healthy girl in her arms. Gabriele is happy about little Marie, but concern for her daughter's future drives her to start looking for suitable foster parents again. Gabriele has ALS, a serious disease of the central and peripheral nervous system. Their life expectancy is very short; She probably only has three to five years left. She does everything she can to ensure that Marie finds herself in a loving environment. Lena wants to support her, but at the same time she worries that the pressure Gabriele is putting herself under could lead to a breakdown. Does Gabriele really have no one in her family who can help her? Gabriele admits that she has a younger sister, but they haven't seen each other for a few years. Sonja seems to be the complete opposite of her older sister, chaotic, unambitious, unreliable. Motivated by Lena, Gabriele resumes contact. Sonja is skeptical when she visits her sister in the hospital. Marie, however, takes her heart by storm. However, when Sonja finds out about Gabriele's illness, she balks: Can she really take responsibility for a child? At the Lorenzhof, Quirin is now planning to expand the attic to create more living space. Eva is enthusiastic about her grandson Luis, but the role of grandma is too one-sided for her. She is planning a performance at the “Almwirt” with her newly formed band. Unfortunately, the concert doesn't end well and has to be canceled several times. Georg "Schorschi" Striebel, actually her partner and also the mayor of Himmelsruh, refuses his direct support so that no one can accuse him of bribery. Because that's exactly what he was warned about - by Vinz Huber of all people, who was only narrowly defeated in the last election. / Hebamme Lena Lorenz und ihr Mann Quirin sind glucklich uber die Geburt ihres kleinen Luis. Auf dem Lorenzhof bekommen sie viel Unterstutzung, sodass Lena ihre Praxis wieder selbst fuhrt.Ihre erste Patientin ist Gabriele Ammerer, deren Schwangerschaft gut verlauft. Doch sie selbst ist schwer erkrankt und hat deshalb schon jetzt Pflegeeltern fur ihr Kind organisiert. Kurz vor der Geburt mussen sie ihr aber absagen. Gabriele ist verzweifelt.Der Schock lost bei ihr die Geburt aus. Zum Gluck verlauft diese ohne Komplikationen, und Lena kann ihr ein gesundes Madchen in den Arm legen. Gabriele ist glucklich uber die kleine Marie, aber die Sorge um die Zukunft ihrer Tochter treibt sie an, erneut auf die Suche nach geeigneten Pflegeeltern zu gehen. Denn Gabriele hat ALS, eine schwere Erkrankung des zentralen und peripheren Nervensystems. Ihre Lebenserwartung ist sehr gering; es bleiben ihr voraussichtlich nur noch drei bis funf Jahre. Sie setzt alles daran, dass Marie in eine liebevolle Umgebung kommt.Lena mochte sie unterstutzen, und zugleich sorgt sie sich, dass der Druck, unter den sich Gabriele stellt, zu einem Zusammenbruch fuhren konnte. Hat Gabriele tatsachlich niemanden in ihrer Familie, der ihr helfen kann? Gabriele gesteht, dass sie eine jungere Schwester habe, doch beide hatten sich schon einige Jahre nicht mehr gesehen. Sonja scheint das komplette Gegenteil ihrer alteren Schwester zu sein, chaotisch, ohne Ehrgeiz, unzuverlassig. Von Lena motiviert, nimmt Gabriele den Kontakt wieder auf.Sonja ist skeptisch, als sie die Schwester im Krankenhaus besucht. Marie jedoch erobert ihr Herz im Sturm. Als Sonja allerdings von Gabrieles Erkrankung erfahrt, schreckt sie zuruck: Kann sie die Verantwortung fur ein Kind wirklich ubernehmen?Auf dem Lorenzhof plant Quirin inzwischen den Ausbau des Dachbodens, um mehr Wohnraum zu schaffen. Eva ist von ihrem Enkel Luis zwar begeistert, doch die Rolle als Oma ist ihr zu einseitig. Mit ihrer neu gegrundeten Band plant sie einen Auftritt im "Almwirt". Leider steht das Konzert unter keinem guten Stern und muss mehrfach abgebrochen werden. Georg "Schorschi" Striebel, eigentlich ihr Kompagnon und zugleich Burgermeister von Himmelsruh, verweigert seine direkte Unterstutzung, damit ihm niemand Bestechlichkeit vorwerfen kann. Denn genau davor wurde er gewarnt - ausgerechnet von Vinz Huber, der bei der letzten Wahl nur knapp unterlegen war.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - parents for my child / Lena Lorenz - Eltern fur mein Kind
programme.desc: Sonja Ammerer is torn between the need to help her sister and the fear of taking responsibility for a baby. The relationship is already fraught with conflict. Gabriele had taken great care of Sonja as a child, until she rebelled against her parents and her big sister in every way during puberty. Now Gabriele wonders whether Sonja can manage to take appropriate care of Marie. Sonja, on the other hand, admits to Lena that she cannot bear to accompany her sister as she dies. She also fears losing her friend Janosch. When Gabriele's health deteriorates, she has to make a decision. Franz also has to make a decision, because he has the need to get out of Himmelsruh and travel the world - with Basti, of course. But Basti can't stay away from the court for several weeks, especially since Schorschi is completely absorbed in his mayoralty and Eva is busy with the band. In the meantime, Julia and Marlon have to figure out how to separate their private and professional relationships, because Marlon wants to offer his own tours again, which is initially met with skepticism from Julia. However, there is good news for Quirin: the monument protection office has approved the roof extension. One more reason to toast Lena with a glass of champagne. And there is also a celebration in the “Almwirt” because the long-awaited performance of the Eva Lorenz Band is finally taking place. / Sonja Ammerer ist hin- und hergerissen zwischen dem Bedurfnis, ihrer Schwester zu helfen, und der Angst, die Verantwortung fur ein Baby zu ubernehmen. Die Beziehung ist ohnehin konfliktbeladen.Gabriele hatte sich in der Kindheit sehr um Sonja gekummert, bis diese in der Pubertat gegen die Eltern und die groSSe Schwester in jeglicher Form rebellierte. Nun fragt sich Gabriele, ob Sonja es schaffen kann, sich angemessen um Marie zu kummern.Sonja hingegen gesteht Lena, dass sie es nicht ertragen konne, ihre Schwester beim Sterben zu begleiten. Sie furchtet auch, ihren Freund Janosch zu verlieren. Als sich Gabrieles Gesundheitszustand verschlechtert, muss sie eine Entscheidung treffen.Auch Franz muss sich entscheiden, denn er hat das Bedurfnis, einmal aus Himmelsruh herauszukommen und die Welt zu bereisen - naturlich mit Basti. Doch Basti kann nicht mehrere Wochen dem Hof fernbleiben, zumal Schorschi ganz in seinem Burgermeisteramt aufgeht, und Eva mit der Band beschaftigt ist.In der Zwischenzeit mussen Julia und Marlon herausfinden, wie sie ihre privaten und beruflichen Beziehungen trennen, denn Marlon mochte wieder eigene Touren anbieten, was bei Julia zunachst auf Skepsis stoSSt. Gute Nachrichten gibt es dagegen fur Quirin: Das Denkmalschutzamt hat den Dachausbau genehmigt. Ein Grund mehr, mit einem Glas Sekt mit Lena anzustoSSen. Und auch im "Almwirt" wird gefeiert, denn endlich findet der langersehnte Auftritt der Eva-Lorenz-Band statt.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - Zerbrechliches Gluck
programme.desc: Food blogger Maja has decided to have a baby, even though Tobias, the father, is married. But Nele is a crybaby. Midwife Lena Lorenz sees that Maja needs support.Maja is in a dilemma. Although she and Tobias share a passion for fine food, she doesn't want to destroy his marriage. Lena can understand Maya's desire for independence. But the current situation is causing Maja to be overwhelmed. Tobias tries in his own way to support Maja and Nele. He and his wife Bettine ran an upscale restaurant together. Her two sons are still of school age, so Tobias hardly finds any time to really relieve Maja's burden. Lena doesn't want to interfere in his and Maja's affairs either. But then Bettine comes to her practice. Lena can confirm that she is ten weeks pregnant. Tobias becomes a father again, and Lena, who is the midwife for both mothers, gets into a loyalty conflict. While Lena and Quirin are enjoying his parental leave, Julia and Marlon are having a crisis. Julia wanted to be more involved in decisions, but Marlon does his own thing without consulting her. Basti also doubts his relationship with Franz because, apart from a few postcards, he doesn't let anyone hear about him. In addition, the work on the farm becomes too much for him, because Schorschi suddenly only has time for his duties as mayor of Himmelsruh. / Foodbloggerin Maja hat sich fur ein Baby entschieden, obwohl Tobias, der Vater, verheiratet ist. Doch Nele ist ein Schreibaby. Hebamme Lena Lorenz sieht, dass Maja Unterstutzung braucht.Maja steckt in einer Zwickmuhle. Sie und Tobias teilen zwar die Leidenschaft fur feines Essen, doch sie will seine Ehe nicht zerstoren. Lena kann Majas Wunsch nach Unabhangigkeit verstehen. Aber die jetzige Situation fuhrt zu einer Überforderung Majas.Tobias versucht auf seine Art, Maja und Nele zu unterstutzen. Er und seine Frau Bettine fuhren gemeinsam ein gehobenes Restaurant. Ihre beiden Sohne sind noch schulpflichtig, und Tobias findet von daher kaum Zeit, um Maja wirklich zu entlasten. Lena will sich auch gar nicht in seine und Majas Angelegenheiten einmischen. Doch dann kommt Bettine zu ihr in die Praxis. Lena kann ihr bestatigen, dass sie in der zehnten Woche schwanger ist. Tobias wird erneut Vater, und Lena, die fur beide Mutter die Hebamme ist, gerat in einen Loyalitatskonflikt.Wahrend Lena und Quirin dessen Elternzeit genieSSen, kriselt es bei Julia und Marlon. Julia mochte mehr in Entscheidungen einbezogen werden, doch Marlon macht sein Ding, ohne sich mit ihr abzusprechen. Auch Basti zweifelt an seiner Beziehung zu Franz, denn bis auf ein paar Postkarten lasst er nichts von sich horen. Daruber hinaus wachst ihm die Arbeit auf dem Hof uber den Kopf, denn Schorschi hat plotzlich nur noch Zeit fur seine Aufgaben als Burgermeister von Himmelsruh.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - Zerbrechliches Gluck
programme.desc: Maja finds out about Bettine's pregnancy and blames Lena for looking after both women and not telling her about it. In addition, Tobias does not provide any support. He only offers to cover the costs of childcare for Nele. Maja is disappointed and increasingly overwhelmed with her crying baby. The situation also comes to a head for Bettine: Tobias confesses to her his affair and that he is Nele's father. Shortly afterwards, Bettine begins bleeding. Will she lose the child? Fortunately, Lena herself finds great support from her family. Quirin is on parental leave and is working intensively on the loft conversion. But Lena notices that he would like to go on a hiking tour again. And since her mother Eva looks after her grandson with great enthusiasm, Quirin sets off on a mountain tour. But while Lena rushes to see Bettine in the hospital, Quirin finds himself in a dangerous situation when he helps a hiker who has slipped on a steep slope. / Maja erfahrt von Bettines Schwangerschaft und macht Lena Vorwurfe, weil sie beide Frauen betreut und ihr nichts davon erzahlt hat. Hinzu kommt, dass Tobias Unterstutzung ausbleibt.Er bietet ihr lediglich an, die Kosten fur eine Kinderbetreuung fur Nele zu ubernehmen. Maja ist enttauscht und zunehmend uberfordert mit ihrem Schreibaby. Auch fur Bettine spitzt sich die Lage zu: Tobias gesteht ihr seine Affare, und dass er der Vater von Nele ist.Kurz darauf setzen bei Bettine Blutungen ein. Wird sie das Kind verlieren?Lena selbst findet zum Gluck bei ihrer Familie groSSe Unterstutzung. Quirin ist in Elternzeit und kummert sich intensiv um den Dachausbau. Lena merkt aber, dass er gerne einmal wieder eine Wandertour unternehmen wurde. Und da ihre Mutter Eva mit groSSer Begeisterung auf ihren Enkel aufpasst, macht sich Quirin auf zu einer Bergtour. Doch wahrend Lena zu Bettine ins Krankenhaus eilt, gerat Quirin in eine gefahrliche Situation, als er einem Wanderer hilft, der an einem steilen Abhang abgerutscht ist.

programme.desc: Croatia, Overview. programme.title: Extreme E - Highlights 2025
programme.desc: Desert X-Prix. Το Extreme E φέρνει ηλεκτρικούς αγώνες σε μερικές από τις πιο απομακρυσμένες γωνιές του πλανήτη για να αναδείξει τις προκλήσεις της κλιματικής αλλαγής που αντιμετωπίζουν τα διαφορετικά οικοσυστήματα, προβάλλοντας παράλληλα την απόδοση όλων των ηλεκτρικών SUV σε ακραίες συνθήκες.

programme.title: Screenshots: 2025 Extreme H / Στιγμιότυπα: 2025 Extreme H

Η εφαρμογή αυτή, ωστόσο, θα γίνει η αφορμή για να δημιουργηθεί ρήγμα στις στενές σχέσεις του.

programme.title: And Yet I'm Still Here E11 (E) / Κι Όμως Είμαι Ακόμα Εδώ Ε11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Natasha asks Alexander for an explanation about the hug with Katerina, she is convinced that there is nothing wrong between them, but she tries to convince Alexander to let Antonis take over Katerina. Kelly starts work at the clinic and is happy to see Mario. / Η Νατάσα ζητάει εξηγήσεις από τον Αλέξανδρο για την αγκαλιά με την Κατερίνα, πείθεται ότι δεν συμβαίνει κάτι μεταξύ τους, αλλά προσπαθεί να πείσει τον Αλέξανδρο να αναλάβει την Κατερίνα ο Αντώνης. Η Κέλλυ ξεκινάει δουλειά στην κλινική και χαίρεται που βλέπει τον Μάριο.

programme.title: And Yet I'm Still Here E12 (E) / Κι Όμως Είμαι Ακόμα Εδώ Ε12 (Ε)
programme.desc: Alexander tells Katerina a far-fetched theory that her illness is affecting her ability to make good decisions, and he goes with her to the funeral home to pay for the funeral himself, supposedly from the clinic's program. / Ο Αλέξανδρος λέει στην Κατερίνα μια τραβηγμένη θεωρία ότι η αρρώστια της επηρεάζει την ικανότητά της να παίρνει σωστές αποφάσεις και πηγαίνει μαζί της στο γραφείο κηδειών για να πληρώσει αυτός την κηδεία, δήθεν από πρόγραμμα της κλινικής.

programme.title: In Foreign Hands E68 (E) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε68 (Ε)
programme.desc: Dioni is missing from Maritina's party and Sula receives an unexpected gift that will move her. Chrysanthos learns the truth about Maros' collaboration with the police and Fegoudis blames Piperopoulos for Dioni's disappearance. / Η Διώνη αγνοείται από το πάρτι της Μαριτίνας και η Σούλα δέχεται ένα απρόσμενο δώρο που θα την συγκινήσει. Ο Χρύσανθος μαθαίνει την αλήθεια για την συνεργασία της Μάρως με την αστυνομία και ο Φεγκούδης κατηγορεί τον Πιπερόπουλο για την εξαφάνιση της Διώνης.

programme.title: In Foreign Hands E69 (E) / Σε Ξένα Χέρια Ε69 (Ε)
programme.desc: Dioni is in the hands of ruthless kidnappers... unfortunately for them! And while they try to figure out from whom they will finally take the ransom, Fegoudis tries to find out if the kidnapping is real or staged. / Η Διώνη βρίσκεται στα χέρια των αδίστακτων απαγωγέων... για κακή τους τύχη! Κι όσο εκείνοι προσπαθούν να καταλάβουν από ποιον θα πάρουν τελικά τα λύτρα, ο Φεγκούδης προσπαθεί να εξιχνιάσει αν η απαγωγή είναι πραγματική ή στημένη.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time There Was a Man E5 / Μια Φορά κι έναν Καιρό Ήταν o Άνθρωπος Ε5

programme.desc: Episode: The Smurf Spectacles. Secretly in love with Smurfette, Xefteris presents her with a pair of smurf-enchanted glasses with which she will see him as the most beautiful smurf in the world. But she finds the eternal enemy of the Smurfs, Dracumel, beautiful! (Trans.) / Επεισόδιο: Τα στρουμφομαγεμένα γυαλιά. Κρυφά ερωτευμένος με τη Στρουμφίτα, ο Ξεφτέρης της κάνει δώρο ένα ζευγάρι στρουμφομαγεμένα γυαλιά με τα οποία θα τον βλέπει ως το πιο όμορφο στρουμφάκι του κόσμου. Όμως εκείνη βρίσκει πανέμορφο τον αιώνιο εχθρό των Στρουμφ, τον Δρακουμέλ! (Μεταγλ.)

programme.title: The Smurfs E10 / Τα Στρουμφάκια Ε10
programme.desc: Episode: The Smurf Soup. Dracumel convinces the ever-hungry giant Fagan to find the Smurfs and make them into smurf soup. Όμως ο Μπαμπαστρούμφ τον παγιδεύει προσθέτοντας στη δήθεν στρουμφόσουπα ένα φίλτρο που τον μετατρέπει σε τέρας. (Μεταγλ.)

The Mona Lisa has become a selfie backdrop. Is the original journey still possible? / Επεισόδιο: Το Ζήτημα του Πολιτισμού. Η εμπειρία είναι η βάση των ταξιδιών και του τουρισμού, αλλά πότε η εμπειρία γίνεται εκμετάλλευση; Η Ταϊλάνδη ταυτίζεται με τον τουρισμό των πάρτι. Η Μόνα Λίζα έχει καταντήσει φόντο για σέλφι. Άραγε το αυθεντικό ταξίδι είναι ακόμη εφικτό;

programme.title: Day in Color (E) / Μέρα με Χρώμα (Ε)
programme.desc: Informative magazine with an emphasis on culture, science, environment and entrepreneurship. With direct links, guests and reports, the show highlights issues that concern the citizens of Thessaloniki. / Ενημερωτικό μαγκαζίνο με έμφαση στον πολιτισμό, τις επιστήμες, το περιβάλλον και την επιχειρηματικότητα. Με απευθείας συνδέσεις, προσκεκλημένους και ρεπορτάζ, η εκπομπή αναδεικνύει θέματα που απασχολούν τους πολίτες της Θεσσαλονίκης.

programme.title: Arboriculture in Poland (E) / Δενδρομελισσοκομία στην Πολωνία (Ε)
programme.desc: Piotr is a beekeeper in Augustow, in the northeastern tip of Poland. For him, the ancient art of tree beekeeping, which dates back to the Middle Ages, is an inspiration for a life in harmony with nature. / Ο Πιότρ είναι μελισσοκόμος στο Αουγκούστουφ, στο βορειοανατολικό άκρο της Πολωνίας. Για τον ίδιο, η αρχαία τέχνη της μελισσοκομίας σε δέντρα, η οποία χρονολογείται από τον Μεσαίωνα, αποτελεί έμπνευση για μια ζωή σε αρμονία με τη φύση.

programme.title: Foreign Children's Program / Ξένο Παιδικό Πρόγραμμα
programme.desc: ERT presents selected children's programs. / Η ΕΡΤ σας παρουσιάζει επιλεγμένα, παιδικά προγράμματα.

programme.title: Landscapes from High K2 E3 (E) / Τοπία από Ψηλά Κ2 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Wales Part A. We are transported to the gentle landscape of Wales, renowned for its beauty, historical past and industrial heritage. It now attracts millions of visitors to enjoy the lush green meadows and magnificent coastline. / Επεισόδιο: Ουαλία Α Μέρος. Μεταφερόμαστε στο ήπιο τοπίο της Ουαλίας, που φημίζεται για την ομορφιά, το ιστορικό παρελθόν και τη βιομηχανική κληρονομιά της. Τώρα προσελκύει εκατομμύρια επισκέπτες για να απολαύσουν τα καταπράσινα λιβάδια και την υπέροχη ακτογραμμή.

programme.title: It's in Your Hand E2 (E) / Είναι στο Χέρι σου Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Ilenia and Stefanos continue construction on their new home. They start with a beautiful bookcase and progress with candlesticks and garden seats made from old tires. / Η Ιλένια και ο Στέφανος συνεχίζουν τις κατασκευές στο καινούργιο σπίτι τους. Ξεκινούν με μία πανέμορφη βιβλιοθήκη και προχωρούν με κηροπήγια και καθίσματα κήπου από παλιά λάστιχα.

programme.title: Herbs, Fruits of the Earth (E) / Βότανα, Καρποί της Γης (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: On the Mountain of the Gods. The forest of Elatochori is a natural botanical garden with more than 1700 species of plants. The flora of the area varies according to the altitude. There we find many great herbs, such as Olympus tea, nettle and truffle mushroom. / Επεισόδιο: Στο Βουνό των Θεών. Το δάσος του Ελατοχωρίου είναι ένας φυσικός βοτανικός κήπος με περισσότερα από 1700 είδη φυτών. Η χλωρίδα της περιοχής διαφοροποιείται ανάλογα με το υψόμετρο. Εκεί βρίσκουμε πολλά και σπουδαία βότανα, όπως το τσάι Ολύμπου, η τσουκνίδα και η τρούφα μανιτάρι.

programme.title: Perimeter / Περίμετρος
programme.desc: Informative broadcast which focuses daily on current affairs and special topics, in concentric circles, with an emphasis on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the Community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: The Salt of the Earth K11 (E) / Το Αλάτι της Γης Κ11 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Pontic Tradition in Almopia-Aridea. The show takes us to Pella and invites us to a Pontian feast with a great music and dance company from the Black Club of Almopia in Aridaia. / Επεισόδιο: Ποντιακή Παράδοση στην Αλμωπία-Αριδαία. Η εκπομπή μάς ταξιδεύει στην Πέλλα και μας προσκαλεί σ ένα ποντιακό γλέντι με μια μεγάλη μουσική και χορευτική παρέα από την Εύξεινο Λέσχη Αλμωπίας στην Αριδαία.

programme.title: Wild Greece K3 E9 (E) / Άγρια Ελλάδα Κ3 Ε9 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Chania. Elias and Grigoris visit the area of ​​Chania. They hike below the White Mountains to explore the cave of the cyclops Polyphemus, meet the endemic lizard, the buffalo frog and the Cretan Tarantula. / Επεισόδιο: Χανιά. Ο Ηλίας και ο Γρηγόρης επισκέπτονται την περιοχή των Χανίων. Κάνουν πεζοπορία κάτω από τα λευκά Όρη για να εξερευνήσουν τη σπηλιά του κύκλωπα Πολύφημου, συναντούν την ενδημική σαύρα, τον βουβαλοβάτραχο και την Κρητική Ταραντούλα.

programme.title: Waterscapes in Europe E3 (E) / Υδάτινα Τοπία στην Ευρώπη Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Dordogne. Along its 500 kilometers, the Dordogne has created a picturesque landscape in the south-west of France. The entire river basin is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Ντορντόν. Κατά μήκος των 500 χιλιομέτρων του, ο Ντορντόν έχει δημιουργήσει ένα γραφικό τοπίο στα νοτιοδυτικά της Γαλλίας. Ολόκληρη η λεκάνη απορροής του ποταμού αποτελεί απόθεμα βιόσφαιρας της UNESCO.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Acrites E2 (E) / Ακρίτες Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Olympus: Refugees at 2697 m. Our next stop is Olympus and the Plateau of the Muses. There we meet the refugees, at 2,697 m. in the highest inhabited building in the Balkans, the shelter of Ioss Apostolidis. / Επεισόδιο: Όλυμπος: Καταφυγιάδες στα 2697 μ. Επόμενος σταθμός μας ο Όλυμπος και το Οροπέδιο των Μουσών. Εκεί συναντάμε τους καταφυγιάδες, στα 2.697 μ. στο υψηλότερο κατοικημένο οίκημα των Βαλκανίων, το καταφύγιο του Γιώσου Αποστολίδη.

programme.title: The Vineyards of the World E18 (E) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε18 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Rhine Valley. The winegrowers of the Rhine Valley know all the secrets of Riesling, the quintessential German variety, a wine that has been cultivated for centuries in this region thanks to the strong influence of the river. / Επεισόδιο: Η Κοιλάδα του Ρήνου. Οι αμπελουργοί της κοιλάδας του Ρήνου γνωρίζουν όλα τα μυστικά του ρίσλινγκ, της κατ εξοχήν γερμανικής ποικιλίας, ενός κρασιού που καλλιεργείται εδώ και αιώνες στην περιοχή αυτή χάρη στην έντονη επίδραση του ποταμού.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K14 E5 / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ14 Ε5
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Brazil. Philip goes to Brazil. His journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a very original commuter train. He then boards the world's longest train, which crosses part of the Amazon forest. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Βραζιλία. Ο Φιλίπ πηγαίνει στη Βραζιλία. Το ταξίδι του ξεκινά στο Ρίο ντε Τζανέιρο, όπου ταξιδεύει με ένα πολύ πρωτότυπο προαστιακό τρένο. Στη συνέχεια, επιβιβάζεται στο μεγαλύτερο τρένο του κόσμου, το οποίο διασχίζει μέρος του Αμαζονίου δάσους.

programme.title: Hope E1 / Ελπίδα Ε1
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: The Big Chance. Behind the climate crisis lies a great opportunity to build a better world. We look at solutions that, in addition to reducing emissions, improve everyone's lives by embarking on a journey to see the solutions in action. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Η Μεγάλη Ευκαιρία. Πίσω από την κλιματική κρίση κρύβεται μια μεγάλη ευκαιρία για να χτίσουμε έναν καλύτερο κόσμο. Εξετάζουμε λύσεις που, εκτός από τη μείωση των εκπομπών, βελτιώνουν τη ζωή όλων, ξεκινώντας ένα ταξίδι για να δούμε τις λύσεις στην πράξη.

programme.title: Honeymoon trip / Ταξίδι του Μέλιτος
programme.desc: Leo, now retired, is on vacation with his wife. This time, their daughter is away on her honeymoon. The world of familiar mature vacationers is overshadowed by the fear of death. Some reminisce and others rebel. (105) / Ο Λέων, συνταξιούχος πλέον, παραθερίζει, μαζί με τη γυναίκα του. Αυτή τη φορά, η κόρη τους λείπει σε ταξίδι του μέλιτος. Ο κόσμος των γνώριμων παραθεριστών ώριμης ηλικίας σκιάζεται από το φόβο του θανάτου. Άλλοι αναπολούν και άλλοι επαναστατούν. (105)

programme.title: Short Stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: Come Let Me Tell You. Prize-winning fiction film at the Glermont-Ferrand International Festival, France. Giannis and Sofia have been married for 20 years. Their life goes on quietly, until the moment when their calm family peace is disturbed. / Έλα Να Σου Πω. Βραβευμένη ταινία μυθοπλασίας στο Διεθνές Φεστιβάλ Glermont-Ferrand της Γαλλίας. Ο Γιάννης και η Σοφία είναι παντρεμένοι εδώ και 20 χρόνια. Η ζωή τους κυλά ήσυχα, ως τη στιγμή που ταράζεται η ήρεμη οικογενειακή τους γαλήνη.

programme.title: With Virtue and Courage / Με Αρετή και Τόλμη
programme.desc: Update on the activities of the Ministry of National Defense and the Armed Forces. / Ενημέρωση για τις δραστηριότητες του Υπουργείου Εθνικής Άμυνας και των Ένοπλων Δυνάμεων.

programme.title: Seed E2 / Σπόρος Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Seed of Ideas in the Prefectures of Fthiotida and Fokida. Our trek starts from the NE foothills of Parnassos, continues towards Mount Kallidromos and ends at the mountain of Oita. Successful ventures taking place in the prefecture of Fthiotida and in the prefecture of Fokida are presented. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Σπόρος Iδεών στους Nομούς Φθιώτιδας και Φωκίδας. Το οδοιπορικό μας ξεκινάει από τους Β.Α πρόποδες του Παρνασσού, συνεχίζει προς το όρος Καλλίδρομο και καταλήγει στο βουνό της Οίτης. Παρουσιάζονται επιτυχημένα εγχειρήματα που λαμβάνουν χώρα στον νομό Φθιώτιδας και στον νομό Φωκίδας .

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Sunday in Chorio Xana K5 / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά Κ5
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Great Meadows. The show maps culture in ever-shrinking places. The village, however, remains a vibrant cell of well-being. Kostis Zafeirakis travels and traces the stories of those who live and create in the village. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Μεγάλα Λιβάδια. Η εκπομπή χαρτογραφεί τον πολιτισμό σε τόπους που μικραίνουν χρόνο με τον χρόνο. Το χωριό, όμως, παραμένει ένα ολοζώντανο κύτταρο ευζωίας. Ο Κωστής Ζαφειράκης ταξιδεύει κι ανιχνεύει τις ιστορίες εκείνων που ζουν και δημιουργούν στο χωριό.

programme.title: From Field to Shelf K3 E2 / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ3 Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Best Of - Part 2. The show presents all links in the chain of a product, from the seed selection stage to the final product that will take its place on the retail shelf. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Best Of - Μέρος 2ο. Η εκπομπή παρουσιάζει όλους κρίκους της αλυσίδας ενός προϊόντος, από το στάδιο της επιλογής του σπόρου μέχρι και το τελικό προϊόν που θα πάρει θέση στο ράφι του λιανεμπορίου.

programme.title: The Art of the Street K2 E2 (E) / Η Τέχνη του Δρόμου Κ2 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Chania. Travel documentary series that will write its own story by the hand of the famous street artist Same84 in cities and islands throughout Greece. The journey meets street art, leaving its own unique imprint. / Επεισόδιο: Χανιά. Ταξιδιωτική σειρά ντοκιμαντέρ που θα γράψει τη δική της ιστορία δια χειρός του διάσημου street artist Same84 σε πόλεις και νησιά σε όλη την Ελλάδα. Το ταξίδι συναντά την τέχνη του δρόμου αφήνοντας το ξεχωριστό της αποτύπωμα.

programme.title: Waterscapes in Europe E4 (E) / Υδάτινα Τοπία στην Ευρώπη Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: In the Mountains of Slovakia. There are more than 100 mountain lakes in the High Tatras and many of them shine with their own color. There is a green lake, a white lake and several black ones. The largest lake is called the Eye of the Sea. / Επεισόδιο: Στα Βουνά της Σλοβακίας. Υπάρχουν περισσότερες από 100 ορεινές λίμνες στα Υψηλά Τάτρα και πολλές από αυτές λάμπουν με το δικό τους χρώμα. Υπάρχει μια πράσινη λίμνη, μια λευκή λίμνη και αρκετές μαύρες. Η μεγαλύτερη λίμνη ονομάζεται Μάτι της Θάλασσας.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Borders
programme.desc: Our show travels every week beyond borders! The border as a meeting point of diversity is a fertile space where cultures interact to create a very rich social, economic and cultural context. / Η εκπομπή μας ταξιδεύει κάθε εβδομάδα πέρα από τα σύνορα! Τα σύνορα ως ένα σημείο συνάντησης διαφορετικοτήτων αποτελούν ένα γόνιμο χώρο όπου οι κουλτούρες συνδιαλέγονται για να δημιουργήσουν ένα πολύ πλούσιο κοινωνικό, οικονομικό και πολιτισμικό πλαίσιο.

programme.title: Fellow Humans K3 E4 (E) / Συν-Άνθρωποι Κ3 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: European Cities. The inhabitants of a hidden city in the heart of Macedonia who were called European citizens thousands of years before the founding of the European Union and a Doctor of Archeology who conveys archaeological information. / Επεισόδιο: Ευρωπαίων Πόλις. Οι κάτοικοι μιας κρυμμένης πόλης στην καρδιά της Μακεδονίας οι οποίοι αποκαλούνταν Ευρωπαίοι πολίτες χιλιάδες χρόνια πριν την ίδρυση της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης και ένας διδάκτορας της Αρχαιολογίας που μεταφέρει αρχαιογνωστικές πληροφορίες.

programme.title: The Vineyards of the World E19 (E) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε19 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Vineyards in the Desert. The Barossa vineyard, standing against the desert, forms a green belt to the north of Adelaide, the capital of South Australia. Here, in the 19th century, a German colony was founded, which introduced the concept of biodynamics. / Επεισόδιο: Αμπελώνες στην Έρημο. Ο αμπελώνας της Μπαρόσα, που στέκεται απέναντι στην έρημο, σχηματίζει μια πράσινη ζώνη στα βόρεια της Αδελαΐδας, πρωτεύουσας της Νότιας Αυστραλίας. Εδώ, τον 19ο αι, ιδρύθηκε μια γερμανική αποικία, που εισήγαγε την έννοια της βιοδυναμικής.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K2 E5 (E) / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ2 Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Malaysia. Malaysia can undoubtedly be discovered from the train that connects different areas, such as the jungle, the rice fields or modern Kuala Lumpur. Philippe will immerse himself in this amazing country, where multiple religions mix in apparent harmony. / Επεισόδιο: Μαλαισία. Η Μαλαισία μπορεί αναμφίβολα να ανακαλυφθεί από το τρένο που συνδέει διαφορετικές περιοχές, όπως η ζούγκλα, οι ορυζώνες ή η σύγχρονη Κουάλα Λουμπούρ. Ο Philippe θα βυθιστεί σε αυτή την καταπληκτική χώρα, όπου οι πολλαπλές θρησκείες αναμιγνύονται σε προφανή αρμονία.

programme.title: Hope E2 / Ελπίδα Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: The Power of Two Words. All change starts with: What if... What if there was another, better way to produce our food, manage water and natural resources, and reduce emissions? / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Η Δύναμη Δύο Λέξεων. Όλες οι αλλαγές ξεκινούν με το: Και αν.... Και αν υπήρχε ένας άλλος, καλύτερος τρόπος να παράγουμε τα τρόφιμά μας, να διαχειριζόμαστε το νερό και τους φυσικούς πόρους και να μειώνουμε τις εκπομπές;

programme.title: The Last Hero / Ο Τελευταίος Ήρωας
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Vida is trying to have a child. At the same time, she tries not to lose her mind as she balances the men in her family - her sexist grandfather, her sterile husband and her immature father. (90) / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Η Βίντα προσπαθεί να κάνει παιδί. Παράλληλα, προσπαθεί να μη χάσει το μυαλό της καθώς ισορροπεί με τους άντρες στην οικογένειά της - τον σεξιστή παππού της, τον στείρο σύζυγό της και τον ανώριμο πατέρα της. (90)

programme.title: Concert in the Heart of Amsterdam, Harding and Kavakos / Συναυλία στην Καρδιά του Άμστερνταμ, Χάρντινγκ and Καβάκος
programme.desc: On September 10, 2021, the Royal Netherlands Orchestra, Concertgebouworkest, opened the season with a festive concert in the heart of Amsterdam. Daniel Harding leads a musical journey with soloist world-renowned violinist, Leonidas Kavakos. / Στις 10 Σεπτεμβρίου 2021, η Βασιλική Ορχήστρα της Ολλανδίας, Concertgebouworkest, άνοιξε τη σεζόν με μια εορταστική συναυλία στην καρδιά του Άμστερνταμ. Ο Ντάνιελ Χάρντινγκ διευθύνει ένα μουσικό ταξίδι με σολίστ τον παγκοσμίου φήμης βιολιστή, Λεωνίδα Καβάκο.

programme.title: Waterscapes in Europe E4 (E) / Υδάτινα Τοπία στην Ευρώπη Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: In the Mountains of Slovakia. There are more than 100 mountain lakes in the High Tatras and many of them shine with their own color. There is a green lake, a white lake and several black ones. The largest lake is called the Eye of the Sea. / Επεισόδιο: Στα Βουνά της Σλοβακίας. Υπάρχουν περισσότερες από 100 ορεινές λίμνες στα Υψηλά Τάτρα και πολλές από αυτές λάμπουν με το δικό τους χρώμα. Υπάρχει μια πράσινη λίμνη, μια λευκή λίμνη και αρκετές μαύρες. Η μεγαλύτερη λίμνη ονομάζεται Μάτι της Θάλασσας.

programme.title: Sunday in the Village Again K5 (E) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά Κ5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Great Meadows. The show maps culture in ever-shrinking places. The village, however, remains a vibrant cell of well-being. Kostis Zafeirakis travels and traces the stories of those who live and create in the village. / Επεισόδιο: Μεγάλα Λιβάδια. Η εκπομπή χαρτογραφεί τον πολιτισμό σε τόπους που μικραίνουν χρόνο με τον χρόνο. Το χωριό, όμως, παραμένει ένα ολοζώντανο κύτταρο ευζωίας. Ο Κωστής Ζαφειράκης ταξιδεύει κι ανιχνεύει τις ιστορίες εκείνων που ζουν και δημιουργούν στο χωριό.

programme.title: Perimeter (E) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: Informative broadcast which focuses daily on current affairs and special topics, in concentric circles, with an emphasis on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the Community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: Seed E2 (E) / Σπόρος Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Seed of Ideas in the Prefectures of Fthiotida and Fokida. Successful ventures taking place in the prefecture of Fthiotida and in the prefecture of Fokida are presented. / Επεισόδιο: Σπόρος Iδεών στους Nομούς Φθιώτιδας και Φωκίδας. Το οδοιπορικό μας ξεκινάει από τους Β.Α πρόποδες του Παρνασσού, συνεχίζει προς το όρος Καλλίδρομο και καταλήγει στο βουνό της Οίτης. Παρουσιάζονται επιτυχημένα εγχειρήματα που λαμβάνουν χώρα στον νομό Φθιώτιδας και στον νομό Φωκίδας .

programme.title: Number cubes (E) / Αριθμοκυβάκια (Ε)
programme.desc: Are they numbers or cubes? Both of them. Αφού κάθε αριθμός αποτελείται από αντίστοιχα κυβάκια, αν βγάλεις ένα και το βάλεις σε ένα άλλο, τότε η πρόσθεση και η αφαίρεση γίνεται παιχνιδάκι.

programme.title: The Trucks (E) / Tα Φορτηγάκια (Ε)
programme.desc: Grandpa Ted trains his grandchildren, the Trucks, to one day become greats themselves, testing their skills through different missions. Για να τα προετοιμάσει, τους θέτει αθλητικές προκλήσεις.

programme.title: Molang (E) / Μολάνγκ (Ε)

programme.title: Porodica Serano

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is designed to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes aimed at children who play sports, no matter what level of success, will show the essential benefits of sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that there are many talented children in Montenegro who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation to at least one level higher. We want to draw attention to the potential that belongs only to us, that is undeniable, a potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Children's quiz / Dječiji kviz
programme.desc: This innovative project represents an important step towards the modernization of the educational process and the promotion of modern learning methods, adapted to the needs of elementary school students. The goal is for the quiz to encourage students' curiosity, creative thinking and the development of key life skills through interesting games, teamwork and solving logical tasks. / Ovaj inovativni projekat predstavlja važan korak ka modernizaciji obrazovnog procesa i promociji savremenih metoda učenja, prilagođenih potrebama učenika osnovnih škola. Cilj je da kviz kroz zanimljive igre, timski rad i rješavanje logičkih zadataka, kod učenika podstakne znatiželju, kreativno mišljenje i razvoj ključnih životnih vještina.

Priča koje su uticale na neke od najpopularnijih blokbastera današnjice, od Tolkinovog Gospodara prstenova do Igre prijestola Džordža Martina.

programme.title: Football - 1st CFL: Round 12: Future - Arsenal / Fudbal - 1. CFL: 12. kolo: Budućnost - Arsenal
programme.desc: The Montenegrin Football League was founded in 2004, but the first season was played in the 2006/2007 season. after the independence of the country. 12 clubs in the three-round competition system fought for the championship title, which was eventually won by Zeta from Golubovac, which remained the only championship title of Montenegro. Today, the number of clubs is reduced to 10, and 30 rounds are played. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for European Championship (w): Faroe Islands - Montenegro / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž): Farska ostrva - Crna Gora
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two stages. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group advances to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Balet tre sorelle
programme.desc: In this all-night modern ballet through movement, dance and music, togetherness, but also rivalry, female rebellion against conventions, traditions, dogma and patriarchal settings of the world, which is especially represented in small circles, is shown. / U ovom cjelovečernjem modernom baletu kroz pokret, ples i muziku se prikazuje zajedništvo, ali i rivalstvo, ženska pobuna protiv konvencija, tradicije, dogme i patrijarhalne postavke svijeta koja je pogotovo zastupljena u malim sredinama.

programme.title: Opet pakujemo majmune
programme.desc: Nebojša, a hyper-worked journalist, and Jelena, a literature student, after several bad experiences with tenants in rented apartments, rent an attic from the Nikolić family - Dragoljub, a retired architect, his wife Dragica, a housewife, and their teenage daughter Nate. In addition to parading non-stop through Nebojša and Jelena's living space, the Nikolićs soon bring all their family misunderstandings and problems to the attic. With such intrusions and interruptions, Jelena and Nebojša almost completely lose their intimacy. Of course, for a young loving couple eager for tenderness, privacy and healthy sex, this course of events means a crisis. The situation is further complicated by financial difficulties, which force Nebojša to work overtime, and Jelena to find a job with a businessman with dubious intentions. / Nebojša, hiperzaposleni novinar, i Jelena, student književnosti, poslije nekoliko loših podstanarskih iskustava po iznajmljenim stanovima iznajmljuju potkrovlje kod porodice Nikolić - Dragoljuba, arhitekte u penziji, njegove žene Dragice, domaćice, i njihove kćerke, tinejdžerke Nate. Pored toga što non - stop defiluju kroz Nebojšin i Jelenin životni prostor, Nikolići ubrzo donose u potkrovlje sve svoje porodične nesporazume i probleme. Ovakvim upadima i prekidima Jelena i Nebojša skoro u potpunosti gube svoju intimu. Naravno da za mladi ljubavni par željan nježnosti, privatnosti i zdravog seksa ovakav tok događaja znači - krizu. Situacija se dodatno komplikuje finansijskim poteškoćama, koje primoravaju Nebojšu da radi prekovremeno, a Jelenu da nađe posao kod biznismena sumnjivih namjera.

programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is designed to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. programme.desc: A space where current national and international news, sports, weather, traffic and economics are highlighted during your weekend mornings. / Espaço em que se dá relevo às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia nas manhas do seu fim de semana.

programme.title: The Year of the Bear / O Ano do Urso
programme.desc: Documentary that follows the life cycle of five different species of bears, filmed over the course of a year in different parts of the world: the European brown bear, the polar bear, the gray bear, the American black bear and the mythical and very rare Kermode bear. / Documentário que acompanha o ciclo de vida de cinco especies diferentes de ursos, filmadas ao longo de um ano em diferentes partes do mundo: o urso-pardo europeu, o urso-polar, o urso-cinzento, o urso-negro-americano e o mítico e raríssimo urso de kermode.

programme.title: Hora dos Portugueses
programme.desc: Daily magazine, with different perspectives, with Portuguese communities spread around the world, to portray the current ways of experiencing Portugueseness in different territories and recognize the achievements and achievements of the Portuguese who make up these groups of citizens. / Magazine diário, com diferentes olhares, junto de comunidades de portugueses espalhados pelo mundo, para retratar as atuais formas de viver a portugalidade nos diferentes territorios e reconhecer os feitos e conquistas dos portugueses que compõem estes grupos de cidadaos.

programme.title: Here Portugal - The Best Moments / Aqui Portugal - Os Melhores Momentos
programme.desc: Remember the best moments of the program that covers and warms hearts from north to south of the country, showcasing the best that Portugal has to offer. programme.title: Portugal Fenomenal
programme.desc: In this Phenomenal Portugal we have mysteries from north to south of the country. From Salazar's secret room to Manique do Intendente, a location thought to be the capital of the kingdom. In between, we visited the unfinished pavilions of Caldas da Rainha and climbed the map to visit one of the most beautiful schools. / Neste Portugal Fenomenal temos misterios de norte a sul do País. Do quarto secreto de Salazar a Manique do Intendente, uma localidade pensada para ser capital do reino. Pelo meio conhecemos os inacabados pavilhões das Caldas da Rainha e subimos no mapa para visitar uma das escolas mais bonitas.

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde

programme.desc: In the early 1960s, with the collapse of colonial empires all over the world, Salazar's Portugal fought a bloody war in its African territories. programme.desc: In Caravaggio's painting "Martha and Mary Magdalene", painted in 1598, there is a fine ivory comb with a broken tooth. programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Aston Villa - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: None of the last 20 Premier League matches between Tottenham Hotspur and Aston Villa have been drawn since a 1-1 stalemate in May 2012. Only two fixtures in the competition’s history have ever had more successive games without a draw: Newcastle v Spurs and Chelsea v Crystal Palace. Aston Villa have won four of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham Hotspur, as many as their previous 29 beforehand.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8
programme.desc: Liverpool have lost just one of their last 14 Premier League meetings with Manchester United, a 1-2 defeat at Old Trafford in August 2022. Indeed, since the start of 2018-19, this is the fewest defeats any side to face the Red Devils 3+ times in the competition has had against them. Manchester United are winless in their last nine Premier League games at Anfield since a 1-0 win in January 2016 under Louis van Gaal. Liverpool could become just the second side to avoid defeat in 10+ successive Premier League home games against the Red Devils, after Chelsea.

programme.title: Getafe vs Real Madrid - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 9
programme.desc: Getafe have lost their last seven LaLiga matches against Real Madrid, failing to score in six of them, after having scored in their previous two against the Whites in the competition without conceding a goal. Getafe have suffered 30 defeats in LaLiga against Real Madrid, their highest tally against a single opponent in their history in the top flight and against whom they have suffered the most home defeats in the competition.

Separated by borders, by checkpoints, and exile, the tells is inspiring “One Jersey…Many Roots” them is a single jersey, a shared dream, and a deep sense of responsibility to players come from every corner of Palestine and from communities scattered across the globe. What unites represent their people on and off the pitch that Palestine endures. This is not just in every match, they carry not just a ball but the weight of history, identity and hope. Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: FMP - SC Derby / Košarka - ABA liga: FMP - SC Derby
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Bundesliga: Wolfsburg - Stuttgart / Fudbal - Bundesliga: Wolfsburg - Stuttgart
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it. / Uz sve ono što nam je Nemačka podarila kroz istoriju ponosno stoji i Bundesliga. Najviši rang fudbalskog takmičenja osnovanog 1963. godine broji 18 ekipa koje svakog avgusta kreću u trku za popularnim tanjirom. Najviše puta ga je osvajao minhenski Bajern, čak 24 puta. Kultura navijanja, pune tribine i vrhunski fudbal je ono što krasi Bundesligu od njenih početaka, pa sve do danas. Ne propustite svakom mogućom prilikom da uživate u bundesligaškim susretima. Sigurno nećete požaliti.

programme.title: Water polo - Regional league: Radnički - Jadran / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Radnički - Jadran
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. After the first season, Italian representatives also joined the league, who soon gave up, while since 2014, the league has also included clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Football - Scottish League: Kilmarnock - Hearts / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Kilmarnock - Hearts
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship started its first season in 1890, and even then a rarity was established. The two teams then shared the championship title due to the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today's world-famous Glasgow Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles, and today's relatively unknown Dumbarton club. The league itself has changed names and format on a couple of occasions over the years, but since 2013 it is officially called the Scottish Professional Football League and is the highest level of Scottish football. The league is also marked by one of the biggest derbies in football history between two Glasgow teams, Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata menjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove Scottish Professional Football League i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obeležava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: A show for all fans of this sport, who are fed up with industrial, high-budget football, for those who are fed up with tactics and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third tier of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one game from all four groups of the Serbian league, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting contributions. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Volleyball: Russian league (w): Korabelka - Dinamo-Metar / Odbojka: Ruska liga (ž): Korabelka - Dinamo-Metar
programme.desc: Follow the matches of the Russian women's volleyball championship! This competition in its current format has been held since 1992. / Pratite mečeve ruskog prvenstva u odbojci za žene! Ovo takmičenje u postojećem formatu održava se počevši od 1992. godine.

programme.title: Football - Russian League: Rubin - Baltika / Fudbal - Ruska liga: Rubin - Baltika
programme.desc: The Russian Football League, as the successor of the Soviet Union, records its competitive beginnings in 1936, although football has been played on the territory of the Union since the 1900s. The most successful team during that time was Spartak Moscow, although since the beginning of the second half of the century, clubs like CSKA Moscow and Zenit from St. Petersburg have been more successful. Petersburg. The league will continue until the 2012/2013 season. played in the term spring - autumn due to the long winter and since then it has been played classically European autumn - spring. Large financial investments in Russian football clubs have brought the league very close to the UEFA ranking of the coefficients of the first leagues in Europe. / Ruska fudbalska liga kao naslednik Sovjetskog saveza beleži svoje takmičarske početke od 1936. godine iako se fudbal na području saveza igrao još od 1900ih. Najuspješnija ekipa za to vreme je Moskovski Spartak iako od početka drugog dela veka uspješniji su klubovi poput CSKA Moskve i Zenita iz St. Petersburga. Liga se sve do sezone 2012./2013. igrala u terminu proleće - jesen zbog dugačke zime te se od tada igra klasično evropski jesen - proleće. Velika finansijska ulaganja u ruske fudbalske klubove jako su približili ligu na Uefinoj lestvici koeficijenata prvih liga po snazi u Evropi.

programme.title: Small sports - big sportsmen / Mali sportovi - veliki sportisti
programme.desc: Stories about sports that are not so represented in our area and competitors who, despite this, achieve significant results. / Priče o sportovima koji nisu toliko zastupljeni na našim prostorima i takmičarima koji uprkos tome ostvaruju značajne rezultate.

programme.title: Hockey - NHL: Washington Capitals - Vancouver Canucks / Hokej - NHL: Washington Capitals - Vancouver Canucks
programme.desc: The National Hockey League is the most prestigious club hockey competition in the world, which dates back to 1917, when the competition was formed and operated with two other North American hockey associations. Since 1926, the NHL has become the main and most important hockey association and thus the competition in North America. The competition itself is divided into two divisions, Western and Eastern, and after the regular season, playoffs for the Stanley Cup trophy are played. / Natonal Hockey League je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dve severnoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Arena izazov
programme.desc: A show that gives you the opportunity to get to know the presenters of our television better! Find out what their professional path looked like and what challenges they faced on the way to success. / Emisija koja vam pruža priliku da bolje upoznate voditelje naše televizije! Saznajte kako je izgledao njihov profesionalni put i sa kojim su se sve izazovima suočavali na putu ka uspehu.

programme.title: Future stars of the Arena / Buduće zvezde Arene
programme.desc: We present to you successful young people who represent the future of sports in Serbia. Get to know sportsmen and women who are already achieving exceptional results in junior competitions. / Predstavljamo vam uspešne mlade ljude koji predstavljaju budućnost sporta u Srbiji. Upoznajte sportistkinje i sportiste koji već u juniorskim takmičenjima ostvaruju izuzetne rezultate.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Sloga - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sloga - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Without the American contacts of the painter Mary Cassatt, the works of Impressionists such as Monet and Renoir, for whom the global market is literally going crazy today, would probably be sold for ridiculous sums, just like they were during their lifetime. programme.title: MODERN, AVANTGARDE: The story of art of the first half of the 20th century - The world as a poem / MODERNA, AVANTGARDA: Příběh umění 1. poloviny 20. století - Svět jako báseň
programme.desc: Never before in history has the beginning of a century been so full of stormy discoveries, inventions and events that changed the life of society and the form of art. Europe was in the throes of technical change, war and revolution, and Czech artists were looking for ways to express the new freedom. New documentary series by A. Kisila (hide subtitles) / Ještě nikdy v historii nebyl začátek století tak plný bouřlivých objevů, vynálezů a událostí, ktere měnily život společnosti i podobu umění. Evropa se zmítala ve víru technických změn, války a revolucí a čeští umělci hledali způsoby, jak vyjádřit novou svobodu. Nový dokumentární cyklus A. Kisila (skryte titulky)

programme.title: Marilyn - the birth of an icon / Marilyn - zrod ikony
programme.desc: Most of all, she wanted to be a good actress. The position of sex symbol and haunted doe was destroying her. French documentary (hide subtitles) / Ze všeho nejvíc chtěla být dobrou herečkou. Pozice sexuálního symbolu a štvane laně ji ničila. Francouzský dokument (skryte titulky)

programme.title: The Art of Dubbing 2025 / Umění dabingu 2025
programme.desc: Is it hard to dub emotions? Crying, kissing or fighting? Actors Dagmar Čárová, Miroslav Hanuš or Jiří Lábus will not only show it to us, but will also share their dubbing experience. We will also take a look at Přelouč, where the František Filipovský Awards for dubbing were also awarded this year (hide subtitles) / Je těžke dabovat emoce? Pláč, polibky nebo rvačku? Herci Dagmar Čárová, Miroslav Hanuš nebo Jiří Lábus nám to nejen předvedou, ale zároveň se podělí o sve dabingove zkušenosti. Podíváme se take do Přelouče, kde se i letos udílely Ceny Františka Filipovskeho za dabing (skryte titulky)

programme.title: Guide to the artistic territory - Kateřina Šedá / Průvodce výtvarným územím - Kateřina Šedá

Z ženo in tremi hčerami se hitro ustalijo.V novem okolju doživljajo tako srečne kot manj srečne trenutke, od rojstev, praznovanj, do požarov, soočiti pa se morajo predvsem z dejstvom, da si ni tako lahko ustvariti stabilen dom kot izgleda na prvi pogled.

programme.title: Columbo: Columbo and the Nightlife / Columbo: Columbo in nočno življenje
programme.desc: Columbo is an American television series starring Peter Falk as Detective Columbo, head of the Blood Crimes Unit of the Los Angeles Police Department. / Columbo je ameriška serija, v kateri Peter Falk nastopa kot detektiv Columbo, vodja oddelka za krvne zločine pri policiji Los Angelesa.

programme.title: Jezdeci na dolge steze
programme.desc: In Missouri, after the end of the Civil War, outlaws Frank and Jesse James join a group consisting of the Coleman brothers, Jim and Bob Younger, and the Miller boys. Together they form a gang that attacks carriages and banks. A bank robbery ends in a shootout with government men. Some of the members of the gang also have better halves: Coleman Younger spends time with the unyielding Belle Start, while Ed Miller is engaged to the reserved Beth. The story begins with a large and successful bank robbery in Missouri and ends with a bank robbery in Northfield, in which there is a massacre of Jessie James's gang. Between the two groundbreaking events, the film shows how the men meet their loved ones and report to them, how there are conflicts within the gang, how they drink in the city pubs and have fun with the buyable women in brothels, how they think about calming down, withdrawing and starting to live a normal life. All the while, Pinkerton's corrupt agency is on their trail, killing their innocent relatives due to intimidation, and this is why public opinion is increasingly on the side of the outcasts. The breakthrough and massacre comes when Jessie James' gang attacks in Northfield. / V Missouriju se po koncu državljanske vojne izobčenca Frank in Jesse James pridružita skupini, ki jo sestavljajo bratje Coleman, Jim in Bob Younger ter Millerjeva fanta. Skupaj ustanovijo tolpo, ki napada kočije in banke. Rop banke se konča s strelskim obračunom z vladnimi možmi. Nekateri od članov tolpe imajo tudi boljše polovice: Coleman Younger preživlja čas z nepopustljivo Belle Start, medtem ko je Ed Miller zaročen z zadržano Beth.Zgodba se prične z velikim in uspešnim bančnim ropom v Missuriju in zaokroži z bančnim ropom v Northfieldu, v katerem je prišlo do masakra tolpe Jessie Jamesa. Med obema prelomnima dogodkoma film prikazuje, kako moški srečujejo svoje drage in se z njimi poročajo, kako prihaja do spopadov znotraj bande, kako popivajo po mestnih krčmah in se zabavajo s kupljivimi ženskami v kurbiščih, kako razmišljajo, da bi se umirili, umaknili in pričelo živeti normalno življenje. Ves čas pa jim je na sledi Pinkertonova skorumpirana agencija, ki zaradi ustrahovanja pobija njihove nedolžne sorodnike, prav zaradi tega pa je javno mnenje vse bolj na strani izobčencev. Do preloma in masakra pa pride ob napadu tolpe Jessie Jamesa v Northfieldu.

programme.title: Kontejnerske vojne: Videti zeleno
programme.desc: The all-new "Container Wars" series proves that a good bank balance doesn't guarantee success in the lightning-fast world of port auctions. In this high-stakes game, it takes both a good nose for goods and nerves of steel to defeat opponents who also want to get rich. Because large sums of money are involved, this is not a game, but a real war. Meet auctioneer John Kunkle and the auctioneers who compete for the best bargains, including Jason R. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. Who will emerge victorious from the "Container Wars"? / Povsem nova serija "Kontejnerske vojne" dokazuje, da dobro stanje na bančnem računu še ne zagotavlja uspeha v svetu pristaniških dražb, v katerem se vse dogaja z bliskovitim tempom. V tej igri visokih vložkov sta za premagovanje nasprotnikov, ki si prav tako želijo obogateti, potrebna tudi dober nos za blago in jekleni živci. Ker gre za velike vsote denarja, to ni nikakršna igra, pač pa prava vojna. Spoznajte dražbarja Johna Kunkla in udeležence dražb, ki se med seboj borijo za najboljše kupčije, med katerimi sta tudi Jason R. Hughes in Matthew Gaus. Kdo bo iz "Kontejnerskih vojn" izšel kot zmagovalec?

programme.title: Janitor Krause: There Must Be Order: Gay Assault / Hišnik Krause: red mora biti: Gejevski napad
programme.desc: Dog trainer and show host Graeme Hall works to restore harmony and with over 10 years' experience has built a reputation for finding quick but long-lasting solutions to almost any dog ​​behavior problem. Serija prikazuje Graema, ki prepotuje Združeno kraljestvo, da bi pomagal lastnikom mladičev in odraslih psov z vedenjskimi težavami.

programme.title: Futsal: Friendly match: Slovenia - Croatia / Futsal: Prijateljska tekma: Slovenija - Hrvaška
programme.desc: In the preparatory period between seasons and before major competitions, clubs and national teams maintain their form by playing friendly matches. programme.title: Basketball (M): Cedevita - Aris, Eurocup 2025, Group A / Košarka (M): Cedevita - Aris, Eurocup 2025, Skupina A
programme.desc: The Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of the "Euroleague Basketball". The strongest basketball clubs that failed to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues mostly participate in it. Clubs secure their place in the Eurocup through national championships and cups and through invitations, i.e. "wildcards". / Evrokup je nastal leta 2002 kot drugo tekmovanje "Evrolige Basketball". V tem tekmovanju se borijo najmočnejši košarkarski klubi, ki se niso uspeli uvrstiti v Evroligo, v njem pa večinoma sodelujejo klubi iz top 15 najmočnejših evropskih lig. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Hockey (M): Olimpija - Salzburg, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Olimpija - Salzburg, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The league has existed under various names since its inception in 1923, with an interruption during World War II. Only Austrian teams competed in it until 2005, and then over the years Slovenian, Croatian, Czech, Italian, Hungarian and Slovak teams joined. 14 teams compete in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Union Berlin - Borussia M., Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Union Berlin - Borussia M., Bundesliga 2025/2026

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Slovenia - Switzerland, Qualification for the 2026 World Cup / Nogomet (M): Slovenija - Švica, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2026
programme.desc: A month ago, Switzerland taught the Slovenian national football team a real lesson, will anything be different in Stožice? More than two hundred members of the International Football Association (FIFA) are competing in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Cup in football. The long and very tense qualifications differ depending on which continental confederation it is. What they all have in common is that it is an overture to the final tournament. The importance of the qualifications is further enhanced by the fact that no one except the host has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions must fight for the opportunity to defend the title. / Švica je pred mesecem dni slovenski nogometni reprezentanci odčitala pravo lekcijo, bo v Stožicah kaj drugače?Več kot dvesto članic Mednarodne nogometne organizacije (FIFA) tekmuje v kvalifikacijah za glavni turnir svetovnega prvenstva v nogometu.Dolge in zelo napete kvalifikacije se razlikujejo glede na to, za katero kontinentalno konfederacijo gre. Vsem pa je skupno to, da gre za uverturo v končni turnir.Pomen kvalifikacij še povečuje dejstvo, da na zaključnem turnirju nima pravice sodelovati nihče razen gostitelja, svetovni prvaki pa se morajo izboriti za priložnost za obrambo naslova.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.
