programme.desc: 1885. Chef Eugenie has been cooking for the famous gourmet Dodin for twenty years in the idyllic French countryside. Together they create dishes that satisfy even the most spoiled palates. Mutual admiration eventually blossoms into a romantic relationship, but Eugenie likes to be free, so she doesn't want to get married. One summer day, however, Dodin decides to cook for his beloved for the first time... Original title: LA PASSION DE DODIN BOUFFANT Year of production: 2023 Country: France, Belgium Genre: romantic drama Director: Anh Hung Tran Screenplay: Anh Hung Tran based on the novel by Marcel Rouff Starring: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Bonnie Chagneau-Ravoire, Patrick dAssumçao. / 1885. Kuharska mojstrica Eugenie na idiličnem francoskem podeželju že dvajset let kuha za znamenitega sladokusca Dodina. Skupaj ustvarjata jedi, ki zadovoljijo celo najbolj razvajene brbončice. Medsebojno občudovanje sčasoma preraste v romantično razmerje, toda Eugenie je rada svobodna, zato se ne želi poročiti. Nekega poletnega dne pa se Dodin odloči, da bo prvič kuhal za svojo ljubljeno …Originalni naslov: LA PASSION DE DODIN BOUFFANTLeto produkcije: 2023Država: Francija, BelgijaŽanr: romantična dramaRežija: Anh Hung TranScenarij: Anh Hung Tran po romanu Marcela RouffaIgrajo: Juliette Binoche, Benoît Magimel, Bonnie Chagneau-Ravoire, Patrick dAssumçao.

programme.title: Century of the Soviet Union, British documentary series, 2/3, Mon. / Stoletje Sovjetske zveze, britanska dokumentarna serija, 2/3, pon.
programme.sub-title: The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; After five years of civil war, the Soviet Union was founded on December 30, 1922, the first socialist country in the world, which left an indelible mark on the entire twentieth century. Documentary series in three / The Soviet Union, 100th Anniversary 1922; Po petih letih državljanske vojne je bila 30. decembra 1922 ustanovljena Sovjetska zveza, prva socialistična država na svetu, ki je vtisnila neizbrisen pečat vsemu dvajsetemu stoletju. Dokumentarna serija v treh
programme.desc: Part 2: With the intensification of the Cold War in the 1950s, the space race and the construction of the Berlin Wall, the Cuban Missile Crisis brought the world to the brink of nuclear war. The leaders of the superpowers managed to find a peaceful solution, but soon both left the stage of history. In the Soviet Union, which tried with all its might to catch up with the West, Khrushchev was deposed due to an unsuccessful agricultural policy, and Kennedy died in an assassination attempt. THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Great Britain / 2022 / Director: Lyndy Saville. / 2. del:Z zaostrovanjem hladne vojne v 50. letih 20. stoletja, vesoljsko tekmo in gradnjo berlinskega zidu se je svet ob kubanski raketni krizi znašel na robu jedrske vojne. Voditeljema velesil je uspelo najti mirno rešitev, a sta kmalu oba zapustila oder zgodovine. V Sovjetski zvezi, ki si je z vsemi silami prizadevala dohiteti Zahod, so zaradi neuspešne kmetijske politike odstavili Hruščova, Kennedy pa je umrl v atentatu.THE SOVIET UNION, 100TH ANNIVERSARY 1922 / Velika Britanija / 2022 / Režija: Lyndy Saville.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: 2nd competition for jazz ensembles and soloists: Winners' concert with the Big Band of RTV Slovenia, recording from Studio 14 of Radio Slovenia, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: 2. tekmovanje za jazzovske ansamble in soliste: Koncert nagrajencev z Big bandom RTV Slovenija, posnetek iz Studia 14 Radia Slovenija, pon.

The artistic director of the competition is saxophonist Primoz Fleischman, otherwise a member of the Big Band of RTV Slovenia. / R: Šuligoj Jaka... Tekmovanje jazzovskih ansamblov in solistov je v Sloveniji edinstveno. Namenjeno je mladim glasbenikom, ki so še v teku šolanja. Spodbuja jih k poglabljanju znanj, nadaljnjem izobraževanju, jih motivira in jim nudi priznavanje njihovih sposobnosti in prizadevanja. Skupno je na prvih dveh tekmovanjih nastopilo več kot 50 mladih nadarjenih tekmovalcev. Za korektnost in strokovnost tekmovanja je skrbela petčlanska strokovna žirija, ki so jo sestavljali najuglednejši instrumentalisti in glasbeni pedagogi. programme.title: Witnesses: Vlado Klopčič, Mon. / Pričevalci: Vlado Klopčič, pon.
programme.sub-title: Vlado Klopčič, born in 1904 in Ljubljana, comes from a wealthy railroad family with a strong religious upbringing. He spent his youth in Mosty, at a time when life was peaceful and dignified. During World War II, he joined the resistance as a teenager / Vlado Klopčič, rojen leta 1904 v Ljubljani, izhaja iz premožne železničarske družine z močno versko vzgojo. Mladost je preživel v Mostah, v času, ko je življenje potekalo mirno in dostojno. Med drugo svetovno vojno se je kot najstnik vključil v odporniš
programme.desc: After the war, he encountered poverty and a complicated political environment. He was not a member of the party, which made it impossible for him to advance in his career. The witness speaks openly about communist repression, post-war massacres, staged trials and the fates of people who were labeled traitors by the authorities. His own brother was shot as a -suspected- informant. Klopčič points out abuses of power, political staffing and injustices caused by the one-party system. Despite everything, he himself remained alive, as a witness of a time that he did not forget. / Po vojni se je srečal z revščino in zapletenim političnim okoljem. Ni bil član partije, kar mu je onemogočilo karierno napredovanje. Pričevalec odkrito spregovori o komunistični represiji, povojnih pobojih, montiranih procesih ter usodah ljudi, ki so jih oblasti označile za izdajalce. Njegov lastni brat je bil ustreljen kot -suma- obveščevalec. Klopčič opozarja na zlorabe oblasti, politična kadrovanja in krivice, ki jih je povzročil enopartijski sistem. Kljub vsemu je sam ostal pri življenju, kot pričevalec nekega časa, ki ni pozabil.

programme.title: General Boroević, documentary film, Mon. / General Boroević, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Pečenko Valentin... The life story of the charismatic defender of Soča, General Svetozar Boroević, the only non-German field marshal of the Austro-Hungarian monarchy. / R: Pečenko Valentin... Življenjska zgodba karizmatičnega branilca Soče, generala Svetozara Boroevića, edinega nenemškega feldmaršala avstro-ogrske monarhije.
programme.desc: Director and screenwriter Valentin Pečenko portrays Boroević's journey "from glory and stars to fall and oblivion", which is also symbolically the story of the collapse of the eternal Habsburg monarchy. One of the greatest military leaders of the First World War is forgotten and died in poverty in May 1920 at the age of 64 in Klagenfurt. His funeral in Vienna, which was attended by thousands of people, was held without state honors. His grave was paid for by the last Austrian emperor, Charles, from exile. General Boroević, as the commander of the Soča army, defeated the Italians against all expectations, who were clearly superior in both infantry and weapons. The mayor of Ljubljana, Ivan Tavčar, named him an honorary citizen of Ljubljana in August 1915 for his services in the defense of the Soča front, but he was removed from this list already in June 1919 at the suggestion of the city's personal legal council. In 2009, the city municipality of Ljubljana returned the title of honorary citizen to General Boroević. Many renowned domestic and foreign historians and history scholars contribute to the diversity of the film. They talk about General Boroević in seven European languages ​​and evaluate the role and importance of the defender of the Carpathians and the legendary commander of the Soča front from different perspectives. In Primorska and the areas along the Soča River, his memory is still very much alive, as are the legends and ice names after him. Many lesser-known facts about Boroević and the First World War will be presented to the wider Slovenian public for the first time in the film. / Režiser in scenarist Valentin Pečenko odstira Boroevićevo pot »od slave in zvezd do padca in pozabe«, ki je simbolično tudi zgodba propada večne habsburške monarhije. Eden največjih vojskovodij prve svetovne vojne je pozabljen in v pomanjkanju maja 1920 umrl v 64. letu starosti v Celovcu. Njegov pogreb na Dunaju, ki se ga je udeležilo več tisoč ljudi, je potekal brez državniških časti. Grob mu je iz izgnanstva plačal zadnji avstrijski cesar Karel. General Boroević je kot poveljnik soške armade proti vsem pričakovanjem porazil Italijane, ki so bili v izraziti premoči tako v pehoti kot orožju. Ljubljanski župan Ivan Tavčar ga je zaradi zaslug pri obrambi soške fronte avgusta 1915 imenoval za častnega meščana Ljubljane, a so ga že junija 1919 na predlog mestnega personalno pravnega sveta črtali s tega seznama. Leta 2009 je mestna občina Ljubljana generalu Boroeviću naziv častnega meščana vrnila. K raznolikosti filma pripomorejo številni priznani domači in tuji zgodovinarji ter preučevalci zgodovine. O generalu Boroeviću spregovorijo v sedmih evropskih jezikih in z različnih vidikov presojajo vlogo in pomen branilca Karpatov in legendarnega poveljnika soške fronte. Na Primorskem in krajih ob reki Soči je spomin nanj še vedno zelo živ, kot tudi legende in ledinska imena po njem. Marsikatero manj znano dejstvo o Boroeviću in prvi svetovni vojni pa bo širši slovenski javnosti v filmu predstavljeno prvič.

programme.desc: The architect decided to buy an apartment in Trieste because life in the seaside city is close to her, and in addition, real estate prices there are more bearable than in Slovenia. Iz postaranega stanovanja z opremo iz 70. let prejšnjega stoletja je s prenovo ustvarila svetel, barvit dom z edinstvenim vzdušjem.Znova se odpravljamo v Zeleni raj nad Litijo, kjer nas bo lastnik Miha Kos popeljal skozi slikovit rastlinski park na 600 metrih nadmorske višine. programme.title: Schonbrunn Summer Concert 2025, Vienna Philharmonic, Piotr Beczała and Tugan Sokiev, Mon. / Poletni koncert iz Schonbrunna 2025, Dunajski filharmoniki, Piotr Beczała in Tugan Sokijev, pon.
programme.desc: The summer concert in the picturesque castle gardens of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna is one of the world's most popular outdoor music events. Schonbrunn Park is otherwise a protected area and is usually closed in the evening; it is opened to the public only once a year, for the summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic, which has been playing there since 2004. This time the conductor is in the hands of Tugan Sokijev, and the Vienna Boys' Choir, founded by Slovenian bishop, choirmaster and composer Jurij Slatkonja, also performs for the first time at the concert. The famous Polish tenor Piotr Bezcała will perform as a soloist, and the concert program once again offers popular classical music from different eras. / Poletni koncert v slikovitih grajskih vrtovih dvorca Schonbrunn na Dunaju je eden izmed najbolj priljubljenih svetovnih glasbenih dogodkov na prostem. Park Schonbrunn je sicer zaščiteno območje in je zvečer navadno zaprt; za javnost ga odprejo le enkrat letno, za poletni koncert Dunajskih filharmonikov, ki tam igrajo že vse od leta 2004. Taktirka je tokrat v rokah Tugana Sokijeva, na koncertu pa prvič nastopa tudi Zbor dunajskih dečkov, ki ga je ustanovil slovenski škof, zborovodja in skladatelj Jurij Slatkonja. Kot solist bo nastopil sloviti poljski tenorist Piotr Bezcała, program koncerta pa vnovič ponuja priljubljeno klasično glasbo različnih obdobij.

programme.title: Asia: The Frozen North, British documentary series, 3/7 / Azija: Zamrznjeni sever, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/7
programme.sub-title: Asia; The documentary series Asia explores the extraordinary nature and natural wonders of the largest continent on Earth. It takes us through the most stunning Asian landscapes - from the world's highest peaks in the Himalayas to the jungles of Borneo, from the polar wilderness of Siberia to coral reefs. / Asia; Dokumentarna serija Azija raziskuje izjemno naravo in naravna čudesa največje celine na Zemlji. Popelje nas skozi najosupljivejše azijske pokrajine – od najvišjih vrhov sveta v Himalaji do džungel Bornea, od polarne divjine Sibirije do koralnih mo
programme.desc: Part 3: The Frozen North In North Asia, life defies extreme conditions. In Lake Baikal, seal pups must learn to swim under the ice at an early age. Hokkaido's hot springs shelter dancing cranes. In Tibet, for a lone Himalayan wolf, every hunt is a test of endurance, and in Japan, bats hibernate right under the snow. In Arctic Russia, starving polar bears wait longer and longer on desolate shores for the sea to freeze again. ASIA / Great Britain / 2024 / Director: Henry M Mix. / 3. del: Zamrznjeni severV severni Aziji življenje kljubuje skrajnim razmeram. V Bajkalskem jezeru se morajo tjulnji mladiči že zgodaj naučiti plavati pod ledom. Topli vrelci na Hokaidu dajejo zavetje plešočim žerjavom. V Tibetu je za osamljenega himalajskega volka vsak lov preizkušnja vzdržljivosti, na Japonskem pa netopirji prezimujejo kar pod snegom. V arktični Rusiji sestradani severni medvedi na pustih obalah čedalje dlje čakajo, da bo morje spet zaledenelo. ASIA / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Henry M Mix.

programme.desc: Lotto is the most popular game of chance in Slovenia, as more than 860,000 Slovenians of legal age play it. programme.title: Heads Up - The Glorious History of the Blue Pill: Fat Earnings UK Documentary Series 2/2 Mon. / Glavo pokonci – veličastna zgodovina modre tabletke: Mastni zaslužki, britanska dokumentarna serija, 2/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Keeping It Up; The documentary series chronicles the discovery and development of Viagra, the first pill to treat erectile dysfunction, which, a quarter of a century ago, is considered by many to have caused a second sexual revolution comparable to the invention of the birth control pill. Pharmacist / Keeping It Up; Dokumentarna serija prikazuje odkritje in razvoj viagre, prve tablete za zdravljenje motnje erekcije, ki je pred četrt stoletja po mnenju mnogih povzročila drugo spolno revolucijo, primerljivo z iznajdbo kontracepcijskih tablet. Farmacevt
programme.desc: Part 2: Big Money When Viagra hit the market in 1998, it became the best-selling and most counterfeited drug of all time. According to some estimates, the counterfeiters even earned more from it than the manufacturer, the pharmaceutical giant Pfizer. After a few years, as competing drugs emerged, Pfizer's market share declined. TV commercials featuring celebrities, politicians and athletes promoting Viagra didn't help either. Pfizer resorted to bribing doctors and therefore paid a billion fine in the United States. However, this was low compared to the profit Viagra brought to the manufacturer. In the last decade, viagra has become a tool that many people use for fun and no longer for the treatment of erectile dysfunction, for which it was originally intended. KEEPING IT UP / Great Britain / 2023 / Director: Stephen Bennett. / 2. del: Mastni zaslužkiKo je viagra leta 1998 prišla na trg, je postala najbolj prodajano in najpogosteje ponarejano zdravilo vseh časov. Ponarejevalci so po nekaterih ocenah z njo zaslužili celo več kot proizvajalec, farmacevtski velikan Pfizer. Po nekaj letih, ko so se pojavila konkurenčna zdravila, se je Pfizerjev tržni delež zmanjšal. Pomagali niso niti televizijski oglasi, v katerih so viagro oglaševale znane osebnosti, politiki in športniki. Pfizer se je zatekel k podkupovanju zdravnikov in zato v Združenih državah Amerike plačal milijardno kazen. Vendar je bila ta nizka glede na dobiček, ki ga je viagra prinesla proizvajalcu. V zadnjem desetletju je viagra postala pripomoček, ki ga mnogi uporabljajo za zabavo in ne več za zdravljenje motnje erekcije, čemur je bila sprva namenjena.KEEPING IT UP / Velika Britanija / 2023 / Režija: Stephen Bennett.

programme.desc: Júlia Lopez and Joan Raventos are in charge of delivering the most outstanding information in the noon edition of the weekend's Telenotícies. / Júlia Lopez i Joan Raventos son els encarregats de fer arribar les informacions mes destacades en l’edicio del migdia del Telenotícies del cap de setmana.

programme.title: Fishermans Friends
programme.desc: London executives from a record company arrive in a remote Cornish village to celebrate a bachelor party, where they meet a group of fishermen who sing sea songs. As a result of a joke, one of the executives stays in the village to try to get a contract with the group of singers for the record company. Optimistic British comedy (pure feel good) starring ten fishermen from Cornwall and the non-professional folk group of which they are a part. Based (quite loosely) on a true story, the film's cast is led by James Purefoy (Momentum, Altered Carbon, The Following, Roma), Daniel Mays (1917, Infiltrado) and Tuppence Middleton (War of the Currents, Double Identity: Jaque at MI5). / Uns executius londinencs duna discogràfica arriben a un poble remot de Cornualla per celebrar un comiat de solter, on coneixen un grup de pescadors que canten cançons de mar. A resultes duna broma, un dels executius es queda al poble per mirar daconseguir un contracte amb el grup de cantants per a la discogràfica.Optimista comèdia britànica (pur feel good) protagonitzada per deu pescadors de Cornualla i el grup de folk no professional del qual formen part. Basada (bastant lliurement) en una història real, encapçalen el repartiment de la pel·lícula James Purefoy (Momentum, Altered Carbon, The Following, Roma), Daniel Mays (1917, Infiltrado) i Tuppence Middleton (La guerra dels corrents, Doble identidad: Jaque al MI5).

programme.title: La decisio
programme.desc: A woman suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis decides to end her suffering through euthanasia with the help of her husband. However, the decision brings with it a series of conflicts. A truly luxurious cast headed by Susan Sarandon (Death Penalty), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (The Piano) and Lindsay Duncan (An Exceptional Gift) star in this drama with family relationships as the center of the plot and euthanasia as a backdrop that does not lack a sense of humor. Directed by Roger Michell (Notting Hill) and written by Christian Torpe, this moving and tender story shows the last family reunion of a woman with a terminal illness who has decided to end her life. The protagonist, who wants to die with dignity before her physical deterioration leaves her totally invalid, will have to deal with the incomprehension of some members of her family. / Una dona que pateix esclerosi lateral amiotròfica decideix acabar amb el seu sofriment per mitjà de leutanàsia amb lajuda del seu marit. No obstant, la decisio porta amb si una sèrie de conflictes.Un repartiment dautèntic luxe encapçalat per Susan Sarandon (Pena de mort), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (El piano) i Lindsay Duncan (Un do excepcional) protagonitza aquest drama amb les relacions familiars com a centre de la trama i leutanàsia com a telo de fons al qual no li falta sentit de lhumor.Dirigida per Roger Michell (Notting Hill) i escrita per Christian Torpe, aquesta commovedora i tendra història mostra lúltima reunio familiar duna dona amb una malaltia terminal que ha decidit posar fi a la seva vida. La protagonista, que vol morir amb dignitat abans que la seva deterioracio física la deixi totalment invàlida, haurà de bregar amb la incomprensio dalguns membres de la seva família.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte
programme.desc: In the area called Devil's Island in Lubeck there are plots with beautiful gardens, but when Anke and Gerd Siebert's robotic lawnmower escapes and stumbles upon a corpse on the neighbors' plot, this idyllic peace disappears. / A la zona anomenada Illa del Diable de Lubeck hi ha unes parcel·les amb uns jardins preciosos, però quan el robot tallagespa de lAnke i en Gerd Siebert sescapa i es topa amb un cadàver a la parcel·la dels veïns, aquesta pau idíl·lica desapareix.

programme.desc: Les principals diades del calendari casteller.

programme.title: Col·lapse: Episode 4 / Col·lapse: Episodi 4
programme.desc: Ken Follett, Martina Klein and Xavier Sala i Martín will visit the program this Saturday. Ken Follett, the British author who has sold more than 200 million books worldwide, will visit the program to present his latest novel, The Circle of Days. / Aquest dissabte visitaran el programa Ken Follett, Martina Klein i Xavier Sala i Martín. Ken Follett, lautor britànic que ha venut mes de 200 milions de llibres arreu del mon, visitarà el programa per presentar-nos la seva última novel·la, El cercle dels dies.

programme.title: Marcians: I am no longer who I was. Cal Eril's little one. / Marcians: Jo ja no soc qui era. El petit de Cal Eril.
programme.desc: Four years ago now, the El petit de Cal Eril project, led by the musician Joan Pons, was put on hold. After a last concert at home, at the Teatre de ca l'Eril de Guissona, the line-up split up. / Ara fa quatre anys el projecte de El petit de Cal Eril, liderat pel músic Joan Pons, va quedar en suspens. Despres dun darrer concert a casa, al Teatre de ca lEril de Guissona, la formacio es va separar.

programme.title: The Final Call
programme.desc: After ingesting a powerful poison in pills, Captain Karan Sachdev arrives on Skyline Flight 502. Shortly after takeoff, Karan watches in panic as his co-pilot is accidentally poisoned. / Despres damagar un potent verí en píndoles, el capità Karan Sachdev arriba al vol 502 de lSkyline. Poc despres de lenlairament, en Karan veu amb pànic com el seu copilot es enverinat accidentalment.

programme.title: The Final Call
programme.desc: After the two co-pilots are poisoned, Karan calls the tower and requests an emergency landing. Anticipating that it could be a kidnapping, Kiran asks for help from the Anti-Terrorist Squad. / Despres que els dos copilots hagin estat enverinats, en Karan truca a la torre i sol·licita un aterratge demergència. Preveient que es pugui tractar dun segrest, la Kiran demana ajuda a lEsquadro Antiterrorista.

Basada (bastant lliurement) en una història real, encapçalen el repartiment de la pel·lícula James Purefoy (Momentum, Altered Carbon, The Following, Roma), Daniel Mays (1917, Infiltrado) i Tuppence Middleton (La guerra dels corrents, Doble identidad: Jaque al MI5).

programme.title: La decisio
programme.desc: A woman suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis decides to end her suffering through euthanasia with the help of her husband. However, the decision brings with it a series of conflicts. A truly luxurious cast headed by Susan Sarandon (Death Penalty), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (The Piano) and Lindsay Duncan (An Exceptional Gift) star in this drama with family relationships as the center of the plot and euthanasia as a backdrop that does not lack a sense of humor. Directed by Roger Michell (Notting Hill) and written by Christian Torpe, this moving and tender story shows the last family reunion of a woman with a terminal illness who has decided to end her life. The protagonist, who wants to die with dignity before her physical deterioration leaves her totally invalid, will have to deal with the incomprehension of some members of her family. / Una dona que pateix esclerosi lateral amiotròfica decideix acabar amb el seu sofriment per mitjà de leutanàsia amb lajuda del seu marit. No obstant, la decisio porta amb si una sèrie de conflictes.Un repartiment dautèntic luxe encapçalat per Susan Sarandon (Pena de mort), Kate Winslet (The Reader (El lector)), Mia Wasikowska (Stoker), Sam Neill (El piano) i Lindsay Duncan (Un do excepcional) protagonitza aquest drama amb les relacions familiars com a centre de la trama i leutanàsia com a telo de fons al qual no li falta sentit de lhumor.Dirigida per Roger Michell (Notting Hill) i escrita per Christian Torpe, aquesta commovedora i tendra història mostra lúltima reunio familiar duna dona amb una malaltia terminal que ha decidit posar fi a la seva vida. La protagonista, que vol morir amb dignitat abans que la seva deterioracio física la deixi totalment invàlida, haurà de bregar amb la incomprensio dalguns membres de la seva família.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte

programme.desc: Earth is facing a threat greater than what civilization has experienced before. programme.desc: SVU-teamet utreder en serie overgrepp mot kvinnliga psykiatriker och arbetsgruppen firar en befodran.

programme.title: Law And order: Special victims unit
programme.desc: Benson tries to juggle work and her new role as foster mother to baby Noah. Amaro arrests an underage prostitute with connections to Noah's mother who was murdered. Amaro's undercover work starts a trafficking chain that puts everyone in danger. / Benson forsoker jonglera arbete och sin nya roll som fostermor for bebisen Noah. Amaro arresterar en minderårig prostituerad med kopplingar till Noahs mamma som blev mordad. Amaros undercover-arbete startar en handelsekedja som forsatter alla i fara.

programme.title: Gardsgårdsserien
programme.desc: We call The Pope has been the go-to solution for as long as anyone can remember when someone needs a goalkeeper in Sveg. He wants nothing more than to finish, despite the risk he takes. / Vi ringer Påven har så lange nastan alla kan minnas varit losningen nar någon behover en målvakt i Sveg. programme.title: Vagens hjaltar
programme.desc: A single vehicle accident occurs in the fog at Årstalanken and Benny, who arrives first on the scene, rushes to the injured driver. During the work on the accident, the unthinkable happens - a heavy collision in the opposite korbana. The sled stops in Nacka during the morning and Micke has to help two motorists who short into one and the same pole. Berra comes across a suspicious drunk driver on the E4 and Christoffer runs into problems when he has to salvage a car that went down a hill in Hogdalen. / En singelolycka intraffar i tat dimma på Årstalanken och Benny som kommer forst till platsen skyndar fram till den skadade foraren. Under arbetet med olyckan hander det som inte får handa - en kraftig kollision i motsatt korbana. Halkan staller till det i Nacka under morgonen och Micke får hjalpa två bilister som kort in i en och samma stolpe. Berra påtraffar en misstankt rattfylla på E4:n och Christoffer stoter på problem nar han ska barga en bil som kort ner for en slant i Hogdalen.

programme.title: Caught on police camera / Fångat på polisens kamera
programme.desc: In Skovde, three masked men rob a watch shop with slag and crowbars, they hit the display stands and then escape on a bicycle. programme.title: Caught on police camera / Fångat på polisens kamera
programme.desc: Police are chasing a van in Haninge that was neglected despite slippery conditions and poor visibility. The driver is under the influence of cannabis and more drugs are found. programme.title: Gransbevakarna Sverige
programme.desc: At Arlanda, Calle stops a man who he suspects will smuggle a large number of counterfeit notes out of the country. programme.desc: The crew experiences a completely magical moment when someone offers a surprise. programme.desc: New tests are needed when the aspirants have to fall backwards from a height of four meters into Vanern's icy water. One of the aspirants leaves a message that shocks the group. programme.title: Den italienska husdrommen
programme.desc: Marie's sister comes to visit and helps Marie choose a color for the walls in the house and they explore the city together. programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Forrest Gump tells the story of his incredible life in this dramatic comedy that became a worldwide success. Forrest has been a celebrated athlete, war hero and millionaire. In spite of everything that has happened to him, he has never been able to relax the male game to his childhood friend Jenny. / Forrest Gump berattar historien om sitt otroliga liv i denna dramakomedi som blev en varldssucce. Forrest har varit firad idrottsman, krigshjalte och miljonar. Trots allt som har hant har han aldrig kunnat slappa karleken till barndomsvannen Jenny.

programme.title: National Lampoons European Vacation
programme.desc: The Griswald family wins first prize in a pig breed. The prize is a trip to Europe and they think they will get a holiday with luxury and flair, but it turns out not to be true. And left-hand traffic in England caused some problems. / Familjen Griswald vinner forsta pris i en gristavling. Priset ar en resa till Europa och de tror att de ska få en semester med lyx och flard, men det visar sig inte stamma riktigt. Och vanstertrafiken i England medfor vissa problem.

programme.title: Dungeons And Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and once unlikely adventurer set out on a quest to recover a lost relic, but their epic heist goes dangerously awry when they become entangled with all the wrong people. / En charmig tjuv och ett gang osannolika aventyrare ger sig ut på jakt for att återta en forsvunnen relik, men deras episka kupp går farligt snett nar de blir intrasslade med helt fel personer.

programme.title: Wahlgrens varld
programme.desc: Tears flow when Emelie and Bianca talk about Bianca's tough time. Oliver and Zoey have their second child, Pernilla becomes a grandmother again. / Tårarna rinner nar Emelie och Bianca pratar om Biancas tuffa tid. Oliver och Zoey får sitt andra barn, Pernilla blir farmor igen.

programme.desc: Åsa and Carro make a bet that Carro can't help but work for a whole afternoon. Will the worker ant Carro be up to the challenge? Jens tries to get hold of an elusive electrician, and in the hunt he repeatedly injures a neighbor. / Åsa och Carro slår vad om att Carro inte kan låta bli att jobba en hel eftermiddag. Kommer arbetsmyran Carro klara utmaningen? Jens forsoker få tag på en svårfångad elektriker och i jakten råkar han gång på gång kranka en granne.

programme.title: Sommaren med slakten
programme.desc: Carro wants to develop and goes on a Just Being course. But is it enough to get such a stressed out person like Carro to relax and just live in the moment? / Carro vill utvecklas och åker på en Bara vara-kurs. Men racker det for att få en så stressad person som Carro att slappna av och bara leva i nuet?

programme.title: Sommaren med slakten
programme.desc: Jens and Åsa are going to rent out the house in order to be able to afford to go away, but they hadn't reckoned with how incredibly rude and troublesome tenants can be. Also - Bobo gets lost when he goes to buy cigarettes. / Jens och Åsa ska hyra ut huset for att få råd att åka bort, men de hade inte raknat med hur oerhort krasna och jobbiga hyresgaster kan vara. Dessutom - Bobo går vilse nar han ska kopa cigaretter.

programme.title: Gardsgårdsserien
programme.desc: Three years without a win makes IFK Sollentuna Sweden's best football team, a title they took from Fone IK who won adversity for success. / Tre år utan vinst gor IFK Sollentuna till Sveriges samsta fotbollslag, en titel de tagit från Fone IK som vant motgång till medgång.

programme.title: House Hunters International
programme.desc: From Denmark to the Dominican Republic. We follow hopeful home buyers around the world as they fight their way through the jungle that often involved buying properties in other countries. / Från Danmark till Dominikanska republiken. Vi foljer forhoppningsfulla bostadskopare runt om i varlden nar de kampar sig fram i den djungel som det ofta innebar att kopa fastigheter i andra lander.

programme.title: House Hunters International
programme.desc: After being transferred to a NATO airbase in Geilenkirchen, Germany, a family must find a house that is comfortable for seven people. / Efter att ha blivit forflyttad till en Nato flygbas i Geilenkirchen i Tyskland måste en familj hitta ett hus som ar komfortabelt for sju personer.

programme.title: Valkommen till Koping
programme.desc: The brothers Bowling, Mats and Tobbe face the girls' league in the most important bowling match of the year. Åke throws a grandiose New Year's party, and everyone is invited! But will Åke's new flame Elisabeth want to come to the party? / Broderna Bowling, Mats och Tobbe moter tjejligan i årets viktigaste bowlingmatch. Åke fixar en grandios nyårsfest, och alla ar bjudna! Men kommer Åkes nygamla flamma Elisabeth vilja komma på festen?

programme.title: Farjan
programme.desc: The vampire infection spreads when Walter transforms Dan into a thinking vampire, who quickly becomes fascinated by his new abilities. Albin and Lo pursue Edith after seeing her attack another passenger. Pia realizes that something really disturbing is happening right in front of their eyes and is forced to act in a way she didn't think she was capable of. Marianne, Goran and Vincent barricade themselves inside a club as panic spreads on the ship. / Vampyrinfektionen sprider sig nar Walter forvandlar Dan till en tankande vampyr, som snabbt blir fascinerad av sina nya formågor. Albin och Lo forfoljer Edith efter att ha sett henne attackera en annan passagerare. Pia inser att något riktigt skrammande håller på att handa mitt framfor deras ogon och tvingas agera på ett satt hon inte trodde att hon var kapabel till. Marianne, Goran och Vincent barrikaderar sig inne i en klubb nar paniken sprider sig på fartyget.

programme.title: Kiosken
programme.desc: Daniel summer talks and Sam puts his whole future in the hands of a job coach. / Daniel sommarpratar och Sam lagger hela sin framtid i handerna på en jobbcoach.

programme.title: Klara - mic drop
programme.desc: Klara Hammarstrom reveals that she has ended the collaboration with her Swedish record company, and she writes a song about her fresh start. After the landing in Mello, she flies directly to Los Angeles for a shoot with a major producer. / Klara Hammarstrom avslojar att hon avslutat samarbetet med sitt svenska skivbolag, och hon skriver en låt om sin nystart. Efter fjardeplatsen i Mello flyger hon direkt till Los Angeles for ett mote med en stor producent.

programme.desc: Sandningsuppehåll

programme.title: Sverige idag
programme.desc: News from all over Sweden - direct from Umeå. / Nyheter från hela Sverige - direkt från Umeå.

programme.title: Gokvall
programme.desc: Middagsvard ar artisten Sofia Kallgren. Gokvallpanelen med Denise Rudberg och Niclas Berglund. Filmrecension och streamingtips med Johan Lundstrom. Programledare: Inger Ljung Olsson.

programme.title: On a journey with Bachstad: Europe in war and peace / På resa med Bachstad: Europa i krig och fred
programme.desc: Øystein and Rune began their journey with a short visit to Cambodia, and after briefly touring the neighboring countries, they are now back where the journey began. A series of memorials from the brutal Khmer Rouge regime make a strong impression on them. The traveling companions in Team Bachstad - Øystein Bache and Rune Gokstad - are out on new adventures. Having previously, among other things, traveled to Mongolia in a fire truck and crossed India in a tuc-tuc, this time they are driving through Indochina. / Øystein och Rune inledde sin resa med ett kort besok i Kambodja, och efter att ha kort runt i grannlanderna ar de nu tillbaka dar resan borjade. En rad minnesmarken från de roda khmerernas skrackregim gor starkt intryck på dem. Reskamraterna i Team Bachstad - Øystein Bache och Rune Gokstad - ar ute på nya aventyr. Efter att tidigare bl a ha kort till Mongoliet i brandbil och korsat Indien i tuc-tuc, bilar de denna gång genom Indokina.

programme.title: Nytt blod i djurparken
programme.desc: Tuva has to have an operation on her ankle and Marie thinks she will probably have room to run her race. But it will take more than a cast to stop Tuva. She pushes on with her big project, despite Marie's and Nils' protests. Hog season is approaching. The month of July will determine if there will be solitude in the park or not. But can the farm attract visitors without socialized wolves? Part 6 of 7. / Tuva måste operera fotleden och Marie tror att hon antligen skall få utrymme att kora sitt race. Men det skall mer till an ett gips for att få stopp på Tuva. Hon driver på sitt stora projekt, trots Maries och Nils protester. Hogsasong stundar. Juli månad avgor om det blir lonsamhet i parken eller inte. Men kan gården locka besokare utan socialiserade vargar? Del 6 av 7.

programme.title: Stromso
programme.desc: Nicke is hosted by noise and silence researcher Outi Ampuja. She has researched noise, the history of noise and the quality of our sound environment. What is silence good for and how is silence defined? Some of the people who visited the open house at Stromso at the beginning of the summer also got their say: Which is the loudest sound there is, which is the most pleasant and can it be too quiet? In the kitchen, Julien and Elin offer mussels that will convince even the biggest mussel skeptic. Hanna and Elin show how to transform your skinny jeans into wide jeans. / Nicke gastas av buller- och tystnadsforskaren Outi Ampuja. Hon har forskat i buller, bullrets historia och kvaliteten i vår ljudmiljo. Vad ar tystnaden bra for och hur definieras tystnad? En del av manniskorna som besokte oppet hus på Stromso i borjan av sommaren får också saga sitt: Vilket ar det varsta ljudet som finns, vilket ar det mest behagliga och kan det bli for tyst? I koket bjuder Julien och Elin på musslor som fralser aven den storsta musselskeptikern. Hanna och Elin visar hur du forvandlar dina skinny jeans till vida jeans.

programme.title: Giganterna
programme.desc: As Norway's first football team for short stature, the Giants are already historic with their participation in the World Cup. But is everyone happy with it? / Som Norges forsta fotbollslag for kortvaxta ar Giganterna redan historiska med sin medverkan i VM. Men ar alla nojda med det?

programme.title: Ask the doctor / Fråga doktorn
programme.desc: Is it dangerous to take several medications at the same time? How do you know if one's physical problems are due to illness, or a side effect of the medication? And how do you know if the benefit of a medication exceeds the risk of side effects? Answering the questions are Sara Nordberg, an expert on drugs and side effects, and Bjorn Wettermark, who does research on how good - or bad - we are at taking our medications while driving. Housewives are Jens Persson and presenter Sofia Rågenklint. / Är det farligt att ata flera mediciner samtidigt? Hur vet man om ens kroppsliga problem beror på sjukdom, eller en biverkning av medicinen? Och hur vet man om nyttan med en medicin overstiger risken for biverkningar? nSvarar på frågorna gor Sara Nordberg, expert på lakemedel och biverkningar, och Bjorn Wettermark, som forskar om hur bra - eller dåliga - vi ar på att ta våra mediciner på ratt satt. Huslakare ar Jens Persson och programledare Sofia Rågenklint.

programme.title: Sju sorters kakor
programme.desc: Montadar Kanbar was baker of the year 2020 and now he shares his interpretation of the ballerina cake. With flake salt and chocolate, he transforms the everyday cake into the highlight of the coffee table. / Montadar Kanbar blev årets bagare 2020 och nu delar han med sig av sin tolkning på ballerinakakan. Med flingsalt och choklad forvandlar han den vardagliga kakan till fikabordets hojdpunkt.

programme.title: Husdrommar
programme.desc: Marie is passionate about interior design and Bill is the home carpenter who is always renovating. They are passionate house lovers and have renovated four houses in ten years. Now they move to Hoganas and a house that Marie dreamed about and longed for. But despite their vast experience, not everything goes as planned. It will be a testing year for the whole family. / Marie brinner for inredning och Bill ar hemmasnickaren som alltid renoverar. De ar passionerade husalskare och har renoverat fyra hus på tio år. Nu flyttar de till Hoganas och ett hus som Marie dromt om och langtat efter. Men trots deras stora erfarenhet går inte allting som planerat. Det blir ett provningens år for hela familjen.

programme.title: Svenska nyheter
programme.desc: The program that explains why things are the way they are, how they should be, and jokes about things that are politics and things that you don't know are politics. nProgram leader is the comedian Messiah Hallberg. / Programmet som forklarar varfor saker ar som de ar, hur de borde vara, och skamtar om sånt som ar politik och sånt som man inte vet ar politik. nProgramledare ar komikern Messiah Hallberg.

programme.title: Age crisis with Keyyo and Rheborg / Ålderskris med Keyyo och Rheborg
programme.desc: Keyyo is chasing Johan in the team unit in Barcelona. In Spain, she wants to relax the splendor and "k***". Johan lets her smoke Cuban cigars while she lets him keep up with the latest trends on tiktok. As thanks for the visit, she surprises Johan with a Spanish butcher's feast. At the nudist beach, an amne appears that Keyyo prefers to avoid. / Keyyo halsar på Johan i lagenheten i Barcelona. I Spanien vill hon slappa praktigheten och ”k*** ”. Johan lar henne att roka kubanska cigarrer medan hon lar honom att hålla jamna steg med de senaste trenderna på tiktok. Som tack for besoket overraskar hon Johan med ett spanskt slaktkalas. På nudiststranden dyker ett amne upp som Keyyo helst av allt undviker.

programme.title: Skavlan och Sverige
programme.desc: Is God who we need in times like these, or is he the last thing we need? Has God made a comeback? Participants: Birgitta Ed, priest and prime minister's wife, Par Lernstrom, defector, Faysa Idle, Muslim, Christer Sturmark, humanist, Claes Malmberg, Buddhist, and Josef Barkenbom, pastor in the Free Church. Program manager: Fredrik Skavlan. / Är Gud den vi behover i tider som dessa, eller ar han tvartemot det sista vi behover? Har Gud gjort comeback? Medverkande: Birgitta Ed, prast och statsministerfru, Par Lernstrom, avhoppare, Faysa Idle, muslim, Christer Sturmark, humanist, Claes Malmberg, buddhist, och Josef Barkenbom, pastor i frikyrkan. Programledare: Fredrik Skavlan.

programme.title: Who lives has? / Vem bor har?
programme.desc: We visit grand estates and farms a stone's throw from the customs in Stockholm, take a trip to Africa via Nacka and go on safari in a jungle in the middle of the city. Five aliens visit each other's homes and wonder - who lives where? Host: Keyyo. / Vi besoker pampiga gods och gårdar ett stenkast från tullarna i Stockholm, tar en resa till Afrika via Nacka och går på safari i en djungel mitt i city. Fem framlingar besoker varandras hem och undrar - vem bor var? Programledare: Keyyo.

programme.title: Djurgården IF FF - Malmo FF / Djurgårdens IF FF - Malmo FF
programme.desc: Direct broadcast from Stockholm where Djurgården is pitted against Malmo in the women's league. Commentators: Pelle Backman and Hanna Marklund. Reporter: Jane Bjorck. / Direktsandning från Stockholm dar Djurgården stalls mot Malmo i damallsvenskan. Kommentatorer: Pelle Backman och Hanna Marklund. Reporter: Jane Bjorck.

programme.title: Spelet
programme.desc: Håkan Juholt sees his theories about a parallel game come true when the upper class for the first time receives information that the lower class exists. Shocked, the upper class realizes that all the rusted out have been waiting for their place in the Forrådet since day one. The shadow player understands that he will be exposed and a worried Daniel Paris realizes that it meant unsavory consequences for him. The group speculates, the pressure rises and distrust in the suite reaches a new level. The entire upper class is shaken and the difference to the team spirit of the lower class could not be clearer. But Julia Franzen is starting to show some irritation towards a teammate for the first time. / Håkan Juholt ser sina teorier om ett parallellt spel bli verklighet nar overklassen for forsta gången får information om att underklassen finns. Chockade inser overklassen att alla de rostat ut har ruvat på sin hamnd i Forrådet sen dag ett. Skuggspelaren forstår att han kommer att avslojas och en orolig Daniel Paris inser att det innebar odesdigra konsekvenser for honom. Gruppen spekulerar, pressen stiger och misstron i sviten når en ny nivå. Hela overklassen ar skakad och skillnaden mot underklassens laganda kunde inte vara tydligare. Men Julia Franzen borjar for forsta gången visa viss irritation over en lagkamrat.

programme.title: Doobidoo
programme.desc: Doobidoo celebrates 20 years with a sparkling anniversary program! A whole three teams against each other in the desks and gas in the band is Tord. Tables go Katrin Sundberg and Annika Andersson against Ankan Johansson and Måns Nilsson as well as Lisa Miskovsky and Kalle Moraeus. / Doobidoo firar 20 år med ett glittrande jubileumsprogram! Hela tre lag mots i pultarna och gast i bandet ar Tord. Tavlar gor Katrin Sundberg och Annika Andersson mot Ankan Johansson och Måns Nilsson samt Lisa Miskovsky och Kalle Moraeus.

programme.desc: Weekend ringing from the Bridget sisters' monastery in Rome. Sister Maria Diana talks about loving your neighbor as yourself. / Helgmålsringning från Birgittasystrarnas kloster i Rom. Syster Maria Diana talar om att alska sin nasta som sig sjalv.

programme.title: Mister Books mysterier
programme.desc: Britain's favorite screen couple, Sandra Dare and Stewart Howard, arrive at Archangel Lane for a film shoot. But everything is not quite as idyllic as it seems - a journalist snoops for gossip and an extra dies after eating poisoned chocolate. / Storbritanniens favoritpar på vita duken, Sandra Dare och Stewart Howard, anlander till Archangel Lane for en filminspelning. Men allt ar inte riktigt så idylliskt som det verkar - en journalist snokar efter skvaller och en statist dor efter att ha atit forgiftad choklad.

programme.title: Sune in Greece - All Inclusive / Sune i Grekland - All Inclusive
programme.desc: Sune is back. Together with little brother Håkan Bråkan, big sister Anna, mother Karin and father Rudolf, Sune goes to Greece for the summer holidays. As every summer before, the Andersson family plans their holiday week in Myggtrask. Then the most unexpected thing happens, father Rudolf books a charter trip to Greece. The family is overjoyed, but there are many questions about the trip. On location in Greece, disasters strike, Sune loses her girl charm, Håkan Bråkan really doesn't like the troll Julle in the children's group, mother Karin gets more and more annoyed with Rudolf. At the same time, father Rudolf notes that it is all inclusive and what unexpected possibilities it brings. / Sune ar tillbaka. Tillsammans med lillebror Håkan Bråkan, storasyster Anna, mamma Karin och pappa Rudolf drar Sune till Grekland på sommarlovet. Som varje sommar forut planerar familjen Andersson sin semestervecka i Myggtrask. Då hander det mest ovantade, pappa Rudolf bokar en charterresa till Grekland. Familjen blir overlycklig men frågorna om resan ar många. På plats i Grekland intraffar katastroferna, Sune tappar sin tjejtjusarkraft, Håkan Bråkan gillar verkligen inte trollet Julle i barngruppen, mamma Karin blir mer och mer irriterad på Rudolf. Samtidigt upptacker pappa Rudolf att det ar all inclusive och vilka oanade mojligheter det for med sig.

programme.desc: Two years have passed since the quiet Peter Parker suffered the accident that changed his life and gave him a very special gift/curse. programme.desc: "It's you and me against the world." First day in the same home - with a person they just married. When differences and similarities emerge, the ability to let the other person in and dare to show who you really are is tested. Who am I sharing life with - and how do you make the new place feel like home? / “Det ar du och jag mot varlden.” Forsta dagen i samma hem - med en person de just har gift sig med. Nar olikheter och likheter trader fram provas formågan att slappa in den andre och att våga visa vem man egentligen ar. Vem ar det jag delar livet med - och hur gor man for att få det nya att kannas som hemma?

programme.desc: The question of animals' right to a good life has begun to create conflicts among both zookeepers and researchers. programme.title: Innocence: opera av Kaija Saariaho
programme.desc: Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho's (1952-2023) opera Innocence took both audiences and critics by storm at its world premiere in Aix-en-Provence in 2021. The libretto, written by renowned author Sofi Oksanen, takes place in two timelines and depicts the shocking account of a school shooting. We hear the London Symphony Orchestra and soloists such as Magdalena Kožena and Sandrine Piau under the direction of conductor Susanna Malkki. The 2025 edition of the world's biggest prize for classical music - the Birgit Nilsson Prize - is awarded to the opera festival in Aix-en-Provence. The award justification emphasizes the festival's outstanding artistic achievements, with special recognition for the 2021 staging of the opera Innocence. The prize will be awarded on 21 October. / Den finlandska kompositoren Kaija Saariahos (1952-2023) opera Innocence tog både publik och kritiker med storm vid sin varldspremiar i Aix-en-Provence 2021. Librettot, skrivet av den beromda forfattaren Sofi Oksanen, utspelas i två tidsplan och skildrar den skakande berattelsen om en skolskjutning. Vi hor London Symphony Orchestra och solister som Magdalena Kožena och Sandrine Piau under ledning av dirigenten Susanna Malkki. 2025 års upplaga av varldens storsta pris for klassisk musik - Birgit Nilsson Prize - tilldelas operafestivalen i Aix-en-Provence. I prismotiveringen betonas festivalens enastående konstnarliga prestationer, med ett sarskilt erkannande for 2021 års uppsattning av just operan Innocence. Priset delas ut den 21 oktober.

In secret, Ali and his friends will now try to dig up the treasure, but it turns out to be easier said than done. / Ett drama om tolvårige gatubarnet Ali och hans tre vanner som via enklare jobb och småbrott kampar for att overleva och forsorja sina familjer. En dag får ganget ett uppdrag av en lokal gangsterboss; de ska skriva in sig i den så kallade Solskolan for i tunnlarna under skolan ryktas att det finns en stor skatt begravd. I hemlighet ska nu Ali och hans vanner forsoka grava fram skatten men det visar sig vara lattare sagt an gjort.

programme.title: Fashion with (sign language) / Mote med (teckenspråk)
programme.desc: What is required to transform one's innermost thoughts into a book that depends and changes? Gunilla and Åsa open up about their strong journey to write a book that helps deaf parents understand their deaf children, an account filled with vulnerability and insight. Marcus talks about his long struggle and the joy of apparently having his book published - a dream that came true after many attempts. / Vad kravs for att forvandla sina innersta tankar till en bok som beror och forandrar? Gunilla och Åsa oppnar upp om sin starka resa att skriva en bok som hjalper horande foraldrar att forstå sina dova barn, en berattelse fylld av sårbarhet och insikt. Marcus berattar om sin långa kamp och gladjen over att antligen ha fått sin bok publicerad - en drom som gått i uppfyllelse efter många forsok.

programme.title: Vapenbroder
programme.desc: Sweden and Finland were long one and the same country and we fought together against our common enemy. Now we are united again through NATO. But what weapons and fighting techniques have we used over the centuries? How effective was the knight's sword, how hard could you shoot with a crossbow and how accurate was the musket? Mirka Kettunen tests old weapon techniques and talks about our common defense history. / Sverige och Finland var lange ett och samma land och vi stred tillsammans mot vår gemensamma fiende. Nu ar vi åter forenade genom Nato. Men vilka vapen och stridstekniker har vi anvant genom århundradena? Hur effektivt var egentligen riddarsvardet, hur hårt kunde man skjuta med ett armborst och hur traffsaker var muskoten? Mirka Kettunen testar gamla vapentekniker och berattar om vår gemensamma forsvarshistoria.

programme.title: Half me? / Halva jag?
programme.desc: Heli calls her possible father and asks for a DNA test. JP has difficulty finding people who want to be tested. How will he find out which of four alternatives is his father? Heli and JP visit a prison where their mother has been imprisoned. The experiences of being abandoned have left their mark and the protective walls grow higher. Heli is upset by the words of his adoptive parents. / Heli ringer sin eventuella pappa och ber om ett dna-test. JP har svårt att hitta personer som vill låta sig testas. Hur ska han få veta vem av fyra alternativ som ar hans pappa? Heli och JP besoker ett fangelse dar deras mamma har suttit. Upplevelserna av att bli overgivna har satt sina spår och skyddsmurarna vaxer sig hogre. Heli blir rord over sina adoptivforaldrars ord.

programme.title: Vetenskapens varld: Djurparkskriget
programme.desc: The question of animals' right to a good life has begun to create conflicts among both zookeepers and researchers. Can you visit zoos with a clear conscience? What is really true about the animals in the cages? Are zoos a protection for biodiversity and important research? Or is it an outdated and immoral way to create entertainment at the expense of sentient beings? / Frågan om djurs ratt till bra liv har borjat skapa konflikter bland såval djurparksagare som forskare. Kan man besoka djurparker med gott samvete? Vad ar egentligen sant om djuren i burarna? Är djurparker ett skydd for biologisk mångfald och viktig forskning? Eller ar det ett foråldrat och omoraliskt satt att skapa underhållning på kannande varelsers bekostnad?

Nar en livlig ung familj flyttar in bredvid moter han sin overman i den snabbtankta och mycket gravida Marisol, vilket leder till en osannolik vanskap som kommer att vanda upp och ner på hans varld. Upplev en rolig, hjartevarmande historia om hur vissa familjer kommer från de mest ovantade hållen.

programme.title: Efterlyst

Programmet sands live från Stockholm med poliser och experter i studion och på plats dar brotten hander, runt om i Sverige. Tittarna får inte bara de senaste nyheterna utan också en helhetsbild av de aktuella brotten, som ofta kan vara svåra att overblicka nar rubrikerna briserar i medierna.

Hemma hos Natalie har alla samlats for att fira jul i hennes hus for forsta gången. Joline visar sig vara skrackslagen vid motet med tomten och efter allt kaos och stok bestammer sig Natalie for att det inte blir något mer firande i hennes hus. programme.sub-title: : Noah's Ark or a prison? / : Noaks ark eller ett fangelse?
programme.desc: The question of animals' right to a good life has begun to create conflicts among both zookeepers and researchers. An English zoo owner wants to shut down Europe's zoos and make the animals wild, even though he himself runs two zoos. In Sweden, zoos feel they are needed more than ever. At the same time, there are recurring scandals with escaping animals and doped animal transporters. Can you visit zoos with a clear conscience? And what is really true about the animals in the cages? / Frågan om djurs ratt till bra liv har borjar skapa konflikter bland såval djurparksagare som forskare. En engelsk djurparksagare vill stanga ner Europas djurparker och forvilda djuren, trots att han sjalv driver två zoon. I Sverige havdar djurparkerna sjalva att de behovs mer an någonsin. Samtidigt sker återkommande skandaler med rymmande djur och dodade djurskotare. Kan man besoka djurparker med gott samvete? Och vad ar egentligen sant om djuren i burarna?

programme.desc: Sukhothai is a city in Thailand, the capital of the province of the same name, located over 400 km north of Bangkok. The modern city is located about 12 km east of Sukhothai Historical Park, with the ruins of the ancient capital of the Sukhothai Kingdom, which dominated the Indochina region for about 140 years. / Sukhothai è una città della Thailandia, capoluogo della provincia omonima, posta ad oltre 400 km a nord di Bangkok. La città moderna è localizzata a circa 12 km ad est del Parco storico di Sukhothai, con le rovine della antica capitale del Regno di Sukhothai, che per circa 140 dominò la regione indocinese.

programme.title: Casi damore
programme.desc: Lawyer Florian Faber runs a prosperous law firm together with his elegant wife Eva. The sudden reappearance of his ex-girlfriend Sarah, a journalist, takes him by surprise. The woman is in prison, suspected of tax evasion, but proclaiming her innocence, she uses all her charm to convince Florian to help her. / Lavvocato Florian Faber gestisce un prospero studio legale insieme allelegante moglie Eva. Limprovvisa ricomparsa della sua ex fidanzata Sarah, una giornalista, lo coglie di sorpresa. La donna è in carcere, sospettata di evasione fiscale, ma proclamando la sua innocenza, usa tutto il suo fascino per convincere Florian ad aiutarla.

programme.title: Back in the game / Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: The story of a baseball talent scout, Gus (Clint Eastwood), in charge of the Atlanta Braves, who sees his career adrift: he can no longer find champions. A trip to North Carolina with his daughter Mickey (Amy Adams), with whom relations are not exactly idyllic, could solve everything. Gus, in fact, returns in the company of a promising young woman and is ready to get back into the game... / La storia di un talent scout di baseball, Gus (Clint Eastwood), in carica agli Atlanta Braves, che vede la sua carriera alla deriva: non riesce più a scovare campioni. Un viaggio in North Carolina con la figlia Mickey (Amy Adams), con la quale i rapporti non sono propriamente idilliaci, potrebbe risolvere tutto. Gus, infatti, torna in compagnia di una giovane promessa ed è pronto a rimettersi in gioco...

programme.title: Albert's Garden - Why do sharks attack? / Il giardino di Albert - Perche gli squali attaccano?
programme.desc: Three deadly attacks in less than a year in the Red Sea. A mystery that shocks tourists, biologists and authorities. Dramas that, without a doubt, leave indelible traces. The documentary proposed today by Albert's garden investigates the causes behind these rare but disturbing events, revealing a mix of factors: warming waters, tourist overcrowding, intensive fishing and hungry sharks pushing ever closer to the coast. With exclusive images, direct testimonies and scientific analyses, the film takes us between the coral reefs of Egypt, the beaches of Florida and the Australian coasts, where the coexistence between man and shark is increasingly delicate. But sharks are not bloodthirsty monsters. They are ancient predators, essential for the balance of the oceans. And perhaps, rather than fear them, we should really learn to know them. A compelling story that mixes biology, ecology and technology, and which forces us to admit perhaps the most obvious thing: we are the ones invading their world! / Tre attacchi mortali in meno di un anno nel Mar Rosso. Un mistero che scuote turisti, biologi e autorità. Drammi che, senza alcun dubbio, lasciano tracce indelebili. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert indaga le cause dietro questi eventi rari ma inquietanti, svelando un intreccio di fattori: riscaldamento delle acque, sovraffollamento turistico, pesca intensiva e squali affamati che si spingono sempre più vicino alla costa. Con immagini esclusive, testimonianze dirette e analisi scientifiche, il filmato ci porta tra le barriere coralline dellEgitto, le spiagge della Florida e le coste australiane, dove la convivenza tra uomo e squalo è sempre più delicata. Ma gli squali non sono mostri sanguinari. Sono predatori antichi, essenziali per lequilibrio degli oceani. E forse, più che temerli, dovremmo imparare a conoscerli davvero. Un racconto avvincente che mescola biologia, ecologia e tecnologia, e che ci costringe ad ammettere la cosa forse più evidente: siamo noi ad invadere il loro mondo!

programme.title: The words I didn't tell you / Le parole che non ti ho detto
programme.desc: Theresa Osborne was left by her husband and dedicates her life to her son Jason and to her work as a researcher. During one holiday, while he is jogging on the beach, he finds a bottle with a letter inside addressed to a woman named Catherine. The content is so touching that the temptation to trace the author is very strong. The Chicago Tribune wrote an article about it and many readers wrote to the newspaper to find out more. Theresa manages to identify a place and a name, that of Garret Blake, a boat manufacturer who lives with his father Dodge. A friendship is born between Theresa and Garret but the figure of his wife is very present and the woman returns to Chicago. When she invites Garret to join her at her house, the man discovers the bottle and sees the article published in the newspaper; he realizes that Theresa found the message, believing it to be written by him, when in reality it was written by Catherine. / Theresa Osborne e stata lasciata dal marito e dedica la sua vita al figlio Jason e al proprio lavoro da ricercatrice. Durante una vacanza, mentre sta facendo jogging sulla spiaggia, trova una bottiglia con dentro una lettera indirizzata ad una donna di nome Catherine. Il contenuto e cosi toccante che la tentazione di risalire allautore e molto forte. Il Chicago Tribune ne fa un articolo e molti lettori scrivono al giornale per saperne di piu. Theresa riesce ad individuare una localita ed un nome, quello di Garret Blake, un fabbricante di barche che vive con il padre Dodge.Tra Theresa e Garret nasce una simpatia ma la figura della moglie e molto presente e la donna torna a Chicago. Quando invita Garret a raggiungerla nella sua casa, luomo scopre la bottiglia e vede larticolo pubblicato sul giornale; capisce che Theresa ha trovato il messaggio, credendolo scritto da lui, mentre in realta e stato scritto da Catherine.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: Mr. Traber had a good idea for the autumn festival: Rico will open the celebrations with a melody on his violin. The little Italian is happy, Heidi too, but not Teresa. She is offended because normally it is William who opens the dance by playing the alphorn. This is intolerable and, to avoid William's humiliation, Teresa decides to steal Rico's violin. He succeeds, but after a chase through the woods, Rico, Heidi and Peter find the broken instrument. Rico wants to respond in kind but Heidi has another idea and needs her grandfather's help. That evening, at the beginning of the party, Teresa is happy to see William ready to play the alphorn as usual. However, Rico arrives and takes out his violin, recently repaired by his grandfather. Accompanied by the old man with his harmonica, Rico begins a lively tune. / Il signor Traber ha avuto una buona idea per la festa dautunno: Rico aprirà i festeggiamenti con una melodia sul suo violino. Il piccolo italiano è contento, Heidi anche, ma non Teresa. Lei è offesa perche normalmente è William che apre il ballo suonando il corno alpino. Questo è intollerabile e, per evitare lumiliazione di William, Teresa decide di rubare il violino di Rico. Ci riesce, ma dopo un inseguimento nel bosco, Rico, Heidi e Peter trovano lo strumento rotto. Rico vuole rispondere a tono ma Heidi ha unaltra idea e ha bisogno dellaiuto del nonno. Quella sera, allinizio della festa, Teresa si rallegra nel vedere William pronto a suonare il corno alpino come al solito. Tuttavia, Rico arriva e tira fuori il suo violino, appena riparato dal nonno. Accompagnato dal vecchio con la sua armonica, Rico inizia una melodia vivace.

programme.title: Albert's Garden - Why do sharks attack? / Il giardino di Albert - Perche gli squali attaccano?
programme.desc: Three deadly attacks in less than a year in the Red Sea. A mystery that shocks tourists, biologists and authorities. Dramas that, without a doubt, leave indelible traces. The documentary proposed today by Albert's garden investigates the causes behind these rare but disturbing events, revealing a mix of factors: warming waters, tourist overcrowding, intensive fishing and hungry sharks pushing ever closer to the coast. With exclusive images, direct testimonies and scientific analyses, the film takes us between the coral reefs of Egypt, the beaches of Florida and the Australian coasts, where the coexistence between man and shark is increasingly delicate. But sharks are not bloodthirsty monsters. They are ancient predators, essential for the balance of the oceans. And perhaps, rather than fear them, we should really learn to know them. A compelling story that mixes biology, ecology and technology, and which forces us to admit perhaps the most obvious thing: we are the ones invading their world! / Tre attacchi mortali in meno di un anno nel Mar Rosso. Un mistero che scuote turisti, biologi e autorità. Drammi che, senza alcun dubbio, lasciano tracce indelebili. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert indaga le cause dietro questi eventi rari ma inquietanti, svelando un intreccio di fattori: riscaldamento delle acque, sovraffollamento turistico, pesca intensiva e squali affamati che si spingono sempre più vicino alla costa. Con immagini esclusive, testimonianze dirette e analisi scientifiche, il filmato ci porta tra le barriere coralline dellEgitto, le spiagge della Florida e le coste australiane, dove la convivenza tra uomo e squalo è sempre più delicata. Ma gli squali non sono mostri sanguinari. Sono predatori antichi, essenziali per lequilibrio degli oceani. E forse, più che temerli, dovremmo imparare a conoscerli davvero. Un racconto avvincente che mescola biologia, ecologia e tecnologia, e che ci costringe ad ammettere la cosa forse più evidente: siamo noi ad invadere il loro mondo!

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: An instrument that crosses genres and is extraordinarily versatile, capable of shining both as a solo voice and as a discreet companion, the piano will be the protagonist of the Paganini episode broadcast on Sunday 19 October at 10.30am on RSI LA1. With two different contributions, the program will explore the jazz declination of the instrument, between regional roots and international horizons. The starting point is a significant anniversary: ​​twenty years ago Riccardo Garzoni, one of the greatest Ticino jazz pianists and one of the few to have gained prominence on the international scene, left us prematurely. To remember him, one of his performances recorded for the RSI Nautilus broadcast in 1988 will be shown again, in a trio with drummer Alan Nelson and double bass player Peter Bockius. Of a completely different generation and with a different musical language, Erroll Garner was one of the most famous jazz pianists ever, capable of achieving a notoriety comparable to that of pop and rock stars during his lifetime. His story was recently told by the Swiss director Georges Gachot in the documentary Misty - The story of Erroll Garner: a work which, in addition to enhancing his inventiveness and musical energy, restores the deep and intimate emotions of his private and family experience. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - The story of Erroll Garner / Strumento trasversale ai generi e straordinariamente versatile, capace di brillare sia come voce solista sia come compagno discreto, il pianoforte sarà protagonista della puntata di Paganini in onda domenica 19 ottobre alle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Con due diversi contributi, la trasmissione esplorerà la declinazione jazzistica dello strumento, tra radici regionali e orizzonti internazionali. Il punto di partenza è una ricorrenza significativa: ventanni fa ci lasciava prematuramente Riccardo Garzoni, tra i maggiori pianisti jazz ticinesi e tra i pochi ad aver conquistato rilievo anche sulla scena internazionale. Per ricordarlo, verrà riproposta una sua esibizione registrata per la trasmissione RSI Nautilus nel 1988, in trio con il batterista Alan Nelson e il contrabbassista Peter Bockius. Di tuttaltra generazione e con un linguaggio musicale differente, Erroll Garner è stato invece uno dei pianisti jazz più celebri di sempre, capace di raggiungere in vita una notorietà paragonabile a quella delle star del pop e del rock. La sua storia è stata recentemente raccontata dal regista svizzero Georges Gachot nel documentario Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner: un lavoro che, oltre a esaltarne linventiva e lenergia musicale, restituisce le emozioni profonde e intime del suo vissuto privato e famigliare. - Riccardo Garzoni Trio - Misty - La storia di Erroll Garner

programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: A sensorial and poetic journey in Cappadocia, guided by those who cannot see but know how to look deeper. Igor and Barbara, visually impaired, lead us on a unique experience between underground cities, ancient traditions and a spectacular hot air balloon trip. Through their daily gestures and the emotions experienced, we rediscover the beauty of the small things that are often forgotten. A documentary where the gaze becomes listening, speech, touch, scent and memory and the protagonists become narrators of their own world. A documentary by Mirko Aretini / Un viaggio sensoriale e poetico in Cappadocia, guidato da chi non può vedere ma sa guardare più a fondo. Igor e Barbara, ipovedenti, ci conducono in un’esperienza unica tra città sotterranee, antiche tradizioni ed uno spettacolare viaggio in mongolfiera. Attraverso i loro gesti quotidiani e le emozioni vissute, riscopriamo la bellezza delle piccole cose spesso dimenticate. Un documentario dove lo sguardo diventa ascolto, parola, tocco, profumo e memoria e i protagonisti diventano narratori del proprio mondo.Un documentario di Mirko Aretini

Ma i nostri eroi cosa lasceranno nelle sterminate foreste dello Yukon e cosa porteranno con se in Svizzera? Lo scopriremo insieme nella settima e ultima puntata di Missione Yukon.

In reality, however, Juliette has long been in love with Michel's cousin, Antoine, who returns to the village to manage the family business. / Film drammatico di Roger Vadim Cast: con Brigitte Bardot, Curd Jurgens, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jeanne Marken Paese - Anno: FRA - 1956 Juliette, adolescente orfana, è ospitata da una coppia d´anziani in un villaggio di pescatori. Per evitare la partenza, Juliette accetta di sposare il timido Michel, da tempo innamorato di lei, il quale spera che col tempo la ragazza possa innamorarsi di lui. programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Fumes, odors and unpleasant noises are the symbol of a difficult coexistence between the PAMP refinery in Castel S. Pietro and the inhabitants of the Gorla district. The matter has been going on for years and continues to raise complaints, doubts and requests for solutions. A recent question in the Grand Council reignites the case and asks for intervention. Falò reportage among the citizens' concerns, the timely responses of the company managers, the feedback from the Municipality and the Canton. / Fumi, odori e rumori sgradevoli sono il simbolo di una convivenza difficile tra la raffineria PAMP di Castel S. Pietro e gli abitanti del quartiere di Gorla. La vicenda si protrae da anni e continua a suscitare lamentele, dubbi e richieste di soluzioni. Una recente interrogazione in Gran Consiglio riaccende il caso e chiede dintervenire. Reportage di Falò tra le preoccupazioni dei cittadini, le puntuali risposte dei dirigenti dellazienda, i riscontri del Comune e del Cantone.

programme.title: Treasures of the World - Merida - Waterways and more - Spain / Tesori del mondo - Merida - Vie dacqua e daltro - Spagna
programme.sub-title: Merida - Waterways and more - Spain / Merida - Vie dacqua e daltro - Spagna
programme.desc: Merida is a Spanish municipality of 54,893 inhabitants, capital of the autonomous community of Extremadura. By population it is the third largest city in the region after Cáceres and Badajoz itself. It is located on the right bank of the Guadiana at 217 meters above sea level. and it is one of the cities in Spain richest in Roman monuments, so much so that it is called Spanish Rome. It is 60 km from Badajoz and 70 from Cáceres. Its economy is based partly on agriculture, partly on industry and services and on tourism thanks to its monumental heritage and the various events organized. Merida is an episcopal and university seat. / Merida è un comune spagnolo di 54.893 abitanti capoluogo della comunità autonoma dellEstremadura. Per popolazione è la terza città della regione dopo Cáceres e Badajoz stessa. È posta sulla riva destra della Guadiana a 217 metri s.l.m. ed è una delle città della Spagna più ricche di monumenti romani tanto da essere chiamata la Roma spagnola. Dista 60 km da Badajoz e 70 da Cáceres. La sua economia è fondata in parte sull agricoltura, in parte sullindustria e sui servizi e sul turismo grazie al patrimonio monumentale di cui è dotata e alle varie manifestazioni organizzate. Merida è sede vescovile e universitaria.

programme.title: The Karate Kid - To win tomorrow / The Karate Kid - Per vincere domani
programme.desc: Timeless cult film from the 80s with Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita. A boy bullied by school bullies is taught the art of karate by a wise Japanese master. / Intramontabile film-culto degli anni 80 con Ralph Macchio e Pat Morita. Un ragazzo vessato dai bulli della scuola viene istruito da un saggio maestro giapponese allarte del karate.

programme.title: 007 - A waterfall of diamonds / 007 - Una cascata di diamanti
programme.desc: Commander James Bond, aka agent 007 of the English secret service, has just completed a difficult mission and is immediately entrusted with the task of discovering the organizers and reasons behind a mysterious hoard of diamonds, which threatens to upset the market. Having assumed the identity of Peter Franks, one of the gang's couriers, Bond does not take long to identify its leader, the beautiful Tiffany Case, whose organisation, however, has for some time been suffering attacks from unknown adversaries, who kill the smugglers and take possession of the diamonds. Having become Tiffany, to whom he revealed his identity, his ally, Bond discovers, after having twice avoided being killed, that the diamonds stolen from Case's organization have ended up in a space laboratory, and used in the construction of a satellite, which is about to be launched into orbit. / Il comandante James Bond, alias agente 007 del servizio segreto inglese, ha appena portato a termine una difficile missione, che subito, gli viene affidato il compito di scoprire gli organizzatori e le ragioni di una misteriosa incetta di diamanti, che minaccia di sconvolgere il mercato. Assunta lidentità di Peter Franks, uno dei corrieri della banda, Bond non tarda a individuarne il capo, la bella Tiffany Case, la cui organizzazione, pero, sta da qualche tempo subendo gli attacchi di sconosciuti avversari, che uccidono i contrabbandieri e simpossessano dei diamanti. Divenuta Tiffany, cui egli ha rivelato la propria identità, sua alleata, Bond scopre, dopo aver evitato due volte di venire ucciso, che i diamanti trafugati allorganizzazione di Case sono finiti in un laboratorio spaziale, e utilizzati nella costruzione di un satellite, che sta per essere lanciato in orbita.

programme.desc: Louis and Abacus want to play a game of their favorite game but they can't find a comfortable, calm and quiet place, despite having tried everything. / Louis et Abacus veulent faire une partie de leur jeu prefere mais ils ne trouvent pas de place confortable, calme et tranquille, malgre avoir tout essaye.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: A self-proclaimed spider "The Enemy of Woodlice" wants to attack Abacus. A game of hide and seek begins.
